notes.title: Oktoberfest!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/8be234bc151c308dd5e66757703d7ceeccc208b8.png[/img]

🍺Time to liven up those dull autumn days—Oktoberfest is coming! Take part in the drinks festival in Sphere 3 and earn unforgettable experiences and valuable prizes, including unique boots and a new title!

In the main cities and towns, you'll find special drink stands where special holiday quests await. Those who've been with us for years will surely remember the charming Fraus with their divine drinks.

Contact the "Festival Master" character in Greenwald and the Raven Legion Camp to accept your first quest.

After completing the quest chain, they will be available daily. Complete them daily to earn festival coins, which you can use to choose your desired reward from the event vendor:
✨Boots of the Fair Wind (Epic quality) - Increases character movement speed by 7.5%. ✨Wind Gust Boots (Epic quality) - When taking damage, there's a 20% chance to increase the character's movement speed by 25% for 10 seconds. 20-second cooldown.
✨Hurricane Boots (Epic quality) - Knock back all enemies within a 7-meter radius by 4 meters when the wearer is affected by a crowd control effect. This effect can only occur once every 50 seconds.
✨Title "Ale Connoisseur" - Increases stamina and spirit by 2.5%.
✨Ancient Helm.

Additional Festival Coins can be obtained from monsters or purchased in the in-game store. Incidentally, you can also get special Festival Potions there, which increase the amount of Event Coins received for killing monsters and completing quests by 200%!

Have a great time at Oktoberfest, collect all the gifts, and stock up on good cheer!

We wish you a pleasant game!

notes.title: Fall Leaf Festival!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/82d0ffae421d514cfe4ec62cedc00c44f18c48b9.png[/img]

🍂An ancient autumn festival is coming to the world of the Sphere. During the festival, any monster of your level, as well as 3 levels higher or lower, may drop a fragment of a golden leaf. Following the ancient tradition, you will have to collect a crown of golden leaves for yourself and receive the blessing of autumn itself (an experience bonus of up to 5% and a damage increase of up to 10%), which is valid during the festival and a week after it.

When combining leaves, you will also be guaranteed to receive one of four epic belts for your level, as well as useful items, including healing potions, teleportation stones, enhancement scrolls, banker summoning scrolls, resurrection scrolls, inlay stones, fortification crystals and runic fortification crystals, as well as experience and breadwinner potions.

More about epic belts: with a certain chance, you can get it every time you combine three symbols from leaves. If your character has not received the belt after 24 attempts, he is guaranteed to receive it on the 25th attempt!

All belts have 6 colorless gem sockets:
🍁Belt of Flying Leaves - when receiving a control effect, removes 2 negative effects from the owner. Cooldown 90 sec.
🍁Belt of Autumn Warmth - on a critical hit, restores 8% of the owner's health. Cooldown 35 sec.
🍁Belt of the Departed Sun - on a critical hit, increases the chance of a critical hit by 8% for 10 sec. Triggers no more than once every 35 sec.
🍁Belt of the Elusive Wind - reduces the chance of receiving a critical hit by 7%.

Don't forget about the daily competition. Every day, the winning team will receive a 10% bonus to experience, gold, and item drops for the entire next day, and the losing team will receive a 5% bonus to experience and gold.

In Greenwald and Raven Legion Camp, you can find a daily quest that will give you additional fragments.

A premium account doubles your chances of getting a gold leaf fragment, and you can buy additional gold leaves in the in-game store.

Good luck!🍂

notes.title: Season "Forgotten Observatory"
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/253e8f9f2549df3a29e4fe156d8157d191563799.png[/img]

More than a hundred gifts for every Sphere player! The bravest, wisest and noblest warriors of the Sphere are invited to participate in the new season!

🔹What is this season?🔹

In essence, this is a set of tasks for participation in which progress points are given. As you accumulate progress points, you will receive sets of useful, and sometimes even unique rewards!

🔹Tell us more about the prizes!🔹

🌀Title "Touched by the Abyss" - increases the amplification of abilities by 1.5%, critical damage multiplier by 1.3%.
🌀Giant's Flask - reduces the chance of receiving a critical hit by 8%, increases health by 20% for a day.
🌀Loot Collector Tree of the Abyss - increases the experience gained and health regeneration by 10%. Moves 60% faster than usual, lasts 30 days.
🌀Groom's Token - used to improve a riding pet at grooms.
🌀Fog of Secrets - a decorative effect for 60 minutes. The cooldown of the item is 60 minutes.
🌀Gormak the Soaring Pet. Its properties are below.
◻️ Crusher
◻️ Skill
◻️ Level 10 - Exceptional Agility (Increases the owner's Agility by 1.6%) OR Exceptional Wisdom (Increases the owner's Wisdom by 1.6%)
◻️ Level 20 - Otherworldly Power (Increases the power of physical abilities by 9%) OR Mystical Mysteries (Increases the power of magical abilities by 9%)
◻️ Level 30 - Exceptional Agility (Increases the owner's Agility by 1.6%) OR Exceptional Wisdom (Increases the owner's Wisdom by 1.6%)
◻️ Level 40 - (Increases attack and ability speed by 5%, critical strike chance by 2%) OR Life Absorption (Restores health in the amount of 2.5% of the damage dealt by the owner.)
◻️ 50 level — Exceptional Agility (Increases the owner's Agility by 1.6%) OR Exceptional Wisdom (Increases the owner's Wisdom by 1.6%)
◻️ Level 60 — Panic (Causes fear in all enemies within 14 meters for 5 seconds if the owner is stunned, feared, silenced, immobilized, asleep, or disarmed. Targets additionally increase their chance to receive a critical hit by 18%. Cannot be triggered more often than once every 75 seconds.) OR Curse of Fragility (When attacking with an 8% chance (16% for a critical hit), reduces the enemy's defense by 6% and increases the chance to critically hit them by 4%. Stacks up to 7 times. The effect lasts for 13s.)

In addition to all this, you can get feed, preservation crystals, the hammer of the master of processing, essences, ghost coins, spices and much, much more. The full set of rewards is available to those who purchase the extended pass.

You can purchase the Aldric's Burden headgear and the Void Gauntlet back attachment from Battle Pass vendors for Ghost Coins.

🔹I'm in! How do I join?🔹

When you first log in after the Battle Season starts, each of your characters will see an invitation window.

Click the "Start Season" button to join. After that, you can open the season window by clicking on the icon next to the minimap.

🔹What do you need to do?🔹

Open the season window. In it, you will see a list of tasks. Tasks are divided into those that you can complete once per season and daily ones. One-time tasks are chains (complete the current task to start the next one). However, each group of tasks is available at the same time - as you complete simple tasks, new, more difficult ones will open up for you.

🔹I want more rewards and tasks!🔹

Easy! To have access to more tasks and get more rewards for progress points, you can purchase an extended pass. In addition to these benefits, the pass will also allow you to gain combat experience (progress points) faster. An extended pass is purchased once for the entire season and is valid for your entire account. You can become the owner of an extended pass and collect the rewards due to you at any time during the season.

🔹Can I get the rewards right now?🔹

If the romance of completing tasks every day gets boring for you, then of course! To speed up the passage of the season and instantly gain access to rewards, you can purchase levels (a fixed number of progress points).

🔹How long is the season?🔹

The season lasts 28 days and contains 100 levels of progress.
Get the maximum gifts!

We wish you good luck in the new season!

notes.title: The Tree of the Abyss
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/eadbc0d60d6a1570a677d5b7312fd9abd6d3ab0a.png[/img]

The magic of the Abyss did not stop at Gormak. It seeped into the ground, poisoning all life around the observatory. Most of the plants withered in an instant, but one woke up.

It was a small, crooked tree that would have withered away on its own over time. But under the influence of the Abyss, it came to life, its roots turning into legs, its branches into clawed tentacles, and its bark cracking into a terrible maw.

The creature devoured everything: grass, animals, even stones. The shamans tried to burn it, chop it up, banish it - but it was reborn, as if the Abyss itself was feeding it.

And then, on the day when the shamans finally sealed the observatory again, it disappeared. No one knows where it went. Some are sure that the cursed tree is looking for Mordruuk so that together they can return and break the seals on the observatory.

notes.title: Gormak the Floating
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/1616b2380399d8d8e7b1f49cd9e0678baf34ad28.png[/img]

When Mordruuk disappeared, leaving the observatory gates unprotected, the shamans were in despair. They did not dare approach the cursed place, but they could not allow the darkness to spread further.
And the magic of the Abyss did not wait. It clung to the living like a disease. And its first victim was Gormak the Floating, one of the demons patrolling the observatory.

At first, the changes were barely noticeable: his skin was covered with purple veins, like the roots of darkness. Then the power began to flow in his veins, distorting his flesh. When his kin noticed this, they pounced on him, but Gormak managed to fight them off and escape.

Escape saved his mind, but not his body. With each passing day, the Abyss reshaped him: blades as sharp as night appeared on his hands, his body turned into a translucent shadow, and his eyes lit up with a cold violet flame. He was no longer a demon, but something else.

At first, he helped his former brothers in arms - saving them from ambushes, leading them out of traps. But when the shamans finally sealed the observatory, Gormak understood his purpose and stood up to protect the observatory. Not out of loyalty to Kagrokhan, not out of fear. But because he knows that something worse than death is hidden inside. And anyone who tries to open the observatory will learn what blades forged by the Abyss itself are capable of.

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/a0c016917a1e89db30740ea5215400f6d6e53f36.png[/img]

When Kagrokhan learned that Aldric's students not only survived, but were also trying to get into the sealed observatory, his rage knew no bounds. He could not allow the magic of the Abyss to break free.

In order to finally bury Aldric's legacy, the First Demon strengthened the observatory's defenses. To do this, he ordered the creation of the three-headed dog Mordruuk. The creature knew no mercy and fatigue. For centuries, it stood guard and attacked everyone who dared to approach the forbidden place.

Over time, the Abyss began to seep through the cracks in the seal that was placed on the observatory. And the first one it touched was Mordruuk. The magic ate ​​into his mind, distorted his very essence. The Great Guardian ceased to be a servant of Kagrokhan, he began to obey the Abyss and left his post. Shamans tried to track him down, but the tracks were cut off, as if magic was hiding the fugitive.

Centuries have passed, but the demons remember this creature and fear that one day he will return. And his intentions will clearly be evil.

notes.title: Gauntlet of the Abyss
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/60343551947accd3ae0db4c063f05511262d3559.png[/img]

Despite the merciless executions, several of Aldric's students managed to escape. They could not come to terms with the loss of their teacher and began to look for a way to bring him back. And one day, they came close to saving him.

Having concentrated their forces, they created the Gauntlet of the Abyss. The artifact was supposed to be an improved version of the mask that Aldric had created, but reinforced with runes for security. The students intended to use the gauntlet to break into the sealed observatory and remove the stone mask from Aldric's face and bring him back. But the Abyss does not forgive mistakes.

The students approached the observatory, killed the guards and tried to remove the protection with the gauntlet. However, the first demon to put on the gauntlet paid for it with his life: purple light poured out of his eyes, mouth, even cracks in his skin. He did not scream. He burned from the inside until his flesh turned to ash.

The students saw what had happened and fled, throwing down the gauntlet. The artifact's fate is unknown. Perhaps it can be found in some forgotten crypt.

notes.title: Aldric's Burden
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/eb5f9d03e0a02b39a283bbd033ed89e76cb3e071.png[/img]

Tir Twaidh is a land full of secrets and forgotten places. Such as the observatory of Aldric the Empty.
Aldric was the greatest shaman of Tir Twaidh. His skill commanded respect even from Kagrokhan, who granted him a huge observatory - a place where he could conduct research and train new great shamans. There, Aldric studied ancient rituals, comprehended the secret laws of the universe and shared his knowledge with other demons.

But shamanism was only a facade. Aldric's true passion was the magic of the Abyss. He craved its power, dreaming of conquering not only people, but also demons. To harness this power, he created a stone mask - an artifact capable of concentrating darkness.

But the mask did not help. At the moment of the ritual, the energy of the Abyss broke out of control and turned Aldric into stone.

When Kagrohan learned of this, he was furious. The First Demon ordered the surviving students executed, all records burned, and the observatory itself sealed forever. No one was to follow in Aldric's footsteps. The power of the Void remained forbidden - the risk was too great that the next person to try to tame it would not only die, but destroy not only Tir-Tuaidh, but the entire Sphere.

notes.title: Season "Secrets of the Deserts"
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/6122dc2aa0a17d9006899bbd3ac4dfe102c95817.png[/img]

More than a hundred gifts for every Sphere player! The bravest, wisest and noblest warriors of the Sphere are invited to participate in the new season!

🔹What is this season?🔹

In essence, this is a set of tasks for participation in which progress points are given. As you accumulate progress points, you will receive sets of useful, and sometimes even unique rewards!

🔹Tell us more about the prizes!🔹
☀️Title "Prince of the Sands" - increases movement speed by 2.5%, health regeneration in battle by 5%.
☀️Infusion of the Mystery of Life - increases endurance by 20%, regeneration by 40% for 24 hours.
☀️Loot Collector Duat - increases the amount of gold and the chance to get loot from monsters by 25%. Moves 60% faster than usual, lasts 30 days.
☀️Groom's Token - used to improve the riding pet at grooms.
☀️Hemsaru Stars - decorative effect for 60 minutes. Item cooldown is 60 minutes.
☀️Hek-Urun Pet. Its properties are below.
◻️ Magic
◻️ Speed
◻️ Level 10 - Exceptional Agility (Increases the owner's Agility by 1.6%) OR Exceptional Wisdom (Increases the owner's Wisdom by 1.6%)
◻️ Level 20 - Light Step (Increases the owner's movement speed by 12%)
OR Tireless (Increases the speed of movement, attack, and casting abilities by 6%.)
◻️ Level 30 - Exceptional Agility (Increases the owner's Agility by 1.6%) OR Exceptional Wisdom (Increases the owner's Wisdom by 1.6%)
◻️ Level 40 - Great Flame of the Warrior (Increases the owner's movement and attack speed by 7.5%) OR Great Flame of the Wizard (Increases the owner's movement and casting abilities by 7.5%)
◻️ Level 50 - Exceptional Agility (Increases the owner's Agility by 1.6%) OR Exceptional Wisdom (Increases the owner's Wisdom by 1.6%)
◻️ Level 60 - Resurrection (After receiving fatal damage, the owner restores 40% of their maximum health. Cannot occur more than once every 200 seconds.) OR Golden Shield (Puts a shield on the owner equal to 30% of their maximum health. The shield absorbs 70% of any damage and returns 35% of the damage to the attacker. The shield lasts for 65 seconds and is refreshed after 65 seconds.)

In addition to all this, you can get feed, preservation crystals, the Refiner's Hammer, essences, ghost coins, spices and much, much more. The full set of rewards is available for those who purchase the expanded pass.

You can purchase the Hemsaru Face headgear and the Sarih Wings back attachment from Battle Pass vendors using Ghost Coins.

🔹I'm in! How do I join?🔹

When you first log in after the Battle Season starts, each of your characters will see an invitation window.

Click the "Start Season" button to join. After that, you can open the season window by clicking on the icon next to the minimap.

🔹What do you need to do?🔹

Open the season window. In it, you will see a list of tasks. Tasks are divided into those that you can complete once per season and daily ones. One-time tasks are chains (complete the current task to start the next one). However, each group of tasks is available at the same time - as you complete simple tasks, new, more difficult ones will open up for you.

🔹I want more rewards and tasks!🔹

Easy! To have access to more missions and get more rewards for progress points, you can purchase an extended pass. In addition to these benefits, the pass will also allow you to gain combat experience (progress points) faster. An extended pass is purchased once for the entire season and is valid for your entire account. You can become the owner of an extended pass and collect the rewards due to you at any time during the season.

🔹Can I get the rewards right now?🔹

If the romance of completing tasks every day gets boring for you, then of course! To speed up the passage of the season and instantly gain access to rewards, you can purchase levels (a fixed number of progress points).

🔹How long is the season?🔹

The season lasts 28 days and contains 100 levels of progress.
Get maximum gifts!

We wish you good luck in the new season!

notes.title: On the Wings of the Storm
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/07ab1af842d768df67c0350efd7af1e94c4ee1cb.png[/img]

The last spirit that Hemsaru created was Sarih. He was forged from the souls of ordinary people who died in a fratricidal war.

Sarih could control nature itself. His wide wings could disperse storms, direct rains to the fields, change the courses of rivers. Thanks to him, the inhabitants of Men-Nefer did not know hunger.

But Sarih had one flaw - unlike other spirits, he was willful. He obeyed the pharaoh, but only in the beginning. The spirit saw the methods by which Hemsaru was expanding the empire, and he did not like it. The last straw was the destruction of the priests of Wet-Narib, after which Sarih left.
The spirit knew that Hemsaru could disembody him, so he patiently waited for the death of the creator. When this happened, Sarih returned. With his wings, he did not allow a single gust of cool wind to blow on the territory of the empire, not a single drop to spill on the possessions of his dead creator. Gradually, the rivers dried up, the fields and forests turned into deserts.

And now, when only sand remains of the empire, sometimes it seems as if huge wings flicker in the sultry haze...

notes.title: Stories of Amaat
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/1291c769f5dcc421d61bfbb68cbc3ae83567bd12.png[/img]

Hemsaru's third creation was the majestic cat Amaat. The pharaoh put the souls of warriors into her creation, who combined the speed of a cheetah with the wisdom of ancient priests.

Hemsaru traveled across his vast empire on this gigantic beast. When the pharaoh could not personally visit distant cities, Amaat rushed there alone and did not simply convey orders, but taught and became a temporary ruler.

After the decline of the empire of Men-Nefer, Amaat did not disappear like other creations. She turned into a patron spirit of the desert, helping caravans cross the desert. To those who treated her with respect, she told stories about her creator and his vast empire, thanks to which today we know about the past of this land.

notes.title: Secrets of Duat
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/7f7fba21e7cf28711db860e64792e7fda0ef3b0a.png[/img]

Khemsaru's second creation was Duat. Unlike the furious Hek-Urun, the pharaoh forged this spirit from the souls of warriors who were pure in heart. With its help, the pharaoh established trade relations, carried goods and delivered messages. When the Hans River flooded an entire province, it was Duat that brought healing herbs and bread to the victims, saving thousands of lives.

But Khemsaru was not only a wise ruler, but also a cunning one. He used Duat to poison his enemies in neighboring states. "It is better to strike a secret blow than to arrange a massacre," the pharaoh believed.

With the death of Khemsaru, Duat lost its meaning. First, it wandered through the desert, and then carved out a sarcophagus and hid inside, as if in a forgotten tomb. The sands of centuries swallowed him up, but legends say that if you dig up the stone tomb and pronounce the true name of the spirit, he will come to light again...

notes.title: Can you tame Hek-Urun?
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/3dbb2149f5fb30c1f8db0add2427c09ebf57fb30.png[/img]

Khemsaru's first creation was Hek-Urun, a merciless guardian forged from the souls of the empire's fiercest warriors.

The spirit knew no mercy. On the battlefield, he summoned sand whirlwinds that tore apart the orderly ranks of troops and left behind only wind-gnawed bones. Within the empire, he waged a constant struggle against conspirators. It was he who destroyed the priests of Wet-Narib, those who whispered with the Nightsisters and plotted to overthrow Khemsaru.

Even after the death of the pharaoh and the fall of the empire, Hek-Urun found no peace. He continues to guard the borders of the ancient state and will do so until the Sphere itself ceases to exist.

notes.title: The Face of Hemsaru
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/8f067ced7426f0b7898b384413e856b3f0721572.png[/img]

Far to the south, among the hot sands of the desert, thousands of years ago, the great empire of Men-Nefer stood. It was ruled by the pharaoh Userkhep, who had four heirs. The youngest of them was Hemsaru. He knew that he would never see the throne, and so from childhood he devoted himself to the study of magic and shamanism.

When Userkhep died, the empire was plunged into darkness: the three elder brothers began a bloody war for the throne. In the end, Totep, the eldest and most ruthless of them, won. But in the civil strife, he lost all his children, and he himself received serious wounds and died after only two years of rule. So the throne went to Hemsaru.

The new pharaoh began to revive the empire, resorting to forbidden arts. He called upon the spirits of fallen warriors and with the power of the Abyss turned them into his servants. But the dark magic did not go in vain - it crippled Hemsar's body. To hide his appearance, the pharaoh ordered a golden mask to be forged, in which he appeared as a subject. They say that somewhere in the depths of the desert his tomb is still hidden, and in it rests that very golden mask...

💍Ring of Elusiveness — When affected by a control effect, reduces the chance of receiving a critical hit by 6% for 12 seconds. Stacks up to 3 times, triggers no more than once every 4 seconds.

All rings are epic and contain 6 colorless gem sockets.

notes.title: Cross-faction alliances, rebalance and more!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/df0225161ef621364a88d95eb109eb79d6372353.png[/img]

Spherians!

Our development team has been carefully studying your wishes for several months and has finally prepared a big update for you! Thanks to everyone who actively shared their impressions on social networks, technical support and surveys. Today, during technical work, the following changes were made to the game.

🔹CROSS-FACTION ALLIANCES
First of all, cross-faction alliances have become a reality! Now human and demon clans can enter into full-fledged alliances and participate together in sieges, wars and other activities.

🔹FACTION BONUSES
The game now has faction bonuses that will always accompany your character from the moment of its creation. Let's look at them in more detail.

👨People
🔸General faction bonus for people:

+4% movement speed.

And also special bonuses for each subclass:

🔸Barbarian, Warrior, Paladin:

Magic damage taken is reduced by 3%,
Attack speed of swords +2%.

🔸Ranger, Monk, Assassin:

+3% attack speed,
The first 3 seconds of combat, the chance to receive a critical hit is reduced by 10%.

🔸Priest, Sorcerer, Necromancer:

+10% speed of restoration of magical or necrotic energy,
Damage is increased by 3% when using a rod and a symbol.

😈Demons
🔸General faction bonus of demons:

+5% endurance.

And also special bonuses for each subclass:

🔸Barbarian, Warrior, Paladin:

Physical damage taken is reduced by 3%,
Damage of any axes +3%.

🔸Pathfinder, Monk, Assassin:

+1% critical strike chance,
+10% movement speed if running for more than 4 seconds.

🔸Priest, Sorcerer, Necromancer:

Critical damage increased by 5%,
Damage taken decreased by 1.5% when using a staff.

🔹CLASS REBALANCE
You have written many wishes about how classes in the game should be changed. We have reviewed them all, thought about them, tried them on the characters, tweaked something, fixed something - and we present to you a new version of balance!
First of all, you complained a lot about sorcerers and warriors, and we heard you - their damage has become less. But they still remain dangerous - and how could they be otherwise, because tearing everyone to rags is their job!
Other classes have also received changes in one direction or another — a detailed list of everything that has changed can be found in this article.

And of course, skill points for all classes have been reset — it's time to redistribute them in a way that will be more convenient for you after the update.

🔹 CASTLE CHANGES
Without further ado — the castle owner's allies during a siege are now also reborn inside the castle. Sieges will become more dynamic, and allies — more useful.

The second change, which was actively voted for by players: royal armor will now only work within the castle.

These are all the changes for today. We are waiting for your feedback on our social networks and technical support and continue to work to implement your other wishes. Together with you we will make the Sphere even better!

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Season "The Power of Nature"
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/4abc05318a9df34055b80c5aed8128f602fd8577.png[/img]

More than a hundred gifts for every Sphere player! The bravest, wisest and noblest warriors of the Sphere are invited to participate in the new season!

🔹What is this season?🔹

In essence, this is a set of tasks for participation in which progress points are given. As you accumulate progress points, you will receive sets of useful, and sometimes even unique rewards!

🔹Tell us more about the prizes!🔹

✅Title "Sprouted" - increases health regeneration by 9%, physical defense by 3%.
✅Windfury Infusion - increases attack speed, spells and movement by 5% for 24 hours
✅Loot collector "renk" - moves 60% faster than usual, exists for 30 days.
Groom's token - used to improve the riding pet at the grooms.
✅Er'ask pet. Its properties are below. ◻️ Strong
◻️ Economy
◻️ Level 10 - Exceptional Strength and Endurance (Increases the owner's strength and endurance by 0.95%) OR Exceptional Intelligence and Endurance (Increases the owner's intelligence and endurance by 0.95%)
◻️ Level 20 - Greater Fortification (Reduces the owner's physical and magical damage by 3.5%) OR Healing Power (Increases received healing and shields by 7.5%)
◻️ Level 30 - Exceptional Endurance (Increases the owner's endurance by 1.6%) OR Exceptional Spirit (Increases the owner's spirit by 1.6%)
◻️ Level 40 - Impenetrable Defense (Increases the owner's physical and magical defense by 35% for 8 seconds upon receiving the effect stun, fear, silence, immobilize, sleep, or disarm. Cannot occur more than once every 40 seconds.) OR Nature's Wrath (Increases the owner's ability power by 12% for 12s when receiving the effect of stun, fear, silence, immobilize, sleep, or disarm. Cannot occur more than once every 40 seconds.)
◻️ Level 50 - Exceptional Strength (Increases the owner's strength by 1.6%) OR Exceptional Intellect (Increases the owner's intelligence by 1.6%)
◻️ Level 60 - Enhanced Regeneration (Increases the owner's health regeneration by 140%) OR Great Tenacity (Reduces incoming damage by 17% for 12s if the owner receives a control effect. Cannot occur more than once every 40 seconds.)

In addition to all this, you can get food, preservation crystals, the hammer of the master of processing, essences, ghostly coins, spices, and much, much more. The full set of rewards is available to those who purchase the extended pass.

You can purchase the Rukh Mask headdress and the Darukhar Hand shoulder ornament from Battle Pass merchants for Ghost Coins.

🔹I'm in! How do I join?🔹

When you first log in to the game after the start of the Battle Season, each of your characters will see an invitation window.

Click the “Start Season” button to join. After that, you can open the season window by clicking on the icon next to the minimap.

🔹What do you need to do?🔹

Open the season window. In it, you will see a list of tasks. Tasks are divided into those that you can complete once per season and daily ones. One-time tasks are chains (complete the current task to start the next one). However, each group of tasks is available at the same time - as you complete simple tasks, new, more difficult ones will open up for you.

🔹I want more rewards and tasks!🔹

Easy! To have access to more tasks and get more rewards for progress points, you can purchase an extended pass. In addition to these benefits, the pass will also allow you to gain combat experience (progress points) faster. An extended pass is purchased once for the entire season and is valid for your entire account. You can become the owner of an extended pass and collect the rewards due to you at any time during the season.

🔹Can I get the rewards right now?🔹

If the romance of completing tasks every day gets boring for you, then of course! To speed up the passage of the season and instantly gain access to rewards, you can purchase levels (a fixed number of progress points).

🔹How long is the season?🔹

The season lasts 28 days and contains 100 levels of progress.
Get the maximum gifts!

We wish you good luck in the new season!

notes.title: Make friends with a renok!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/80838eb689713e27fbd32e922ac5fd968e13a5ab.png[/img]

One of the most bizarre animals of the ancient forest were renoks. These funny grunting creatures inhabited the ancient forest and helped the rukhas in their daily affairs: they collected crops, looked after children.
The main problem of the renoks was their gullibility. When people entered the forest, the renoks met them first and brought them to their tribes.

People could breed gullible renoks, but they were afraid that these animals were somehow connected with Darukhar. Therefore, having finished with the spirit and the rukhas, they exterminated the renoks. These animals are not found anywhere else in the sphere.

notes.title: Who is Er'ask?
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/2168eb9de2bbf33b84f0fc11ce23c40955e2a99c.png[/img]

Darukhar loved his forest and the Rukhs who honored him very much. And even in the darkest hour, he did not abandon his charges.

One day, a disease came to the forest that killed healthy Rukhs in a few days. The forest dwellers prayed to Darukhar asking for help. The spirit heard them and brought Er'ask.

It was a small stone creature with a flower growing on it. From the plant, the Rukhs created an elixir that healed the sick. When the disease receded, it remained and entertained the children.

But Er'ask was a product of Darukhar's ancient magic. Therefore, when the spirit disappeared, the living stone disappeared too. But who knows, maybe if Darukhar returns, then Er'ask will return too.

notes.title: Hand of Darukhar
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/63e2ffb52e0d4d6441adf056f5f953c942a5e2fe.png[/img]

People don't remember anymore, but thousands of years ago, during the birth of the Sphere, a beautiful forest stood on the site of Olannor, the cemetery and the farm. It was a wonderful place, inhabited by strange animals. The spirit of Darukhar guarded them.

He protected the local animals and the humanoid rukhs. Under his protection, the entire forest lived in harmony. Until people came.

At first, Darukhar discovered traps and freed the animals that had fallen into them. Then he saw how people had cut down part of the forest.

Darukhar became furious and unleashed his power on the people. The first battle was his, but after a while the people returned and, with the support of the mages, destroyed the forest protector. The spirit evaporated, and only one hand remained. They say that Darukhar's power still glimmers in it, and if he is resurrected, he will sweep Olannor off the face of the sphere.

notes.title: Season "Pirates of the Southern Seas"
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/49f1c7ed855a776f7da3020c5d1e3b1a2bdadae0.png[/img]

More than a hundred gifts for every player of the Sphere! The bravest, wisest and noblest warriors of the Sphere are invited to participate in the new season!

🔹What is this season?🔹

In essence, this is a set of tasks for participation in which progress points are given. As you accumulate progress points, you will receive sets of useful, and sometimes even unique rewards!

🔹Tell us more about the prizes!🔹
🔸Title "Sea Storm" - increases movement speed by 2.5% gold when killing monsters by 6%.
🔸Wind Fury Infusion - increases attack, spell and movement speed by 5% for 24 hours
🔸Loot Collector Kirtan - moves 60% faster than usual, exists for 30 days.
🔸Groom's Token - used to upgrade a riding pet for grooms.
🔸Sting Pet. Its properties are below.
◻️ Beast
◻️ Luck
◻️ Level 10 - Exceptional Agility and Endurance (Increases the owner's Agility and Endurance by 0.95%) OR Exceptional Wisdom and Endurance (Increases the owner's Wisdom and Endurance by 0.95%)
◻️ Level 20 - Light Step (Increases the owner's movement speed by 12%) OR Tireless (Increases movement, attack, and casting speed by 6%)
◻️ Level 30 - Exceptional Agility and Endurance (Increases the owner's Agility and Endurance by 0.95%) OR Exceptional Wisdom and Endurance (Increases the owner's Wisdom and Endurance by 0.95%)
◻️ Level 40 - Sudden Attack (Increases critical hit chance by 2.5%, movement speed by 6%.) OR Superior Vigilance (Reduces the chance of being critically hit by 6.5%)
◻️ Level 50 - Exceptional Agility (Increases the owner's Agility by 1.6%) OR Exceptional Wisdom (Increases the owner's Wisdom by 1.6%)
◻️ Level 60 - Raise the Sails (When the owner's health drops to 30% of maximum or lower, their movement speed increases by 25%, damage taken is reduced by 26% for 8 seconds. Cannot be triggered more often than once every 40 seconds.) OR Fair Wind (When the owner deals critical damage, their movement speed increases by 18%, health regeneration in battle by 75% for 10 seconds. Cannot be triggered more often than once every 25 seconds.)

In addition to all this, you can get food, preservation crystals, the hammer of the master of processing, essences, Ghost Coins, Spices, and much, much more. The full set of rewards is available to those who purchase the Advanced Pass.

You can purchase the Sol's Hat and Sol's Armada Back Attachment from Battle Pass vendors using Ghost Coins.

🔹I'm in! How do I join?🔹

When you first log in after the Battle Season starts, each of your characters will see an invitation window.

Click the “Start Season” button to join. After that, you can open the season window by clicking on the icon next to the minimap.

🔹What do you need to do?🔹

Open the season window. In it, you will see a list of tasks. Tasks are divided into those that you can complete once per season and daily ones. One-time tasks are chains (complete the current task to start the next one). However, each group of tasks is available at the same time - as you complete simple tasks, new, more difficult ones will open up for you.

🔹I want more rewards and tasks!🔹

Easy! To have access to more tasks and get more rewards for progress points, you can purchase an extended pass. In addition to these benefits, the pass will also allow you to gain combat experience (progress points) faster. An extended pass is purchased once for the entire season and is valid for your entire account. You can become the owner of an extended pass and collect the rewards due to you at any time during the season.

🔹Can I get the rewards right now?🔹

If the romance of completing tasks every day gets boring for you, then sure! To speed up the passage of the season and instantly gain access to rewards, you can purchase levels (a fixed number of progress points).

🔹How long is the season?🔹

The season lasts 28 days and contains 100 levels of progress.
Get the maximum gifts!

We wish you good luck in the new season!

notes.title: Kirtan will help!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/313af7a94aaf1b813f51b9da456bf4064054e3b9.png[/img]

An unusual and useful member of the crew was a monkey nicknamed Kirtan. She was picked up after one of the raids on the human camp. From there, the demons took everything they could: gold, folios, crystals, magic tools, and at the same time grabbed an exotic animal.

When they began to divide the spoils, they wanted to abandon the monkey and throw it overboard. But Sol said that he had seen the same animal in a traveling circus. So he decided to keep the animal and teach it the intricacies of sea life.

Kirtan, as the monkey was called, was ill-suited for ship life. He could not tie knots, shoot, or help in the kitchen. The only thing he could do was carry gunpowder. But thanks to this, the ship could fire quickly, which repeatedly saved Sol's pirates in battles with superior enemy forces.

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/6feb6bf92578ed4df6d910cc15403c498b4bc8fd.png[/img]

Sol's faithful assistant in his travels was a parrot named Sting. The pirate found him as a chick when he fell out of the nest. The demon took pity and took the bird onto the ship.

At first, the demons treated Sting as a funny toy: the parrot entertained the sailors with singing, listened to their complaints about the sea and the humans, and comically distorted words. But everything changed during one of the battles with a human ship.

It was an ordinary fight, but it was different because the humans had three magicians at once. The advantage was on the side of the humans, until one of the sorcerers launched lightning at the ship and hit Sting. The demons saw this and with tripled fury fell upon the human ship.

The battle quickly ended with the complete destruction of the humans. Sting survived that attack, but lost a paw. The pirates did not abandon their friend and made him a crutch from scrap materials. Since then, Sting has not flown, but has learned to move quickly around the deck with the help of his new wooden paw.

notes.title: The Most Fearsome Weapon
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/3d9d07fbc3b8cf7b0672d0bb7f2355159201db28.png[/img]

Sol's troops terrified people. And it wasn't just because of the mercons or the sharp demon sabers. Sol's main asset was his armada.

Instead of mounting cannons on ships, the pirate ordered them to be redesigned to be carried on the back. This allowed them to fire at people while already standing on their ship.

In addition, during land operations, there was no need to bring the ship close: the demons on the mercons reached the land, ordered the fish to attack people with their sharp saw-like noses, and fired from convenient positions.

The humans tried to create something similar, but their flimsy backs could not withstand the power of a cannon shot.

notes.title: Riding a Mercon
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/83a7f2fe0ed73a3c561a22f2a7135a1a80f4b8c0.png[/img]

Sol was a close friend of Nerod the Seer and guarded him on many sea expeditions. This ocean explorer discovered a sea predator named Mercon and told Sol about it. The pirate was impressed by the unusual fish, which had a long nose with sharp teeth, so he decided to use it as a weapon.

The pirate ordered to catch several specimens and deliver them to the observatory. There he instructed the shamans to adapt the fish for movement on land and breathe new life into it. For a long time, the shamans did not succeed and only after an experiment with tiburon, the demons were able to revive the merkons.

In total, about 20 land fish were created by Sol's order. The pirates used them to attack enemy ships at sea and ravage human camps on land. Today, there are practically no demon pirates left, and after Sol's death, no one knows where to find merkons. Almost no one.

notes.title: Try on Sol's hat!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/3afb3e429c16a639509fe2313e68539c31bb74c8.png[/img]

Humans were the first race of the Sphere to master shipbuilding and begin expansion to other continents. Soon, demons joined them. In order to dominate the sea, Vagroth created separate units of pirates who were supposed to prevent people from moving on the water. The most famous of them was Solomitus Kahren, also known as Sol.

He was a loyal demon who fought fiercely against people. He sank hundreds of human ships, plundered dozens of camps. He was considered a real terror of the seas, until one day his luck changed.

Humans spread a rumor that a ship with precious stones and valuable tomes would soon leave for Erikuria. Sol did not think that this could be a trap, so he went for big loot.
And the ship really was. But it was a fast bait vessel that lured the pirate into a narrow strait. There, the humans began shelling Sol's ship with coastal guns. The pirates wanted to leave, but a huge ship blocked the way back.

The demon knew that the ship was going to the bottom, but its crew could still escape. He raised a magic shield, which allowed the demons to put on Neroda's air and go underwater on merkons. Sol himself accepted death with honor. His body was never found. Only his hat remained in memory of him.

notes.title: Invasion of the Abyss
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/2386b545292e6cd10a91426b3ca7fab61f0fd044.png[/img]

Rumor has it that monsters from the Abyss are trying to break into the world of the Sphere! Fight them on their own territory and get unimaginable rewards.

You will find the Treasure of the Abyss, which contains one of four rare or epic relics with six colorless gem sockets.

Rare relics:
💎Relic of Might - increases the chance of a critical attack by 1% and the magnitude of the critical effect by 4%.
💎Relic of Vitality - increases the owner's endurance by 3%, the amount of healing received by 8%.
💎Relic of Speed ​​- increases the speed of movement, attack and casting spells by 3%.
💎Relic of Strength - increases regeneration by 10%, regeneration in battle by 5%.

Epic Relics:
💎Relic of Power — increases the chance of a critical attack by 1.5% and the magnitude of the critical effect by 6%.
💎Relic of Vitality — increases the owner's endurance by 5%, the amount of healing received by 10%.
💎Relic of Speed ​​— increases the speed of movement, attack and casting spells by 5%.
💎Relic of Strength — increases regeneration by 20%, regeneration in battle by 10%.
Relics after being placed in an equipment slot can be taken to the ability panel and have an additional property:
When used, removes the effects of stunning, immobilization, sleep, disarming from the character. Cooldown: 150 seconds.

If the character has not received the treasure of the abyss after 24 attempts to combine fragments, he is guaranteed to receive it on the 25th attempt.

🌀What to do?🌀

Mysterious “echoes of the Abyss” can be obtained from all the monsters of the Sphere world. You can get even more echoes by completing quests in a special zone, where you will have to fight various monsters from all corners of the Abyss.

You will be offered tasks that you will have to complete in the dangerous territory of a special zone. There you can encounter representatives of the enemy faction.

If you are brave enough, you will meet the most terrible Boss of the Abyss - the dragon Darkness, from whom you can win back crystals of preservation and strengthening, but keep in mind that he, like all dragons, has the ability to grow and increase his combat power. The more warriors enter the battle with the boss - the more rewards you will receive in the end, but remember, they will go only to the most worthy of the warriors.

🌀Reward guaranteed!🌀

In addition to the Abyssal Treasure, when combining fragments of a mysterious egg, there is a chance to get a mysterious egg, from which one random pet is guaranteed to drop: forest lizard, bat, winged gurinid, abyssal dragon, snake catcher, gurinid warrior, as well as a poisonous, ice or golden dragon.

Also, when combining fragments of a mysterious egg, the character receives the power of dark energies, which increases the damage dealt and experience gained and is valid until the end of the event and a week later.

🌀What else?🌀

In the process of combining echoes of the abyss, you will also receive rewards: teleportation stones, resurrection scrolls, armor and weapon enhancement scrolls and much more.

Every day, the winning faction that has united the most echoes will receive a 10% bonus to experience, gold, and item drops for the day, while the losing team will receive a 5% bonus to experience and gold.

Important: characters with an active premium account have a double chance of knocking out echoes of the abyss from monsters! And if you don't want to farm mobs, you can buy additional Abyss materia in the game store.

Good luck!

notes.title: Gamel — the pioneer camel in the world of the Sphere!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/a3b39a17c7c18b82e6f4d5014c217b32af4cff16.png[/img]

Friends, great wanderers of the Sphere!

The wind of change has touched our lands again, and this time it has brought with it a real curiosity. For the first time in the history of the Sphere, a mount capable of collecting resources on the go appears — and its name is Gamel.

Yes, you heard right! From now on, you don’t need to dismount and dig in the grass or near an ore vein. Just rush past the desired point on Gamel’s back — and the ore, flowers or mushrooms will appear in your bag themselves.

But that’s not all. Gamel accelerates to a speed of +120%, quickly overcoming the vastness of the Sphere. And although it cannot be improved — neither by a groom’s token, nor by merging with other mounts — its value only increases from this.

Gamel is a temporary companion, and that’s why it is so rare and desirable. You can get it via direct sale in the game store.

Please note that in order for Gamel to collect resources, you must still have the appropriate collection tools in your inventory: a pickaxe, a herbalist's knife, etc. Gamel also does not collect resources that can be obtained directly from monsters (such as skins) - you still need to hunt them for that.

Hurry, heroes, Gamel will not be available for direct sale forever! Perhaps you are destined to be the first to sit on a camel saddle and open a new era in the Sphere.

notes.title: Season "Let There Be a Show!"
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/ab430d492d81dbb13e88172376c25e43295ad951.png[/img]

More than a hundred gifts for every Sphere player! The bravest, wisest and most noble warriors of the Sphere are invited to participate in the new season!

🔹What is this season?🔹

In essence, this is a set of tasks for participation in which progress points are awarded. As you accumulate progress points, you will receive sets of useful, and sometimes even unique rewards!

🔹Tell us more about the prizes!🔹
⚫️ Title "Harlequin" - Increases critical strike chance by 0.6%, critical damage multiplier by 1.3%.
⚫️ Windfury Flask - increases attack, spell and movement speed by 5% for 24 hours
⚫️ Ruby the Loot Collector - moves 60% faster than usual, lasts 30 days.
⚫️Groom's Token - used to upgrade a riding pet for grooms.
⚫️Pet Spaldi. Its properties are below.
◻️ fast
◻️ skill
◻️ 10th level - Exceptional Agility (Increases the owner's Agility by 1.6%) OR Exceptional Wisdom (Increases the owner's Wisdom by 1.6%)
◻️ 20th level - Light Step (Increases the owner's movement speed by 12%) OR Tricks (Reduces the chance of getting a critical hit by 4%, increases health recovery in battle by 25%)
◻️ 30th level - Exceptional Agility (Increases the owner's Agility by 1.6%) OR Exceptional Wisdom (Increases the owner's Wisdom by 1.6%)
◻️ 40th level - Onslaught (Increases attack and ability speed by 5%, critical hit chance by 2%) OR Evasion (When hit with a 7.5% chance, reduces the chance of getting a critical hit by 4.2%. Stacks up to 5 times. The effect lasts for 14 seconds and refreshes.)
◻️ Level 50 - Exceptional Agility (Increases the owner's Agility by 1.6%) OR Exceptional Wisdom (Increases the owner's Wisdom by 1.6%)
◻️ Level 60 - Panic (For 5 seconds, causes fear in all enemies within 14 meters if the owner is stunned, feared, silenced, immobilized, sleep, or disarmed. Targets additionally increase their chance to receive a critical hit by 18%. Cannot be triggered more often than once every 75 seconds.) OR A series of Stabs (If the owner deals critical damage, their attack speed and ability use speed are increased by 16%, the chance of a critical hit is increased by 7.5% for 8 seconds. Cannot be triggered more often than once every 35 seconds.)

In addition to all this, you can get food, preservation crystals, the hammer of the master of processing, essences, Ghost Coins, Spices, and much, much more. The full set of rewards is available to those who purchase the Advanced Pass.

Fleck's Mask headgear and Lemi's Back Attachment can be purchased from Battle Pass vendors using Ghost Coins.

🔹I'm in! How do I join?🔹

When you first log in after the Battle Season starts, each of your characters will see an invitation window.

Click the "Start Season" button to join. After that, you can open the season window by clicking on the icon next to the minimap.

🔹What do I need to do?🔹

Open the season window. In it, you will see a list of tasks. Tasks are divided into those that you can complete once per season and daily ones. One-time tasks are chains (complete the current task to start the next one). However, each group of tasks is available at the same time - as you complete simple tasks, new, more difficult ones will open up for you.

🔹I want more rewards and tasks!🔹

Easy! To have access to more tasks and get more rewards for progress points, you can purchase an extended pass. In addition to these benefits, the pass will also allow you to gain combat experience (progress points) faster. An extended pass is purchased once for the entire season and is valid for your entire account. You can become the owner of an extended pass and collect the rewards due to you at any time during the season.

🔹Can I get the rewards right now?🔹

If the romance of completing tasks every day gets boring for you, then of course! To speed up the passage of the season and instantly gain access to rewards, you can purchase levels (a fixed number of progress points).

🔹How long is the season?🔹

The season lasts 28 days and contains 100 levels of progress.
Get the maximum gifts!

We wish you good luck in the new season!

notes.title: Fear the drumbeat
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/b70fa01e9f247a8b9b537ad1f8e6ae82c1792c4b.png[/img]

The lion was not the only animal in Harold Fleck's circus. The audience was also amazed by a small monkey. She joined the troupe on her own during their travels in the south of the Sphere. The troupe noticed that the monkey was quite smart, so the clowns began to train her and named her Lemi.

Lemi learned simple tricks with disappearing objects. Often, personal belongings of the audience would disappear, but at the end of the show, the monkey would return the stolen items. But Lemi's greatest passion was the drum. Harold Fleck saw that the little animal liked the instrument, so he allowed her to open and close the shows by hitting the drum.

Even after the circus's demise, the monkey did not give up these activities. Today, if someone hears the drumbeat, they better run away from there without looking back, because this means that the show of the damned troupe is beginning.

notes.title: Hear the roar of Hatar!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/6c3f882a695511415e5202c2b47077dd44463128.png[/img]

The star of Harold Fleck's circus was the huge white lion Hatar. The troupe found him as a cub in the desert and saved him from the shushpans. They wanted to let the lion go, but Spald was afraid that the lion cub would not survive alone. So the troupe decided to take him with them.

Hatar grew up quickly and learned the circus craft. He jumped through fire rings, juggled balls and even walked a tightrope. At the same time, Hatar was the main protector of the circus and often rescued the artists during their travels, saving them from monsters.

Unfortunately, he was unable to save them from a gang of thugs. Among the attackers was a wizard who captured the lion and allowed his comrades to deal with him.

The lion returned from the other world along with the entire troupe and became even stronger and more dangerous. Today, even the most powerful demon cannot resist the power of the rebellious white lion.

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/cf098b180d3f9b3da6b2d057366911602d2db53a.png[/img]

One of Harold Fleck's main clowns was Ruby. He knew many tricks that delighted the audience. Some even suspected that Ruby was a magician, but the clown himself claimed that he only created the illusion of magic.

At the end of each performance, Ruby took off his hat and went out to the audience to ask them to throw a couple of coins. The audience was always grateful and filled the hat to the brim with gold.

After his death, Ruby also joined the cursed troupe. Now, at the end of each cruel performance, he goes out to the few remaining spectators and collects a bloody harvest. If you are lucky enough to survive, then it is better to pay. Otherwise, there is no escape from the cursed circus.

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/84fae6a82e283c505a8c46ec195ca3d8ed649d2e.png[/img]

Harold Fleck could see right through people, so he could invite anyone with pure intentions to join his troupe. That's why one of the troupe's members was a murderer nicknamed Spaldi.

More precisely, he was recognized as a murderer in the village he fled from. Spaldi himself claimed that he was trying to help a dying girl, but people misunderstood everything. Fleck immediately realized that the guy was not lying, so he hid him and taught him the circus craft.

Spaldi showed tricks with swords and knives. But during an attack by a gang on the troupe, his skill failed him, and the trickster died. After his death, he did not forget his skills and still shows dangerous tricks with knives. Only now the audience does not live to see the end of the show.

notes.title: Coming soon — Fleck's Mask
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/a43845027b06cd64121924dcddf25c00ca247774.png[/img]

A few centuries ago, a man named Harold Fleck organized his own circus, which traveled across Erikuria and beyond. The leader of the troupe believed that art should be accessible to everyone, so he performed even in demon lands. The horned ones almost killed the artists the first time, but quickly realized that the circus came to entertain, so they attended the performances with pleasure.

Friendship with demons did not please a gang of retired soldiers who operated in Erikuria. So they attacked the troupe, killed the artists and animals, and locked Harold Fleck in a cage and set it on fire. According to rumors, the clown did not scream, but only laughed and cursed his killers.

Time passed, and the gang came across a renewed circus. They decided to go inside to destroy it again. Since then, no one has seen them again. They say that the circus travels around the Sphere and invites those who, in the opinion of the artists, deserve punishment.

notes.title: Crystal fever
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/85a27ad34c50def64a3e94f93c68a67ef9e2d744.png[/img]

Dive into the Crystal Rush and get one of five epic bracelets with special properties:
🔹Bracelet of Destruction - increases the chance of a critical attack by 2%, critical damage by 5%. Only one bracelet of destruction can have this effect at a time
🔹Bracelet of Avoidance - reduces the chance of receiving a critical hit by 6%. Only one bracelet of Avoidance can have this effect at a time.
🔹Bracelet of Resistance - increases magic defense by 12%. Only one bracelet of resistance can have this effect at a time.
🔹Bracelet of Strengthening - increases physical defense by 12%. Only one bracelet of Strengthening can have this effect at a time.
🔹Bracelet of Enhancement - increases the power of abilities by 4%. Only one bracelet of Enhancement can have this effect at a time.

The Crystal Rush is coming to the world of the Sphere! Travelers from all over the continent are talking about the same thing: the Sphere is filled with mysterious magic crystals that contain various secrets and powers. The loyal soldiers of Vagrot and King Sigurd are already preparing to get as many valuable crystals as possible, but this time everyone will not only face war, but also a real competition.

⚡️Rewards⚡️

During Crystal Mania, the factions of people and demons will begin the pursuit of the power of crystals. By killing monsters of your level, you have a chance to get a tarnished shard, from a group of which you can create more powerful crystals. Each time you combine crystals, you will receive pleasant bonuses.

By creating new crystals, you can get:
- items for improvement,
- teleportation stones,
- pet food,
- useful potions,
- illusion cubes,
- resurrection scrolls.

⚡️Guaranteed Prize⚡️

In addition, when combining unfinished crystals, you have a small chance to get a crystal cache containing one of five epic bracelets, and every 25th attempt to combine unfinished crystals, you are guaranteed to get a crystal cache!

⚡️Useful Buffs⚡️

At the end of each day, the faction that has collected more crystals will receive a nice bonus to experience, gold and item drops, which will last until the next count.

And one more thing. For combining unfinished crystals, you will receive a buff that increases the power of abilities by 0.4% and maximum health by 0.7%. The effect stacks up to 40 times, that is, you can increase the power of abilities by 16% and maximum health by 28%. The buff is not lost after the death of the character and will remain with you until the end of the event and 1 week after it.

⚡️Important details⚡️

To get crystals from monsters, your level must not differ from the monster's level by more than 5 levels.

While the premium account is active, the chance of getting tarnished shards is doubled.

Additional shards can be purchased in the in-game store.

You will need cunning, attentiveness and remarkable persistence to get as many prizes as possible and defeat your opponents. Well, enough chatter, the Crystal Rush is starting!

notes.title: Season "Legends of the City-Above-the-Abyss"
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/0293329b582c8d5c6627a05fccca76b62c6f66fd.png[/img]

More than a hundred gifts for every Sphere player! The bravest, wisest and noblest warriors of the Sphere are invited to participate in the new season!

🔹What is this season?🔹

In essence, this is a set of tasks for participation in which progress points are given. As you accumulate progress points, you will receive sets of useful, and sometimes even unique rewards!

🔹Tell us more about the prizes!🔹
⚫️Title "Foreigner" - Increases the amplification of abilities by 1.5%, attack speed and abilities by 2.5%.
⚫️Infusion of Windfury - increases attack speed, spells and movement by 5% for 24 hours
⚫️Loot Collector He Nu - moves 60% faster than usual, exists for 30 days.
⚫️Groom's Token - used to upgrade a riding pet for grooms.
Pet Nyugun. Its properties are below.
◻️ stealthy
◻️ economy
◻️ Level 10 - Exceptional Strength (Increases owner's strength by 1.6%) OR Exceptional Intellect (Increases owner's intelligence by 1.6%)
◻️ Level 20 - Stone Strength (Reduces damage taken by 3.2%, chance to get a critical hit by 3.7%) OR Stone Power (Increases ability power and critical damage by 7%)
◻️ Level 30 - Exceptional Stamina (Increases owner's stamina by 1.6%) OR Exceptional Spirit (Increases owner's spirit by 1.6%)
◻️ Level 40 - Deep Waters (Increases movement speed by 7.5%, reduces damage taken by 2.5%) OR Healing Currents (Increases movement speed by 7.5%, increases health regeneration by 40%.)
◻️ Level 50 — Exceptional Agility (Increases the owner's Agility by 1.6%) OR Exceptional Wisdom (Increases the owner's Wisdom by 1.6%)
◻️ Level 60 — Path of the Wind (Increases movement speed by 8% every 3 seconds. Stacks up to 5 times, up to 40%. Upon receiving minor damage, the accumulated effect is reset.) OR Hurricane Fury (Increases attack and ability speed by 8% every 4 seconds. Stacks up to 4 times, up to 32%. Upon receiving minor damage, the accumulated effect is reset.)

In addition to all this, you can get feed, preservation crystals, the Refiner's Hammer, essences, ghost coins, spices and much, much more. The full set of rewards is available for those who purchase the expanded pass.

You can purchase the Hagen Headgear and Fusan Branch Back Ornament from Battle Pass vendors using Ghost Coins.

🔹I'm in! How do I join?🔹

When you first log in after the Battle Season starts, each of your characters will see an invitation window.

Click the "Start Season" button to join. After that, you can open the season window by clicking on the icon next to the minimap.

🔹What do you need to do?🔹

Open the season window. There you will see a list of tasks. Tasks are divided into those that you can complete once per season and daily ones. One-time tasks are chains (complete the current task to start the next one). However, each group of tasks is available at the same time - as you complete simple tasks, new, more difficult ones will open up for you.

🔹I want more rewards and tasks!🔹

Easy! To have access to more missions and get more rewards for progress points, you can purchase an extended pass. In addition to these benefits, the pass will also allow you to gain combat experience (progress points) faster. An extended pass is purchased once for the entire season and is valid for your entire account. You can become the owner of an extended pass and collect the rewards due to you at any time during the season.

🔹Can I get the rewards right now?🔹

If the romance of completing tasks every day gets boring for you, then of course! To speed up the passage of the season and instantly gain access to rewards, you can purchase levels (a fixed number of progress points).

🔹How long is the season?🔹

The season lasts 28 days and contains 100 levels of progress.
Get maximum gifts!

We wish you good luck in the new season!

notes.title: The Legend of He Nu
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/194ced1e1300ad15b668f744dc353e58c33d8872.png[/img]

Another time, Sursh told the regulars of the Hellsong Tavern about He Nu. He allegedly saw it in the world where the mythical City-Above-the-Abyss exists.

Sursh said that he took out a drum to return home, but then this beast came out of the bushes. It looked like a bear, only the color of its fur was different. In addition, the bear there wore unusual clothes, was smart and introduced himself as He Nu.

The black and white bear was an ordinary farmer who lived in the forest and grew bamboo. He took the sticks to the monks of the Nyugong Order, and he dried the leaves and made tea from them. He Nu turned out to be very hospitable, so he invited Sursh to his place and treated him to a herbal drink.

The regulars of the Hellsong Tavern again did not believe Sursh, because they knew that bamboo leaves cannot be brewed. He was offended, said that he was going to the City-Above-the-Abyss, and left. No one saw him again. Perhaps he really did go to that mysterious place. Or, as many believe, he found another tavern where he tells his nonsense about the City-Above-the-Abyss.

notes.title: The Story of Nyugun
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/1604805e2ba3a2bb066046919c294697bcfa276b.png[/img]

At one point, Garlinor stopped appearing in the Hellsong Tavern. Instead, Sursh the Invulnerable began telling tales about the City-Above-the-Abyss. He claimed that Garlinor was a deceiver, but he really had visited another world. And he got there with the help of a drum.
The artifact took him not to the City-Above-the-Abyss itself, but to the forests that surround it. There he was found by monks of the Nyugun order, similar to large cats. Only they walked on two legs and were dressed in strange long robes.

But the Nyugun were not just hermits. In fact, they were skilled warriors who used staffs and fought like monks from the Sphere. But their skill reached such heights that the gods themselves bowed before them. At the same time, the Nyugun fought with simple sticks made of bamboo.

Sursha was laughed at after this story, because everyone knows that cats cannot be monks. But he did not calm down and said that he even wanted to bring a stick from the Nyugong Order to the tavern. However, the monks did not allow it and threw him out of the monastery, so he returned to the Sphere.

The last tale about the City Above the Abyss that Garlinor told was the story of the Fusan Tree. The demon claimed that in the city, right in the main square, there grew a huge tree. Allegedly, it would take fifty demons to embrace it.

notes.title: Hagen Mask

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/7d5fd945659ee8fc7624ced52b1aa85bbed9987a.png[/img]

Once Garlinor told how he got to the City-Above-the-Abyss for an unusual festival. The whole city was glowing with lights, and demons were walking along the streets in unusual masks.

Garlinor did not know what this meant, so he began to question the locals. Of course, they were very surprised that the demon did not know the customs, but they still revealed the truth to him.

It turned out that in the world of the City-Above-the-Abyss, in the past, lived the damned demon Sigurn. He did not just destroy his own kind, but also enslaved their spirits. No one could tolerate this, so the demons gathered a huge army and destroyed Sigurn. His spirits scattered around the world and frightened the demons, so in order to hide, they began to wear masks of Hagen.

Garlinor brought one such mask to the Hellsong Tavern, but the locals quickly saw through the rogue: the mask was made in the Sphere. However, it was very beautiful and Boddugan Alcohol Barrel hung it in the hall as a decoration.

notes.title: The Story of Gun-mu
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/f44ec769d463945e90115b8c184093c0b897a682.png[/img]

You can hear all sorts of things from the regulars at the Hellsong Tavern after a few mugs of strong ale.

The demon Garlinor told everyone about another world where the City-Above-the-Abyss is located - a beautiful place where demons live. As proof, he showed everyone some strange thing, and then told legends that he heard there.

One of the legends was connected with an unusual dragon that looked like a snake. The locals called him Gun-mu. Garlinor wanted to learn more about him, so he also sat in the local tavern and asked the regulars about the dragon. It turned out that Gun-mu was once an ordinary demon mercenary. He went on the most dangerous crossings and protected caravans from bandits and monsters. At the same time, he took for his work only as much as was needed for food and lodging.

After Gun-mu died in battle while guarding a caravan, the gods of that world accepted him into their pantheon. Having gained the power of the gods, Gun-mu turned into a huge dragon, which is worshiped by travelers.

Garlinor told this story many times, but no one believed him. Because dragons that look like snakes do not exist. At least, no one has ever met one in the Sphere.

notes.title: Dead Season
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/af891e0ec98d5ddd99cbf8bbb423d2ac48eb3548.png[/img]

More than a hundred gifts for every Sphere player! The bravest, wisest and most noble warriors of the Sphere are invited to participate in the new season!

🔹What is this season?🔹

In essence, this is a set of tasks for participation in which progress points are given. As you accumulate progress points, you will receive sets of useful, and sometimes even unique rewards!

🔹Tell us more about the prizes!🔹
⚫️Title "Harbinger" - Increases the amplification of abilities by 1.5%, attack speed and abilities by 2.5%.
⚫️Flax of Windfury - increases attack speed, spells and movement by 5% for 24 hours
⚫️Loot Collector Harbinger's Doom - moves 60% faster than usual, exists for 30 days.
⚫️Pet Harbinger's Wisdom. Its properties are below.
◻️ Magic
◻️ Speed
◻️ Level 10 - Exceptional Agility (Increases the owner's Agility by 1.6%) OR Exceptional Wisdom (Increases the owner's Wisdom by 1.6%)
◻️ Level 20 - Tireless (Increases movement, attack, and casting speed by 6%) OR Accelerated Recovery (Increases the owner's energy, magical, or necrotic energy regeneration by 24%)
◻️ Level 30 - Exceptional Agility (Increases the owner's Agility by 1.6%) OR Exceptional Wisdom (Increases the owner's Wisdom by 1.6%)
◻️ Level 40 - Shadow Prism (When dealing a critical hit, grants invisibility for 3 sec. Movement speed in this state increases by 25%. Triggers no more than once every 60 sec) OR Prismatic shield (After receiving damage, with a 7% chance, removes 1 negative effect from the owner. Does not work more often than once every 30 sec.)
◻️ Level 50 - Exceptional Agility (Increases the owner's Agility by 1.6%) OR Exceptional Wisdom (Increases the owner's Wisdom by 1.6%)
◻️ Level 60 - Curse of Fragility (When attacking with an 8% chance (16% for a critical hit), reduces the enemy's defense by 6% and increases the chance of dealing a critical hit by 4%. Stacks up to 7 times. The effect lasts for 13 sec.) OR Devour (Restores health in the amount of 5% of the damage dealt by the owner.)

In addition to all this, you can get feed, preservation crystals, the hammer of the master of refining, essences, ghost coins, spices and much, much more. The full set of rewards is available for those who purchase an expanded pass.

You can purchase the Harbinger's Mask headgear and Harbinger's Punishment back attachment from Battle Pass vendors using Ghost Coins.

🔹I'm in! How do I join?🔹

When you first log in after the Battle Season starts, each of your characters will see an invitation window.

Click the "Start Season" button to join. After that, you can open the season window by clicking on the icon next to the minimap.

🔹What do you need to do?🔹

Open the season window. In it, you will see a list of tasks. Tasks are divided into those that you can complete once per season and daily ones. One-time tasks are chains (complete the current task to start the next one). However, each group of tasks is available at the same time - as you complete simple tasks, new, more difficult ones will open up for you.

🔹I want more rewards and tasks!🔹

Easy! To have access to more missions and get more rewards for progress points, you can purchase an extended pass. In addition to these benefits, the pass will also allow you to gain combat experience (progress points) faster. An extended pass is purchased once for the entire season and is valid for your entire account. You can become the owner of an extended pass and collect the rewards due to you at any time during the season.

🔹Can I get the rewards right now?🔹

If the romance of completing tasks every day gets boring for you, then of course! To speed up the passage of the season and instantly gain access to rewards, you can purchase levels (a fixed number of progress points).

🔹How long is the season?🔹

The season lasts 28 days and contains 100 levels of progress.
Get maximum gifts!

We wish you good luck in the new season!

notes.title: Coming soon!
notes.notes:
The new season will bring new gifts to the Sphere, and it's time to learn more about them!

MASK OF THE HARBOR

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/0179cba7c9ecf11db7f425eb659545d4988e3476.png[/img]

No one knows how many Nameless are in the Abyss outside the Sphere. But many shamans are sure that they all want to break into this world and enslave it. In fact, only some Nameless are trying to influence this world, while others want to build their own kingdom, like Vran.
Vran did not participate in the creation of the Sphere, but only observed and learned. Having gained knowledge, he created his own Sphere, in which cold and darkness reign, and it is inhabited by ice giants who feed on living creatures.

Vran spent all his power on their creation, and he decided to look for food for his children in other worlds. For this, he created the Mask of the Harbinger - an unusual artifact that turned the owner into the Harbinger of Vran's will. The Nameless One managed to send it to the Sphere. A person, elf, dwarf or demon who put on this mask became an executor of Vran's will. If he destroyed a creature, it was transferred to a harsh kingdom of cold and darkness.

The demons were not going to helplessly watch someone take away their brothers, and challenged Vran's servant. They gathered the most powerful shamans and removed the cursed mask from the Harbinger. After that, they hid this cursed artifact. But even this did not save the Sphere from Vran's treachery.

THE HARBOR'S PUNISHMENT

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/51a24670783c8aa0d31e98e1d2d2a4d15c5b3b28.png[/img]

After the demons defeated the first Harbinger, Vran realized that he needed to act more decisively. He spent a lot of effort to contact the remains of his first servant. But he still managed to turn his bones into a powerful weapon - the Harbinger's Punishment.

The weapon was discovered by one of the elves and, as soon as he took it in his hands, Vran enslaved his mind. He sent the new Harbinger to the demon lands to return the Mask. The servant was successful. With the mask and the punishment, the new harbinger became almost invulnerable.

But the people managed to stop him. Trogvar Thistle, a distant ancestor of Agvar, gathered the most powerful mages and together they destroyed the Harbinger, and hid the Raven artifacts. And no one alive now knows where to look for them.

THE WISDOM OF THE HARBOR

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/559410587323079ec795de8c1840f90459a5becb.png[/img]

Despite the fact that there were only two Raven artifacts in the Sphere, the Nameless One created something else: an assistant in the form of a raven for his Harbinger.

The bird stored the knowledge of the Raven within itself, and could also speak with the voice of the Nameless One. She accompanied the Harbinger in the Sphere, helped him avoid the traps that demons and humans set, and also supplied magical energy to the world of Vran.

Fortunately, Trogvar Thistle wove a powerful spell that captured the raven. This saved the Sphere and helped get rid of the Harbinger. But after the defeat of Vran's servant, the raven was freed from captivity, and no one has seen it since. Surely the bird is hiding somewhere and waiting for the appearance of a new Harbinger.

THE DEATH OF THE HARBOR

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/a20d63688a8f77ec02da3766bc34c1593e8e447f.png[/img]

Nobody remembers Trogvar Thistle today, but this man did the most important thing for the entire Sphere - he stopped the Harbinger in time. If he had not done this, then all living things would have been transferred to the cold world of Vran.

Not long before his death, the second Harbinger, using the wise raven, found a way to transfer an entire city at once to the kingdom of cold and darkness. To do this, he subjugated a rat to his will, infected it with a dangerous plague, and sent it to the city of Ar'Kaliat.

The elves who lived there quickly began to die and after death were transferred to the kingdom of Vran. Trogvar learned of this incident and realized that the Harbinger needed to be stopped immediately. Fortunately for the entire Sphere, he and other mages succeeded. But Agvar Thistle's ancestor was afraid that the plague would spread, so he sealed the passage to the lands where the beautiful city of Ar'Kaliath stood for many centuries. Only hundreds of years later was the passage reopened and people saw what this place had become.

HARBOR'S COMPANION

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/0946caebaa38b8648ec9e52e74dc7c7e87ed85bd.png[/img]

The animal that accompanied both Harbingers was the cursed hyena. It was made by the first of Vran's wards in order to move around the Sphere as quickly as possible.

The Harbinger's companion was a very dangerous animal. Created by the magic of the Nameless One, the hyena did not know fatigue, quickly covered huge distances and could survive not only the cold, but also the heat emanating from the Sulfur Heart volcano.

As soon as the demon shamans defeated the first Harbinger and removed his mask, the hyena disappeared. Some tried to revive it, because it was an inexhaustible source of knowledge, but to no avail.

After the death of the second Harbinger, humans also intended to study the unusual hyena. The then human king ordered to put the Mask on one of his servants so that the hyena would appear, but Trogvar stopped him. He believed that the secret of the Harbinger's Companion was not worth the troubles it would bring to the Sphere. The king was furious that some mage would contradict his order, so he banished Trogvar.

The wizard left, but took the Mask and Scourge of the Harbinger with him. Today, no one, not even Agvar Thistle himself, knows where the Harbinger's artifacts rest.

The new battle season starts on March 19. Don't forget to claim the gifts of the "Secrets of the Dungeon" season before this date and free up bags for the next rewards!
