notes.title: Season "Secrets of the Dungeons"
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/a06a2f845bd23fea01873c1a36cea38ee62b44b8.png[/img]

More than a hundred gifts for every Sphere player! The bravest, wisest and noblest warriors of the Sphere are invited to participate in the new season!

🔹What is this season?🔹

In essence, this is a set of tasks for participation in which progress points are given. As you accumulate progress points, you will receive sets of useful, and sometimes even unique rewards!

🔹Tell us more about the prizes!🔹
⚫️Title "Excavator" - Endurance and received crafting resources are increased by 3%, attack speed and abilities by 1%.
⚫️Windfury Infusion - increases attack speed, spells and movement by 5% for 24 hours
⚫️Loot Collector Kobold Carrier - moves 60% faster than usual, exists for 30 days.
⚫️Kobold Defender Pet. Its properties are below.
◻️ Crusher
◻️ Luck
◻️ Level 10 - Exceptional Strength (Increases owner's Strength by 1.6%) OR Exceptional Intellect (Increases owner's Intelligence by 1.6%)
◻️ Level 20 - Warrior's Flame (Increases owner's Movement and Attack Speed ​​by 5%) OR Wizard's Flame (Increases owner's Movement and Ability Speed ​​by 5%)
◻️ Level 30 - Exceptional Strength (Increases owner's Strength by 1.6%) OR Exceptional Intellect (Increases owner's Intelligence by 1.6%)
◻️ Level 40 - Growing Wrath (When attacking, with a 6% chance, increases owner's Attack and Ability Speed ​​by 6% for 13s. Stacks up to 5 times.) OR Growing Fortress (When receiving damage, with a 6% chance, increases owner's Defense by 6% for 14s. Stacks up to 5 times.)
◻️ Level 50 - Exceptional Stamina (Increases the wearer's stamina by 1.6%) OR Exceptional Spirit (Increases the wearer's spirit by 1.6%)
◻️ Level 60 - Fire Shield (Puts a shield on the wearer equal to 25% of their maximum health. The shield absorbs 75% of any damage and returns 25% of the damage to the attacker. The shield lasts for 50s and refreshes after 50s.) OR Hurricane Strike (If the wearer deals critical damage, their running and casting speed is increased by 10% for 10s. Cannot occur more than once every 20s.)

In addition to all this, you can get feed, preservation crystals, the Refiner's Hammer, essences, ghost coins, spices and much, much more. The full set of rewards is available for those who purchase the expanded pass.

You can purchase the Excavator's Helmet headgear and the Excavator's Backpack from Battle Pass vendors using Ghost Coins.

🔹I'm in! How do I join?🔹

When you first log in after the Battle Season starts, each of your characters will see an invitation window.

Click the "Start Season" button to join. After that, you can open the season window by clicking on the icon next to the minimap.

🔹What do you need to do?🔹

Open the season window. In it, you will see a list of tasks. Tasks are divided into those that you can complete once per season and daily ones. One-time tasks are chains (complete the current task to start the next one). However, each group of tasks is available at the same time - as you complete simple tasks, new, more difficult ones will open up for you.

🔹I want more rewards and tasks!🔹

Easy! To have access to more missions and get more rewards for progress points, you can purchase an extended pass. In addition to these benefits, the pass will also allow you to gain combat experience (progress points) faster. An extended pass is purchased once for the entire season and is valid for your entire account. You can become the owner of an extended pass and collect the rewards due to you at any time during the season.

🔹Can I get the rewards right now?🔹

If the romance of completing tasks every day gets boring for you, then of course! To speed up the passage of the season and instantly gain access to rewards, you can purchase levels (a fixed number of progress points).

🔹How long is the season?🔹

The season lasts 28 days and contains 100 levels of progress.
Get maximum gifts!

We wish you good luck in the new season!

notes.title: Deep Digger
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/08e367664f5313e778c9d3ad1cf0effd00e0bfef.png[/img]

The underground passages are inhabited not only by kobolds, but also by other creatures, such as deep diggers.

These are large insects that have powerful front legs that allow them to rip up the ground in front of them. Initially, kobolds used the passages that these creatures used, and over time, they managed to tame the underground creatures and use them.

During the war with the gnomes, many diggers were destroyed in battle, so today the kobolds have only a couple dozen individuals left.

Deep diggers could have forever remained an underground rarity until their clutch was discovered by demons. With the help of their magic, they increased the size of these insects in order to use them as riding animals, and also increased their reproductive properties. Thanks to this, the species was not only saved from extinction, but also populated the surface with them.

notes.title: Digger's helmet
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/b239b1eb174aff927d2482661e68683d070b3ada.png[/img]

It is very important to protect your head underground, so the kobolds made special helmets. They also put candles on them to see better in the underground darkness, as well as to track the movement of air.

After the war with the dwarves began, helmets began to be remade into military helmets to protect their heads not only from protruding stones, but also from blows from dwarven swords. When the war ended, the need for helmets disappeared. However, the kobolds did not abandon them, since they turned out to be better than the old helmets. They only added a special place for candles, as it was in peacetime.

notes.title: Digger's set
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/9b78615c3b3b66fcfcb517e9b7b96f5ce416c58f.png[/img]

The most important thing that every kobold digger needs is his set. It contains the most important things - a pick and a shovel, which help to create new adits and tunnels. In emergency situations, these items can turn into weapons and protect against gnome attacks.

But the most valuable thing for kobolds was a small teapot. Underground dwellers dug passages to the surface and collected tree roots. Kobolds brew them to get a tonic drink, which is so necessary for those who work underground.

notes.title: Kobold Defender
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/1c1bc47dc62e377f11f2d9653bee33769301b6ba.png[/img]

For a long time, the kobolds believed that they were the only ones underground. But several centuries ago, they were unlucky enough to run into the gnomes. The shorties outnumbered the kobolds and had advanced mechanisms. So they decided to conquer the peaceful miners.

The gnomes destroyed several kobold colonies and took their underground cities for themselves. The peaceful creatures had no choice but to hide.

They could not hide in the underground adits for long, because the gnomes could find them at any moment. So they decided to act. They created squads of kobold defenders who fought back the invaders.

Many gnomes and kobolds died in that underground war. And even though there is an uneasy peace between these peoples now, the kobolds did not disband the kobold defender squads in case the shorties again decide to show that they are the true rulers of the underworld.

notes.title: Coming soon — Kobold Porter
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/b26e61abe8e0b516803bb37c677cc4d87fb277fe.png[/img]

Not only gnomes live underground, but also other creatures. The most intelligent of them are Kobolds.

This peaceful race is technologically far behind the gnomes. They do not have advanced technologies and mechanisms, but they are excellent diggers. Kobolds are capable of building an entire city underground in a month, with dozens of streets and hundreds of buildings.

As soon as a Kobold reaches the age of 1 year, he enters service as a porter. Every day, he collects the rock that his older brothers mine in numerous adits. Then this rock is sorted, some is sent to build new houses, and some is used to make shovels, picks and other items.

Kobold Porters are very dedicated to their work and always take a responsible approach to their work. After all, if one of the kobolds shirks work, the entire production chain will be disrupted and the colony may suffer.

notes.title: Valentine's Day!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/e5e395198b88e8e0a6929e287b24003d05d69642.png[/img]

A holiday dedicated to Valentine's Day is beginning in the world of the Sphere! While the event lasts, you can complete quests from the Master of Ceremonies and the Keeper of Ceremonies, collect fragments of the golden heart and get a special festive stallion, a temporary boost that can be improved up to twenty times, as well as many other pleasant gifts, including a ❤guaranteed prize - the Treasure of Lovers❤. But first things first.

The quests are available to all characters of level 10 and above, and you can get them in Sinderkreg or the Hellsong Tavern. Additional fragments can be obtained by killing monsters close to your level. A premium account doubles the chance of getting a fragment. And if you need even more fragments, you can always purchase them in the in-game store.
💫34 fragments of a golden heart combine into a golden heart.
💫8 golden hearts combine into an animated golden heart.
💫2 animated hearts give a reward when combined and have a small chance to bring you a lovers' treasure.

The more often you combine animated hearts, the higher the chance to get a lovers' treasure. In the event window, you can see the current number of attempts until you are guaranteed to receive the treasure. Initially, there are 25.

From the lovers' treasure, you can get one of three rare knee pads:
💙Elegant knee pads - reduces the chance of getting a critical hit by 5%.
💙Brilliant knee pads - when receiving damage with a 5% chance, increase defense by 5% for 10 seconds. Stacks up to 3 times.
💙Exquisite knee pads - when receiving damage with a 5% chance, increase health regeneration by 9% for 12 seconds. Stacks up to 3 times.
Or one of three epic knee pads:
💜Elegant knee pads - reduces the chance of getting a critical hit by 8%.
💜Shiny Kneepads - When receiving damage, there is a 6% chance to increase defense by 7% for 12 seconds. Stacks up to 3 times.
💜Exquisite Kneepads - When receiving damage, there is a 6% chance to increase health regeneration by 13% for 14 seconds. Stacks up to 3 times.
❤️Or a special item - Heart of Eternal Friendship, which calls all party members to the one who used the item. Cooldown 60 minutes.

Congratulations and good luck in love and in the game!

notes.title: 29.01.2025 game update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/7ebc4764d7c89fc4f666047b4fb619eee9654cbf.png[/img]

The following changes were made to the game during maintenance today:

🔹The "Great Concern" event has started.

🔹The construction of siege weapons has been reworked:
▪ The defense decree that slows down the construction of siege weapons no longer applies to allies (clans that are part of the same alliance) of the castle defenders.
▪ Defenders can now build siege weapons both inside and outside the castle, including near its walls, even if the gates are not broken.
▪ Allies of defenders are now allowed to build siege weapons inside and under the castle walls, just like the defenders themselves.
▪ Allies of defenders and defenders are prohibited from building rams, automatic catapults, and airships.
▪ Added a ban on applying positive effects (buffs) to siege weapons.

🔹Fixed the inability to talk to the castle castellan when not in an alliance.
🔹Castle defenders now receive a standard "Sphere of Protection" for 20 seconds when reviving inside the castle.

🔹The war between alliances has been reworked. The following rules now apply:
▪ During a war between alliances, it is prohibited to leave or kick out clan members, as well as disband the clan.
▪ To declare war on another alliance, all clans in your alliance must have positive influence.
▪ You can declare war on another alliance even if the clans in it have negative influence.
▪ After the war, the winning alliance will receive the prize influence only from those losing clans that had non-negative influence at the end of the war.
▪ The losing clans will lose 4500 influence points in any case, even if they already had negative influence at the end of the war.
▪ The losing alliance gets a 5-day grace period until the next war.

🔹Fixed the unnecessary write-off of the royal tax for entering the dungeon when there are no more attempts to enter.
🔹Increased the running speed of the Mummy, Tamed Shieldback and Beast.

🔹Eliminated the write-off of the energy resource (or mana) from the character in case of unsuccessful use of the following abilities:
▪ "Comet", "Hail of Blows" of the monk;
▪ "Teleport" of the sorcerer;
▪ "Furious Leap", "Berserker Leap" of the barbarian;
▪ "Step into the Shadow" of the assassin.
🔹The mechanism for writing off the energy resource (or mana) when using the following continuous abilities has been reworked: "Rain of Arrows", "Burst", "Discharge", "Fire Rain", "Power Giving".
Now the resource is spent gradually in portions, and not entirely, as it was before. However, to start using the abilities, you still need to have the amount of resource specified in them.
🔹Changes in ability costs:
▪ Pathfinder:
- Arrow Rain – cost increased from 45 to 65.
- Burst – cost increased from 60 to 65. Simplify 2 now reduces cost by 5, instead of 10.
▪ Sorcerer
- Discharge – ability cost increased from 9 to 12.
- Fire Rain – ability cost increased from 40 to 45.
▪ Priest
- Empower – ability cost increased from 15 to 17
▪ Necromancer
- Blood Stream – ability cost increased from 12 to 15.
🔹Ability upgrade points have been reset for the following classes: Necromancer, Priest, Pathfinder, Sorcerer.

Have a nice game!

notes.title: The Great Concern
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/edb2a16bcfda8340f8cec6a6992ed1996b4544f7.png[/img]

The fight against the sinister Concern begins!

While the event lasts, any monsters of your level, as well as 3 levels higher or lower, can drop a mechanism. By combining mechanisms into runic drives, and then into steel hearts, you can get many useful items: various stones, potions, food, and so on.

🔥When combining 3 steel hearts, you can get a Concern Stash with a low chance, and every 25th attempt to combine will bring you a Stash guaranteed. You can see the number of attempts remaining until you are guaranteed to receive a Concern Stash in the event window.

When you open a Concern Stash, you can get one of the following items.

Rare helmets:
🔸Helmet of Strengthening - when receiving damage, with a 6% chance, increases defense by 12% for 10 seconds. Cooldown 40 seconds.
🔸Helm of Restoration - When receiving damage, there is a 6% chance to restore 7% of your maximum health. Cooldown 50 seconds.
🔸Helm of Destruction - When receiving damage, there is a 6% chance to increase critical damage by 12% for 12 seconds. Cooldown 40 seconds.

Epic Helmets:
🔸Helm of Fortification - When receiving damage, there is a 10% chance to increase defense by 24% for 12 seconds. Cooldown 35 seconds.
🔸Helm of Restoration - When receiving damage, there is a 10% chance to restore 14% of your maximum health. Cooldown 45 seconds.
🔸Helm of Destruction - When receiving damage, there is a 10% chance to increase critical damage by 24% for 14 seconds. Cooldown 35 seconds.

🔥For combining hearts, you will receive the Gift of Victor, a legendary inventor, which is active during the holiday and a week after it. The effect increases the experience gained by 0.6% and the resources picked up by 2%. Stacks up to 30 times.

Be careful! Representatives of the opposite faction can kill you and take half of your mechanisms in battle!

In Cinderkreg and the Hellsong Tavern, you can meet Victor Novak and go through a chain of quests to get more mechanisms and learn the history of the emergence of new ancients. While the Premium account is active, the chance of mechanisms dropping is doubled.

Additional mechanisms can be purchased in the store.

Good luck in your adventures!

Once upon a time, Viktor Novak dreamed of changing the world by creating a unique means of transportation — the autoketa. His invention, presented at an exhibition in the capital, caused a real sensation, but, alas, a disaster in the workshop stopped the production of the new product. The prototype became a legend, and Novak himself faded into the shadows, leaving behind many secrets and rumors.

But Viktor's dream of speed and freedom did not disappear. Today we are pleased to present you with that very prototype of the autoketa — the revolutionary rocket! It can increase your movement speed by 160%, turning any journey into an exciting adventure.

You can get this legend with a certain chance from the magic boxes "Rocket Summoning Chest". Don't miss the opportunity to touch history and become part of a dream that was on the verge of extinction!

The Sphere needs heroes who dare to conquer speed!

notes.title: Season of Great Discoveries
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/9b0ce63c1ce7af06f1d475c86f59e40528b88d1b.png[/img]

More than a hundred gifts for every Sphere player! The bravest, wisest and noblest warriors of the Sphere are invited to participate in the new season!

🔹What is this season?🔹

In essence, this is a set of tasks for participation in which progress points are given. As you accumulate progress points, you will receive sets of useful, and sometimes even unique rewards!

🔹Tell us more about the prizes!🔹

⚫️Title "Inventor" - Increases movement speed by 2.5% and collection of crafting resources by 5%.
⚫️Windfury Flask - increases attack speed, spells and movement by 5% for 24 hours
⚫️Mortana's Loot Collector - moves 60% faster than usual, exists for 30 days.
⚫️Mechanical Treant Pet. Its properties are below.
◻️ Crusher
◻️ Skill
◻️Level 10 — Exceptional Stamina (Increases owner's stamina by 1.6%) OR Exceptional Spirit (Increases owner's spirit by 1.6%)
◻️Level 20 — Superior Vigilance (Reduces the chance of being critically hit by 6.5%) OR Heavy Strike (If the owner deals critical damage, their opponent will be stunned for 3.5 seconds. Cannot occur more than once every 110 seconds.)
◻️Level 30 — Exceptional Stamina (Increases owner's stamina by 1.6%) OR Exceptional Spirit (Increases owner's spirit by 1.6%)
◻️Level 40 — Dead Man's Strength (If the owner deals critical damage, their physical and magical ability power increases by 16% for 10s. Triggers no more than once every 40s) OR
Growing Fortress (When receiving damage, there is a 6% chance to increase the owner's defense by 6% for 14s. Stacks up to 5 times.)
◻️Level 50 - Exceptional Stamina (Increases the owner's stamina by 1.6%) OR Exceptional Spirit (Increases the owner's spirit by 1.6%)
◻️Level 60 - Undermining (Reduces the physical and magical defense of enemies within 6 meters by 30%, and also increases their chance to receive a critical hit by 8.5% for 10 seconds if the owner receives the effect of stunning, fear, silence, immobilization, sleep or disarming. Can only occur once every 1 minute.) OR Powerful Armor (Reduces physical damage taken by the owner by 13%, magic damage by 7%.)

In addition to all this, you can get feed, preservation crystals, the Refiner's hammer, essences, ghost coins, spices and much, much more. The full set of rewards is available to those who purchase an extended pass.

You can buy the "Viktor Novak Mask" headdress and "Viktor Novak Key" shoulder ornament from the Battle Pass goods merchants for ghost coins.

🔹I'm in! How to participate?🔹

When you first log in to the game after the start of the battle season, each of your characters will see an invitation window.

Click the "Start Season" button to join. After that, you can open the season window by clicking on the icon next to the minimap.

🔹What do you need to do?🔹

Open the season window. There you will see a list of tasks. Tasks are divided into those that you can complete once per season and daily ones. One-time tasks are chains (complete the current task to start the next one). However, each group of tasks is available at the same time - as you complete simple tasks, new, more difficult ones will open up for you.

🔹I want more rewards and tasks!🔹

Easy! To have access to more tasks and get more rewards for progress points, you can purchase an extended pass. In addition to these benefits, the pass will also allow you to gain combat experience (progress points) faster. An extended pass is purchased once for the entire season and is valid for your entire account. You can become the owner of an extended pass and collect the rewards due to you at any time during the season.

🔹Can I get the rewards right now?🔹

If the romance of completing tasks every day gets boring for you, then of course! To speed up the season and instantly gain access to rewards, you can purchase levels (fixed number of progress points).

🔹How long is the season?🔹

The season lasts 28 days and contains 100 progress levels.
Get the most gifts!

We wish you good luck in the new season!

notes.title: Victor Novak's Helmet
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/c4276d8303a73f6f9ec621ccb7f4d30d3ce5dd74.png[/img]

After an explosion in the autocat production workshop, Victor was seriously injured. The best doctors fought for the life of the researcher and they managed to save it. But Novak still had health problems.

Victor had difficulty breathing, and his eyes saw the world as if in a fog. The scientist's face was also severely disfigured. In order to somehow improve his life, Victor created a special helmet. It allowed the scientist to breathe freely and also restored his vision. This allowed him to continue working, but Victor was afraid that his inventions would again lead to an explosion or something worse, so he stopped appearing in public. According to rumors, he stopped inventing so as not to harm the Sphere even more than he had already harmed.

notes.title: Autokete prototype
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/f355402ff380fdd5d12341ce5ffb1a6b8e0ebdbd.png[/img]

After a series of successful and not so successful experiments, Viktor Novak decided to create a revolutionary means of transportation - an autokete. It was supposed to become the newest type of transport that would speed up the movement of people around the Sphere.

The prototype of the autokete made a splash at the exhibition that the Novak family held in the capital. Hundreds of people wanted to buy the new product, but the autokete remained a dream. A fire and explosion occurred in the workshop where the unusual mechanism was being produced. All the created samples were destroyed, only the prototype remained.

Luckily, Viktor managed to save his workers. But he himself was seriously injured and his face was permanently disfigured. After this explosion, Viktor only appeared in public a few times. No one knows what he did next, but many are sure that he is preparing something that can change the world.

notes.title: Experiments with the Ancients
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/39c29c68ed359b86b8147fd7fa33dcd17d0502a0.png[/img]

After his success with Mortana, Victor spent a long time experimenting with crossing technology, magic, and living matter. He wanted to not only add prosthetics to the monsters, but also pacify them and take them under his control. But it was all in vain.

The only monsters that could be modified were the Ancients. First, Victor conducted an experiment adding prosthetics to the cubs of the Ancients. The experiment went well, and the little Ancients began to help with the household, first for the aristocrats, and then for ordinary people.

The king learned of these experiments and asked to create an army of adult Ancients under the control of the Ancients, in order to use them to fight the demons. Victor realized the danger that the demon race posed, so he took up the work.

At first, the experiments went well, and the scientist increased production. And when the army was almost ready, the Ancients began to show self-awareness. They went out of control and attacked the workers of the workshop where Victor was creating the Ancients. So the scientist evacuated the people and locked the workshop so that the horde of mechanical ancients would never get out.

The ancients' cubs were not self-aware, but Victor refused to continue creating them and switched to a new invention - the autoceta.

notes.title: Victor Novak's Key
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/77e4891eb3864490b07ed96b66fe43c7321c1296.png[/img]

One of the first items that Victor Novak created was an unusual key. Regular keys were only good for tightening bolts. If runes were inscribed on the mechanism or magical items were used, the keys would be destroyed.

Then Victor remade one of them, adding runes and a magic crystal. The inventor also expanded the capabilities of the tool, allowing it to grow or shrink. All this led to the key becoming not just a tool, but also a weapon.

One day, Victor was returning home and was attacked by a squad of demons. They wanted to destroy Novak and take away his technology. But Victor got the key and with its help was able to cast several simple knockback spells and destroy the demons.

Rumors about Victor's incredible device quickly spread throughout Erikuria and many wanted to get their hands on the unusual key. But the scientist was adamant and did not make a single copy of his unusual device. He believed that people would use his device to harm each other, and he could not allow science to be used against humanity.

notes.title: Mortana, bring it!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/899f5ba1006f474c72542565f3d5ede2852bc629.png[/img]

Victor Novak was a true man of the future. He grew up in a family of aristocrats and instead of burning through his parents' inheritance, he began to study technology and magic. He believed that people's lives could be made much easier by combining magic and science, and he succeeded.

Victor Novak's first breakthrough experiment was his cat Mortana. She was not just a pet of the scientist, but also a faithful companion. Although she did not make any drawings, she always knew which tool to give to her owner.

While working on a project to extract water and deliver it to houses, Victor accidentally dropped a piece of pipe on Mortana's paw. The scientist tried with all his might to save the cat's limb, but he could not: the paw had to be amputated anyway. Victor could not watch his beloved pet limp, so he began to look for a solution to the problem.

The scientist created a small mechanical prosthesis that worked with the help of hidden runes and mechanisms. The unusual device restored the cat's former flexibility and mobility, so she continued to work with her owner.

notes.title: Alliances, Influence, and Kings
notes.notes:
A new era of politics and power begins in Sphere 3!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/982f31969c97c4fe5c0dfc17f8ae8a27b50fa925.png[/img]

Forget about old alliances — now clans can unite into alliances to fight for dominance in the game! A new clan resource — influence, a unique system of decrees and votes, as well as royal equipment for alliance leaders will open up endless possibilities for you.

Gather fighters, capture castles, manage territories and intrigue to lead your alliance to the pinnacle of glory! Forward to victories!

Let's dwell on each aspect of the update in more detail.

✨INFLUENCE✨

Influence is a new clan resource that can be accumulated and spent on the needs of the entire clan or alliance.

Influence will allow you to impose buffs on allies in the area where the castle is located, start wars, create alliances and choose kings in alliances. Kings can set decrees - positive effects and taxes that apply to the entire territory of the alliance (all locations where there are alliance castles).

The clan generates 1 influence point for each level 60 clan member. For owning each castle, the clan receives 250 influence per day.

In each castle that your clan owns, you can summon a castellan. Summoning a castellan costs 500,000 gold and a significant amount of craft resources and castle tokens. With his help, you can issue various decrees for influence.

Decrees are valid for the entire location in which the castle is located for 72 hours from the moment of activation.
A maximum of 3 edicts from different categories can be active in one castle:
🔹1
400 influence - +50% gold mined by the clan in the location
400 influence - +50% experience gained by the clan in the location
400 influence - +25% to the chance of items dropping for the clan in the location
400 influence - +50% to resource collection in this territory
🔹2
800 influence - reduction of damage received in the location for the clan by 10%
800 influence - the chance of items with quality dropping by +10%
🔹3
800 influence - during the siege of this castle, the speed of construction of siege weapons by the enemy is reduced by 50%.

If the castle is captured by another clan, the castellan will disappear and will need to be summoned again. Edicts are also removed if the castle is captured by another clan.

For territories that include multiple castles (Bristly Fields of War), only one decree of each category set earlier can be active at a time.
For example, if a decree on gold was issued in Miriel Castle yesterday, and today the same clan captured Osgar Castle, it will not be able to activate a decree on experience while the decree from Miriel is active.

✨ALLIANCES✨

You have already encountered the mechanics of alliances between clans, when allies could help you during sieges. The mechanics of alliances expands this system.

To invite a clan of your faction to an alliance, open the clan window and the new “Alliances” tab. Think of a name for the alliance and enter it in the first window, and in the second - the name of the clan you want to invite.

Please note that this window is case-sensitive, and if you write the clan name with a lowercase letter, and in the game it is with a capital letter, the invitation will not be received.

Creating an alliance will cost you 800,000 gold.
Members of alliance clans are considered friendly to each other everywhere except for places with full PvP, disabling groups, PvP arenas and battlefields. One alliance can include no more than 10 clans.
An alliance cannot be left earlier than 3 days after its creation. If an alliance is dissolved, the clan will not be able to rejoin the alliance or create a new alliance for 24 hours.

The alliance of clans gains access to the alliance chat, and the “Alliances” tab changes. It has three tabs: alliance, voting and war. For players of clans in an alliance, the clan name under the character's nickname in the game changes to the name of the alliance. You can still see which clan a character nearby is in by hovering over him.

In the “Alliance” tab, you can see the clans that are part of the alliance, their leaders, the number of members and influence. Let's take a closer look at the "Voting" tab.

✨VOTING✨

Voting in an alliance is used to make important decisions such as accepting a clan into the alliance, expelling a clan from the alliance, declaring war on another alliance, and choosing a king. Yes, you are not imagining things, you can really become a king in the Sphere! But first things first.
Each clan in the alliance can start a vote no more than once a day. In total, there cannot be more than 3 votes per day within the alliance, regardless of the number of clans in the alliance. Voting is started only by the clan leader.
The clan leader can invest more points to increase the chances of his decision being accepted. At the end, the sum of clicks on the "FOR" and "AGAINST" votes will be compared. Starting a vote is considered one "FOR" vote.

A notification about the vote comes to the alliance chat, the vote itself is available to all clan leaders in the alliance in the alliance window when clicking on the vote button.
Voting ends automatically 12 hours after it starts or if all clans have voted. Regardless of whether the decision was made or rejected, influence points are spent.

If the number of FOR and AGAINST points is equal, the vote ends in a draw - points are also spent. If only one clan leader voted before the deadline - the decision is made.

🔹Invitation and expulsion from the alliance🔹

To invite a third clan to the alliance, as well as all the others, you will have to hold a vote of existing alliance members. Clans pay for votes with their influence. Starting a vote costs 500 influence, the cost of one vote is 50 influence.

After the end of the vote, if the decision was made, an invitation is sent to the target clan, which can be found on the alliances tab. If the clan is disbanded or joins another alliance during this time, the invitation expires, points are spent, and a message is sent to the sender's chat stating that the clan has already joined the alliance or no longer exists.
The invitation exists for 72 hours, after which it is automatically rejected. If the target clan accepts another invitation while it has your invitation, your invitation is rejected.

When expelling a clan from an alliance, starting a vote will cost you 200 influence, and the expelled clan will leave the alliance immediately after the vote ends.

🔹 Declaring war on another alliance 🔹

Alliances that are at war with each other can attack each other on any territory, with the exception of certain peaceful zones. War is declared unilaterally.

Starting a vote to declare war will cost you 2000 influence. The war begins from the moment the timed vote ends or if all clans have voted and the total votes indicate "FOR" the war. Voting is removed, and the current war is moved to the wars section. An alliance can be in no more than 1 war at a time, regardless of whether it was declared by it or its opponents.

All current clan wars, the number of kills from both alliances are displayed at the bottom of the alliances tab. Victories are kills of your alliance representatives, losses are kills of the enemy alliance. Kills are counted only if the difference between the characters is no more than 5 levels.

During the war, an alliance cannot disintegrate, clans cannot leave this alliance.
The alliance war lasts 7 days, the number of kills of the enemy alliance representatives is counted, including during sieges and in the open world. Based on the results of the war, clans of the winning alliance receive 4500 influence points, clans of the losing alliance lose 4500 points, up to negative values.

If at least one clan of the declaring or target alliance has a negative value at the time of the war declaration, the vote does not start.

🔹 Declare yourself the king of the alliance 🔹

And another interesting reason for voting, which will require 4000 influence points from you.
After choosing a king, new elections are impossible for 21 days. Then, until the player-king leaves the clan or alliance, he is considered its king. If for some reason the king leaves the alliance, you can start a new vote. Until a new vote begins, the king is not replaced and continues to be considered the king. As long as there is a king in the clan, this clan cannot be expelled from the alliance.

✨KING✨

Let's take a closer look at the mechanics of kings.
Having a king additionally gives the clan 50 influence daily, and also opens the opportunity to choose the location of the throne room (a special room with a throne). The throne room is needed for additional storage and the decree menu. Royal decrees can only be activated by the king.
Each alliance can only have one king at a time.

🔹Throne Room🔹

The throne room is more than just a fancy room with a throne. It can be created in the “Castles” tab when selecting a castle belonging to the king’s clan. Activating the throne room requires an alliance and a king in your clan. Creating a throne room costs resources from the king’s inventory depending on the castle.
The entrance to the throne room is inside the castle and looks like a teleport stone.

The following items and NPCs can be created inside the throne room for a certain amount of resources and gold:
🔹Treasury
🔹Royal Advisor
🔹Royal Armorer
🔹Royal Blacksmith

The Royal Armorer gives the king legendary equipment with special properties, improved by +10. Similar to the castle equipment, it can be further improved at the blacksmith in the throne room. When a castle is lost or the king changes, any actions by the character who was previously king will require him to remove the equipment. He will be able to put it on again only if he again becomes king in the alliance that owns the throne room.

The Treasury is an additional large storage area that can hold an additional 20 million gold, among other things. Unbound items can be placed in this chest later. All taxes collected by decrees are sent to the King's Chest.
If the castle is captured, the gold is confiscated, 50% of the gold is burned, 25% is returned to the magic chest of the leader of the previous clan owner (plus items), 25% of the gold is sent to the magic chest of the new leader of the clan that owns the castle.
If the castle is captured by an enemy or otherwise lost, the throne room is closed and must be reopened. If the clan leaves the alliance in any way, access to the throne room is lost. 25% of the gold and items from the treasury are returned to the leader's magic chest.

The Royal Advisor is a character who gives the king access to special decrees.

🔹King's Decrees🔹

Royal decrees provide bonuses for all alliance members in the territory where there is a castle controlled by the alliance. Decrees are valid for 72 hours. Activating a decree costs clan influence.

The following clan decrees are available to the king:
🔹Dungeon Tax - in territories controlled by the alliance, everyone except alliance members must pay a tax to enter the dungeon. This money goes to the king's treasury. Decree cost: 1000 influence.
🔹Territory Defense - in all territories where there are alliance castles, alliance members have a 10% reduced chance of receiving a critical hit. Also works during a siege. Decree cost: 1000 influence.
🔹General Celebrations - in all controlled territories, any characters of your faction have a 10% increase in experience gained, the chance of a drop, and the amount of gold and resource production received. Cost: 1000 influence.
🔹Logistics Development – ​​All alliance members receive a 15% bonus to movement speed. Cost: 600 influence.
🔹Teleportation Tax – The cost of using teleports for everyone except alliance members increases by 50%, the tax portion goes to the clan treasury. Even if the destination is outside the alliance's holdings, the money is first withdrawn taking into account the tax, then the teleport occurs. Cost: 1000 influence.

In the Bristly Fields of War, where several castles are located, when a tax is established by different alliances holding these castles, the tax amount remains fixed (as from one decree), and the revenues to the treasury are divided between all these alliances.

In the future, other improvements and additions to the mechanics of alliances and influence are possible.
I wonder who will be the first king on your server? Maybe you? We are looking forward to your impressions of the update!

notes.title: The Feast of the Snow Whirl
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/41534a63cbd2c195c7ba60d2e75b4fa7142710c4.png[/img]

🎄The most festive time of the year has arrived! Have you already started decorating the tree and buying gifts for friends and family? We invite you to go on a winter's adventure in Sphere 3.

Only at this special time of the year will you have access to completely unique opportunities: snow battles, holiday missions and, of course, pleasant gifts from the local Frosty.

First, get to know Frosty. Depending on the faction you play for, you can find him in Cinderkreg (humans) or the Hellsong Tavern (demons).
It is with him that the festive chain of quests that you will have to complete begins.

By completing daily quests and killing monsters of your level, you can get ❄snowflakes. Snowflakes can be combined into snowballs, and snowballs into snowmen. When combining snowmen, the character will receive the "Gift of the Whirlwind" buff, which increases health regeneration, experience gained, as well as the chance of obtaining and gold received from killing monsters by 1% for each stack, up to 40%. The buff exists for all 3 weeks of the event and for another week after.

Also, during the unification of snowmen, there is a chance to receive a chest "Cache of the Whirlwind", which contains special amulets, a box with eternal carnival masks and pets "Frost Star" and "Ice Ifrit". The box of masks and pets are bound to the account, so they can be transferred to your other characters. If you have not received the Cache of the Whirlwind in 24 attempts, you are guaranteed to receive it on the 25th attempt!

All amulets are suitable for the level and class of the character who received the cache, and also contain 6 slots for inlay. From the Cache of the Whirlwind, you randomly receive one of the following amulets.

Rare Amulets:
📿Whirling Amulet - When receiving a crowd control effect, reduces damage taken by 20% for 8 sec. Cannot occur more than once every 60 sec.
📿Fireworks Amulet - When dealing a critical hit, strikes the target and surrounding enemies within 8 meters with a burst of flame, causing disorientation for 2 sec. NPCs are stunned for 3 sec instead. Cannot occur more than once every 80 sec.

Epic Amulets:
📿Lucky Talisman - an amulet for good luck in the new year. Increases the chance of items dropping by 10%.
Wealth Talisman - an amulet for good luck in the new year. Increases the amount of gold received for killing monsters by 15%.
📿Whirling Amulet - When receiving a crowd control effect, reduces damage taken by 30% for 12 sec. Triggers no more than once every 40s.
📿Fireworks Amulet - when dealing a critical hit, it strikes the target and nearby enemies within 8 meters with a burst of flame, causing disorientation for 3.5s. NPCs are stunned for 5s instead. Triggers no more than once every 50s.

Legendary Amulet
💎Amulet of Happiness - increases stamina by 5%, the amount of resources and gold collected, and the chance of items dropping by 15%.
Premium account doubles the chance of getting snowflakes from monsters, and additional snowballs can be obtained in the in-game store.

Each time you combine snowflakes, your faction gets 1 victory point. Once a day, the points are reset and both factions receive a boost, the power of which depends on their place in the competition.

And how can the winter halidays pass without snow games and fun? All this is now available to you! Find snowdrifts and ice floes from which you can get snowballs or icicles that give a slowing effect. You can throw them at each other or at monsters. However, remember that these funny ammunition melt easily, and in the warm hands of your characters they will not last longer than 5 minutes.

And now let's celebrate the holidays in Sphere 3! Winter adventures await their heroes! 🎄

Happy upcoming holidays!

notes.title: Class Rebalance
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/4eb3421bd80c6db6904966ed7491b5fc464555bd.png[/img]

We always keep our finger on the pulse of events, closely monitoring your feedback and game statistics. And now it's time to bring in a fresh wind of change! We've revised the abilities of some classes so that they shine even brighter in the modern realities of the game, taking into account new equipment, pets, runes and other powerful enhancements.

Ready for new challenges? Meet the seasonal balance update!

⭐️ All skill points have been reset and you can redistribute them in accordance with the new realities.

🔷WEAPONS🔷

This time, some weapons have also been changed:
▪️ Daggers - attack and ability speed increased by 10%, damage decreased by 6%
▪️ Wands - attack and ability speed increased by 5%, damage decreased by 5.5%
▪️ Symbols - attack and ability speed increased by 5%, damage decreased by 6%.

🔷BARBARIAN🔷

🔸Fury
▪️ Whirlwind - base damage of the ability increased by 14%, weapon damage by 9%.
▪️ Furious Leap - recovery 1 now increases rage generation by 4, instead of 3.
▪️ Reprisal - base damage of the ability increased by 8%, weapon damage by 5%. Cost increased from 17 to 20. Simplification 1 and 2 reduce the cost of the ability by 4, instead of 2. Simplification 3 has been replaced with Cleave, which increases the number of targets to 3 and the cost of the ability by 5.
▪️ Axe Throw - Duration now increases the slow by 2s, instead of 1.
▪️ Skull Crusher - Base Silence duration decreased from 5s to 4s. Duration 1 and 2 now increase the silence duration by 2s, instead of 1s.

🔸Combat Mastery
▪️ Bull Strike - Base stun duration against monsters increased from 1s to 2s. The ability now generates double the amount of hatred from monsters.
▪️ Frightening Shout - Base Fear duration decreased from 8s to 5s. Rage level 5 now increases the fear duration by 2s, instead of 1s.
▪️ Berserker - ability cooldown increased from 40s to 60s. Additionally, the ability reduces the chance of receiving a critical hit by 4%. Duration 1 and 2 increase the duration by 3s, instead of 2s. Duration 3 has been replaced with a recovery that increases rage generation by 15.
▪️ Shockwave - ability cooldown increased from 30s to 35s.

🔸Containment
▪️ Shackle - base duration decreased from 5s to 4s.
▪️ Titan's Stride - Volume 3 has been replaced with a buff that increases the ability's damage by 15%.
▪️ Unbridled Fury - a new passive skill that increases the barbarian's attack speed by 6% and run speed by 4%.

🔷PALADIN🔷

🔸Retribution

▪️ Righteous Strike - Cleave 3 no longer reduces damage dealt.
▪️ Judgement - Cooldown increased from 10s to 14s. Base damage and healing of the ability increased by 15%, weapon damage and healing increased by 7%. Increased cooldown speeds up the ability by 4s, up from 2s. Hatred generation rate increased by 20%.

🔸Self-Sacrifice
▪️ Shield Bash - Hatred generation rate increased from 1 to 2.
▪️ Sacrifice - Range increased from 25m to 30m. Cooldown increased from 2 to 4s.

🔸Valor
▪️ Divine Revelation - base damage multiplier of the ability increased by 12%, weapon damage multiplier by 8%.
▪️ Divine Shield - base shield durability increased by 12%, weapon durability share increased by 5%.
▪️ Consecration - the ability no longer blinds enemies, but increases the critical strike chance of allies in the area of ​​application by 5%. Simplification 1 and 2 reduce the cost of the ability by 7 and 8, instead of 5. Simplification 3 has been replaced with a buff that increases the critical strike chance under the effect of Consecration by another 1.5%. The Consecration buff rune has been changed and now increases the critical strike chance from Consecration.

🔷WARRIOR🔷

🔸Battle Mastery
▪️ Dash - Increase 1 and 2 speed up the ability's cooldown by 4s, instead of 3s. Increase 3 has been replaced with a duration that increases the stun by 1s.
▪️ Titan Strike – added a 15s cooldown. Simplification 1 and 2 now reduce the ability cost by 10, instead of 5. Buffs 1 and 2 increase the ability damage by 20%, instead of 15%.
▪️ Guillotine – Simplification 1 now reduces the ability cost by 10, instead of 5. Simplification 2 has been replaced with an increase that speeds up the ability cooldown by 3s.

🔸 Exhaustion
Whirlwind – cooldown reduced from 25s to 20s. Base damage increased by 18%, weapon damage by 10%.

🔸Tactics
▪️ Taunt – generates 20 rage, instead of 10.
▪️ Lion's Roar – Volume 2 increases the ability radius by 3m, instead of 2m. Increase 2 speeds up the reload by 3s, instead of 2s.
▪️ Wrath – reload increased from 45s to 50s. Damage increases by 25%, instead of 20%.
▪️ Fighting Spirit – ability duration decreased from 20s to 15s. Rage generation decreased from 30 to 25.

🔷PATHFINDER🔷

🔸Accuracy
▪️ Shot – base damage increased by 10%, weapon damage by 5%.
▪️ Arrow Rain – cost increased from 45 to 50. Base damage increased by 18%, weapon damage by 8%. Enhancement 1 increases ability damage by 20%, instead of 15%. Skill shot frequency increased by 2 times. Cast range decreased from 26m to 23m.
▪️ Burst – ability duration increased by 0.5s
▪️Precise Shot – Simplification reduces the cost of the ability by 15, instead of 10.

🔸Survival
▪️ Jagged Arrow – Buff 1 and 2 increase bleed damage by 30%, instead of 20%.
▪️ Heavy Arrow – Base damage and weapon damage increased by 20%.

notes.title: Season "Snowy Fairy Tale"
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/e4e2c9089ee8c0ad33edd6bb6a1f7b8244575559.png[/img]

More than a hundred gifts for every Sphere player! The bravest, wisest and noblest warriors of the Sphere are invited to participate in the new season!

🔹What is this season?🔹

In essence, this is a set of tasks for participation in which progress points are given. As you accumulate progress points, you will receive sets of useful, and sometimes even unique rewards!

🔹Tell us more about the prizes!🔹

⚫️Title "Enchanted" - Increases the chance of item drop, the amount of gold, experience and collection of craft resources by 3%.

⚫️Windfury Infusion - increases attack speed, spells and movement by 5% for 24 hours
⚫️Loot Collector Lopa - moves 60% faster than usual, exists for 30 days.
⚫️Groom's Token - used to upgrade a riding pet for grooms.
⚫️Kili the Brown's Pet. Its properties are below.
◻️ Strong
◻️ Economy
◻️ Level 10 - Exceptional Stamina (Increases the owner's stamina by 1.6%) OR Exceptional Spirit (Increases the owner's spirit by 1.6%)
◻️ Level 20 - Greater Fortification (Reduces the owner's physical and magical damage taken by 3.5%) OR Regeneration (Increases the owner's health regeneration by 60%)
◻️ Level 30 - Exceptional Strength and Endurance (Increases the owner's strength and endurance by 0.95%) OR Exceptional Intelligence and Endurance (Increases the owner's intelligence and endurance by 0.95%)
◻️ Level 40 - Greater Wound Healing (During combat, restores the owner's health regeneration by 50% of their normal value) OR Accelerated Recovery (Increases the owner's energy, magical, or necrotic energy regeneration by 24%)
◻️ Level 50 - Exceptional Strength and Endurance (Increases the owner's strength and endurance by 0.95%) OR Exceptional Intellect and Endurance (Increases the owner's intelligence and endurance by 0.95%)
◻️ Level 60 - Potion of Vitality (If the owner's health drops to 30% of maximum or lower, they instantly restore 33% of their health. This effect can occur no more than once every 40 seconds.) OR Potion of Invulnerability (If the owner receives a control effect, they are invulnerable for 4 seconds. This effect can occur no more than once every 50 seconds.)

In addition to all this, you can get feed, preservation crystals, a hammer of the master of refining, essences, ghost coins, spices, and much, much more. The full set of rewards is available to those who purchase the extended pass.

The "Klamus Cap" headdress and "Klamus' Gift" shoulder ornament can be purchased from Battle Pass merchants for Ghost Coins.

🔹I'm in! How do I join?🔹

When you first log in after the Battle Season starts, each of your characters will see an invitation window.

Click the "Start Season" button to join. After that, you can open the season window by clicking on the icon next to the minimap.

🔹What do you need to do?🔹

Open the season window. In it, you will see a list of tasks. Tasks are divided into those that you can complete once per season and daily ones. One-time tasks are chains (complete the current task to start the next one). However, each group of tasks is available at the same time - as you complete simple tasks, new, more difficult ones will open up for you.

🔹I want more rewards and tasks!🔹

Easy! To have access to more tasks and get more rewards for progress points, you can purchase an extended pass. In addition to these benefits, the pass will also allow you to gain combat experience (progress points) faster. An extended pass is purchased once for the entire season and is valid for your entire account. You can become the owner of an extended pass and collect the rewards due to you at any time during the season.

🔹Can I get the rewards right now?🔹

If the romance of completing tasks every day gets boring for you, then of course! To speed up the passage of the season and instantly gain access to rewards, you can purchase levels (a fixed number of progress points).

🔹How long is the season?🔹

The season lasts 28 days and contains 100 levels of progress.
Get the maximum gifts!

We wish you good luck in the new season!

notes.title: The Legend of Lopa
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/690c3d804ad34d0eaab0afe780d21e84c4121b8d.png[/img]

Demons also had a hand in the legend of Sinek Klamus. They said that they sent entire expeditions to the north to find the gnome, and some succeeded. The demons claimed that they reached the snowy estate of Sinek Klamus, and saw not only a bear, but also a snowman, whom the gnome calls Lopa.

These "witnesses of Klamus" claim that the gnome saved them from the cold, invited them to his place, and Lopa poured them tea. At the same time, Sinek himself shared a story about the creation of the snowman: allegedly his snow servant simply stood at the entrance as a statue, and Kili the Brown brought him to life with the help of a potion.

Of course, no one believes them. After all, how can you believe that someone got so far north? But some children say that they heard in the house not only the clatter of Sinek Klamus' boots, but also the crunch of snow, and in the morning they found small puddles on the floor.

notes.title: The Story of Kili the Brown
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/94b0339b7c529957aed82fcd6149b1332a928696.png[/img]

Human legends about Sinek Klamus mention a boy named Kili the Brown. From early childhood, he wanted to become an alchemist, but curiosity played a cruel joke on him.

Kili really wanted to grow up quickly so that some famous alchemist would take him as an apprentice. In an ancient tome, he found a recipe for an aging potion, but mixed the ingredients incorrectly, which is why he turned into a bear.

Kili tried to call for help, but everyone heard only a bear's roar and ran away in horror. Even his parents. So the boy had to run as far away from people as possible. He tried to get to the demons so that they could use their magic to return him to his true form, but the horned ones decided to start hunting him. So Kili went north.

There he met Sinek Klamus, who was not afraid of the young alchemist. On the contrary, he found a suitable place for the boy, where he could make toys move with the help of alchemy. So if you got a moving toy as a gift, know that it was the work of the boy Kili.

notes.title: Try on the Klamus cap!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/7c88ee26fe71e8b2b77907da4e8c7689f5f57703.png[/img]

Nobody knows what Sinek Klamus looked like. The legends only contain partial descriptions of his appearance, and the few witnesses always added something of their own.

However, everyone agrees on a few things: Sinek has a lush white beard and a cap with a snowflake on the end. Some wizards claimed that this snowflake protects Klamus from the cold, so they tried to create something similar.

Of course, they failed. Their caps only repeat the appearance, but do not protect from the winter cold. Nevertheless, such caps sold very well, because many demons, people, elves and gnomes wanted to congratulate their children and tried on Sinek Klamus's outfit.

The thing is that Klamus is against fighting. Therefore, all the weapons in the bag are made of caramel or chocolate. No one in the Sphere makes such delicious sweets, so the warriors leave the battlefield to enjoy edible weapons.

notes.title: Under the jingle bells
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/eca6ad80e0b26b738d7b7762cc896340a2719050.png[/img]

According to the dwarven legend, several centuries before Morozovik appeared in the Sphere, the main symbol of the Snow Whirlwind was the dwarf Sinek Klamus. Unlike his brothers, he did not wish evil on anyone, but sought to help everyone. He believed that elves, dwarves, demons and people had nothing to divide and there was a place for everyone in the Sphere.

His kindness was out of place in the Sphere, so he went far to the North. Sinek did not want to see endless wars and bloodshed. It was better to look at the swirls of snow in the cold desert.
The dwarf did not like the life of a hermit. Klamus knew that endless battles were going on somewhere out there. But how to fix everything and make the world a better place? And then the answer came to him.

Sinek Klamus decided that it was necessary to educate kindness in children, no matter if it was a demon, a human, a dwarf or an elf. So he began to give toys. So he wanted to make the Sphere a little better. At least for the period of the winter whirlwind. And in order to have time to deliver the toys, he created a sleigh that quickly moved him to all corners of the world.

Now everyone knows that during the Snow Whirlwind, Morozovik appears in the Sphere, and everyone has already forgotten about Sinek Klamus. However, children all over the Sphere continue to find gifts with the initials SK in their homes and encounter traces of sleighs in places where they should not be.

notes.title: Season "Darkness and Cold"
notes.notes:
More than a hundred gifts for every Sphere player! The bravest, wisest and noblest warriors of the Sphere are invited to participate in the new season!

🔹What is this season?🔹

In essence, this is a set of tasks for participation in which progress points are given. As you accumulate progress points, you will receive sets of useful, and sometimes even unique rewards!

🔹Tell us more about the prizes!🔹

⚫️Title "Cold-Blooded" - increases movement speed by 3%, the chance of items dropping from monsters by 4%.
⚫️Windfury Infusion - increases attack speed, spells and movement by 5% for 24 hours
⚫️Loot Collector Trug - moves 60% faster than usual, exists for 30 days.
⚫️Groom's Token - used to upgrade a riding pet at grooms.
⚫️Gwaine's Pet. Its properties. Its properties are below.
◻️ Beast
◻️ Luck
◻️ Level 10 - Exceptional Strength (Increases owner's Strength by 1.6%) OR Exceptional Intelligence (Increases owner's Intelligence by 1.6%)
◻️ Level 20 - Otherworldly Power (Increases the power of physical abilities by 9%) OR Magical Mysteries (Increases the power of magical abilities by 9%)
◻️ Level 30 - Exceptional Strength (Increases owner's Strength by 1.6%) OR Exceptional Intelligence (Increases owner's Intelligence by 1.6%)
◻️ Level 40 - Secrets of Darkness (Increases critical strike chance by 3.5%) OR Scent of Blood (Increases critical strike power by 7%)
◻️ Level 50 - Exceptional Strength (Increases owner's Strength by 1.6%) OR Exceptional Intelligence (Increases owner's Intelligence by 1.6%)
◻️ Level 60 — Beast's Fury (If the owner deals critical damage, their critical damage is increased by 20% for 15 seconds. Cannot occur more than once every 60 seconds.) OR Hurricane Strike (If the owner deals critical damage, their running and ability speed is increased by 10% for 10s. Cannot occur more than once every 20s.)

In addition to all this, you can get feed, preservation crystals, the Refiner's Hammer, essences, ghost coins, spices and much, much more. The full set of rewards is available to those who purchase the expanded pass.

You can buy the Icecrown headdress and the Hammer of Thrayn back attachment for ghost coins from Battle Pass merchants.

🔹I'm in! How to participate?🔹

When you first log in to the game after the start of the battle season, each of your characters will see an invitation window.

Click the “Start Season” button to join. After that, you can open the season window by clicking on the icon next to the minimap.

🔹What do you need to do?🔹

Open the season window. In it, you will see a list of tasks. Tasks are divided into those that you can complete once per season and daily ones. One-time tasks are chains (complete the current task to start the next one). However, each group of tasks is available at the same time - as you complete simple tasks, new, more difficult ones will open up for you.

🔹I want more rewards and tasks!🔹

Easy! To have access to more tasks and get more rewards for progress points, you can purchase an extended pass. In addition to these benefits, the pass will also allow you to gain combat experience (progress points) faster. An extended pass is purchased once for the entire season and is valid for your entire account. You can become the owner of an extended pass and collect the rewards due to you at any time during the season.

🔹Can I get rewards right now?🔹

If the romance of completing tasks every day gets boring for you, then sure! To speed up the season and instantly gain access to rewards, you can purchase levels (a fixed number of progress points).

🔹How long is the season?🔹

The season lasts 28 days and contains 100 progress levels.
Get the most gifts!

We wish you good luck in the new season!

notes.title: Everyone needs a Trug
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/56fc9d17977b86fcbae096564f2468e7aaa04023.png[/img]

Sark, after everything that happened to him as a child, was an unsociable person. He spent all his time with books, and he also hated it when someone tried to find out why the boy was so obsessed with books. However, he needed a friend to talk to, but who would not ask questions. So Sark made a Trug.

Trug was a dead cub of a treant, which the boy revived with a large candle. The created creature became an excellent assistant for Sark. Trug unquestioningly followed all the instructions and did not ask questions.

Trug was nearby and listened to the boy's ideas on how to destroy demons. His wick lit the way for Sark in the dark caves where the crown was found. And it was Trug that was the only source of light in the ice castle.

After the death of his master, Trug remained near his master until he froze and his wick went out. Who knows, maybe if it is lit again, Trug will find a new owner.

notes.title: Meet Gwaine
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/0f2dbe4f3cae02a9507c1514a99692c991c4ecff.png[/img]

When Sark began to build his ice castle, local demons tried to attack him. He was not going to waste his energy on pathetic demon troops, so he created the Gwaine - magical birds that wielded weapons.

The Gwaine protected their master from attacks by enemies who tried to break into the ice hall and destroy his spell. The birds bravely stood in defense of their master while he was weaving his deadly ice spell. But they could not stand in battle against the demon Trayn.

The mighty blacksmith fought with the unusual birds and defeated them. However, he did not kill them, because he believed that these unusual creatures deserved to live. Instead, he immediately went to Sark, where he destroyed the cursed man and his Ice Crown.

After that, the Gwaine were free. They dispersed throughout the world to find a new master who needed brave little fighters. Today, many people and demons can be found with these birds, which help in hunting monsters.

notes.title: Find Thrain's hammer!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/6a11a3f3eb5b78c8d7db501275bc910ce05ed93a.png[/img]

Today, almost every warrior in the Sphere has yellow, red, or purple crystals in their weapons that increase their power. But once upon a time, a long time ago, there were blue crystals. They were extremely rare and gave their owner's weapons magical properties.

Such stones were in Thrain's huge hammer. They allowed Thrain to forge the best swords, create toys, and resist Sark: the stones protected him from the man's ice rays. In addition, thanks to these stones, the hero was able to destroy Icecrown.

After Thrain's death, his hammer disappeared. Perhaps it is buried under the rubble of Sark's ice castle and is waiting for a new hero to get it.

notes.title: The Tale of Icecrown
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/df8de6913520a861e073ef2f3a1b8d720f32c777.png[/img]

People usually think that demons are pure evil. However, there are cruel characters among people too. One of them was Sark, a child of war who almost destroyed all the demons at once.

Sark was born in a small village on the outskirts of Erikuria. One day, a large group of demons entered the land of people and attacked Sark's village. The boy was the only survivor of that massacre.
Since then, he hated demons and wanted to destroy them once and for all. But the boy was physically weak, so he began to look for strength in magic books. He spent many years reading ancient tomes, until one day Sark discovered records of a mysterious artifact in one of them - Icecrown. It allowed him to control the spirits of ice.

Sark became obsessed with the artifact and managed to find it in distant northern caves. However, at that moment there was practically no magic in it. Then Sark used all his knowledge and powers, and linked his life with Icecrown. As a result, Sark turned into a living skeleton, but the artifact became so powerful that it allowed him to create an ice castle on the territory of demons and freeze the demon land.

But, like every villain, Sark met his hero. It turned out to be the demon blacksmith Train, who struck Sark with his hammer and destroyed Icecrown.

notes.title: History of Sinum
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/ed28a8db016acecaa1c427ba435f506ae86801ab.png[/img]

There is a legend among demons about an unusual deer Sinum, who differed from his relatives with large spreading antlers. Some believe that this is just an animal, others - that it is a spirit. In fact, Sinum is the reincarnated demon Train.

He was a strong demon, whose power could be the envy of many. At the same time, Train was not a warrior, but an ordinary blacksmith: he forged sharp swords and axes, and in his free time he made toy balls of different colors for children.

Train was kind to everyone, even to those who tried to offend him. He himself never started fights, and fought only to protect those in trouble.

When the curse of darkness and cold fell on the lands of demons, Train went north in search of answers and came across a castle made of ice. There he defeated the king of cold and received his crown. This artifact could give unlimited power over the cold. The demon could even destroy people in one fell swoop.
But he did not do this. Trayn was sure that such power would not lead to anything good. Therefore, he destroyed the Icecrown, breaking the curse of eternal cold, but he died himself, because the magic of the artifact was too strong.

The gods saw the nobility of the demon and gave him a second life. They turned him into the noble deer Sinuma, which can sometimes be seen in the northern lands. He helps children and sometimes, out of old memory, gives them small toys.

notes.title: Season "The Secret of White Blood"
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/63afc739af554f72c0d5f5b25bd3fec7365e1e14.png[/img]

More than a hundred gifts for every Sphere player! The bravest, wisest and most noble warriors of the Sphere are invited to participate in the new season!

🔹What is this season?🔹

In essence, this is a set of tasks for participation in which progress points are given. As you accumulate progress points, you will receive sets of useful, and sometimes even unique rewards!

🔹Tell us more about the prizes!🔹

⚫️Title "Blood Hunter" - Increases movement speed by 2.5%, critical damage by 1.3%.
⚫️Windfury Infusion - increases attack, spell and movement speed by 5% for 24 hours
⚫️Risen Loot Collector - moves 60% faster than usual, lasts 30 days.
⚫️Groom's Token - used to upgrade the riding pet at grooms.
⚫️Pet "Storm Bat". Its properties are below.
◻️ stealth
◻️ speed
◻️ 10th level - Exceptional Strength and Endurance (Increases the owner's strength and endurance by 0.95%) OR Exceptional Intelligence and Endurance (Increases the owner's intelligence and endurance by 0.95%)
◻️ 20th level - Greater Wound Healing (During combat, restores the owner's health by 50% of their normal regeneration value) OR Accelerated Recovery (Increases the owner's energy, magical or necrotic energy regeneration by 20%)
◻️ 30th level - Exceptional Agility and Endurance (Increases the owner's agility and endurance by 0.95%) OR Exceptional Wisdom and Endurance (Increases the owner's wisdom and endurance by 0.95%)
◻️ 40th level - Onslaught (Increases attack and ability speed by 5%, critical strike chance by 2%.) OR Life Absorption (Restores health equal to 2.5% of the damage dealt by the owner.)
◻️ Level 50 - Exceptional Agility and Endurance (Increases the owner's Agility and Endurance by 0.95%) OR Exceptional Wisdom and Endurance (Increases the owner's Wisdom and Endurance by 0.95%)
◻️ Level 60 - Beast's Fury (If the owner deals critical damage, their critical damage is increased by 20% for 15 seconds. Can only occur once every 60 seconds.) OR Return (After receiving fatal damage, the owner is restored to 30% of their maximum health. Can only occur once every 3 minutes.)

In addition to all this, you can get feed, preservation crystals, the Refiner's Hammer, essences, ghost coins, spices, and much, much more. The full set of rewards is available to those who purchase the extended pass.

You can buy the Godinev Skull headdress and the Curse of Grix back ornament for ghost coins from Battle Pass merchants.

🔹I'm in! How do I participate?🔹

When you first log in to the game after the start of the battle season, each of your characters will see an invitation window.

Click the “Start Season” button to join. After that, you can open the season window by clicking on the icon next to the minimap.

🔹What do you need to do?🔹

Open the season window. There you will see a list of tasks. Tasks are divided into those that you can complete once per season and daily ones. One-time tasks are chains (complete the current task to start the next one). However, each group of tasks is available at the same time - as you complete simple tasks, new, more difficult ones will open up for you.

🔹I want more rewards and tasks!🔹

Easy! To have access to more tasks and get more rewards for progress points, you can purchase an extended pass. In addition to these benefits, the pass will also allow you to gain combat experience (progress points) faster. An extended pass is purchased once for the entire season and is valid for your entire account. You can become the owner of an extended pass and collect the rewards due to you at any time during the season.

🔹Can I get the rewards right now?🔹

If the romance of completing tasks every day gets boring for you, then of course! To speed up the season and instantly gain access to rewards, you can purchase levels (fixed number of progress points).

🔹How long is the season?🔹

The season lasts 28 days and contains 100 progress levels.
Get the most gifts!

We wish you good luck in the new season!

notes.title: The Story of the Risen
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/277fd606a34964cc061e0ec2c517f162042f123f.png[/img]

Amanda Nix conducted various experiments with white blood to improve its properties. The day before turning into a monster, she exposed white blood to necrotic magic and ice magic. The girl wanted to defeat death in this way, so she used it on the remains of her dead son.

The result exceeded all expectations. The bones came to life and began to serve their mistress. Amanda was sad that her son did not return. However, she decided that since she was able to revive the bones, she could thus defeat death. Therefore, she gathered the top of the order and decided to grant everyone immortality.

Unfortunately, this did not work out and everyone who took such white blood turned into monsters, who were then hunted. The Risen remained in the estate where the ritual was held. To this day, he is waiting for the return of his mistress to continue serving her.

notes.title: Secrets of the Thunder Bat
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/b855fe3bc4af088f0f13fd4624c450331b6bdea9.png[/img]

Thunder Bats are common bats that hide in caves in Erikuria and lead a predominantly nocturnal lifestyle. Their white blood can absorb magic, heal wounds and cure diseases. This is all that was written in the diary of the demon Rakshasa, who first discovered the bats in the caves of Erikuria during one of the horned ones' forays into the lands of people.

The demon took several individuals with him and studied their blood for a long time, subjecting it to magical effects. He tested all the properties of white blood on human test subjects and himself.

One day, he tried to expose white blood to necrotic magic and ice magic at once. He gave the resulting blood to a person to drink, and the person turned into a monster that almost killed the demon. Rakshasa realized that his research was dangerous, so he tore out all the pages describing his experiments from the diary and burned them. Only a brief description of the bats themselves remained.

A few years later, the demon died, and his diary fell into the hands of human soldiers who had infiltrated the demons' territory. They understood nothing of it, so when they returned to Erikuria, they gave it to the library. A hundred years later, Amanda Nix found the diary and learned about the unusual bats. Who knows, maybe if the demon had not torn out the pages from the diary, the white blood crisis could have been avoided.

notes.title: North's Wheel is rolling towards you!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/5e76d69a9b7ecd341eeedcc4288c8b95adefc33d.png[/img]

At the council, where the decision was made to create the order of hunters, the king was furious. The aristocrats told him where the monsters came from, so the sovereign was ready to execute them. But at that moment, the monsters attacked the council hall.

The knights quickly fell from the sharp claws of the monsters and began to turn into monsters. Those who had previously been part of the "White Blood" order began to protect the king. The ruler saw that the aristocrats did not turn into monsters from the wounds they received, which meant they could be used to fight the monsters.

The defenders did not have swords with them, so they protected the king with improvised means: candelabra, chairs, plates. Together they retreated to the courtyard, trying to break through to the armory, but the monsters surrounded them. Then Count Nathan North tore the wheel off the cart with provisions. With its help, he destroyed the monsters and saved the king.

After that, the king agreed to create an order of monster hunters and even took white blood himself to gain immunity. He appointed Nathan North as the leader of the order. The Count agreed and began to lead the cleansing of the kingdom from monsters. He used the same cart wheel as a weapon.

notes.title: What the Hunter's Hat Will Tell
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/f328aa09469d662db130a19fcdc08eb4b3f18bcf.png[/img]

After the top of the White Blood Order turned into monsters, panic began in Erikuria. Monsters that the Sphere had never seen before began to attack people and turn them into their own kind. To stop this, the king declared a state of emergency in Erikuria, forbade people from leaving their homes, and called a council to find a way out of the crisis.

The council was attended by aristocrats who were members of the White Blood Order. Because they had previously participated in rituals, monster bites did not work on them. Therefore, they proposed to the king to found an order of monster hunters. Its members pledged not to conduct sophisticated rituals with white blood, but to use it only to heal wounds and gain immunity from monsters.

The hallmark of the hunters was to be the hats that the aristocrats wore, and the masks that previously hid the faces of the followers of the White Blood Order.

The king agreed to this and selected the best fighters to become the basis of the new order. The monster hunters managed to destroy almost all the creatures of white blood, and drove some into deep caves from where they do not come out. After a successful hunt, they became ordinary knights. But if monsters appear in Erikuria again, they will take out their hats and challenge the monsters again.

notes.title: The story of Magister Nix
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/d58fef00ffdb093eac303021966927a62650e6e1.png[/img]

Amanda Nix was an influential aristocrat who strove for knowledge all her life. Together with other researchers, the girl studied ancient manuscripts and treatises in libraries throughout Erikuria. From one diary, she learned about the white blood of a thunder bat, which allowed her to heal wounds and cure any disease. Amanda decided to check it out.

It turned out that white blood really does have healing properties, but for this it is necessary to conduct magical rituals. The girl mastered them and began to secretly conduct rituals, healing her comrades. Rumors of healing spread, the number of Amanda Nix's followers grew, so the girl created a secret order "White Blood", and she herself became its Magister.

But healing alone was not enough, Magister Nix wanted more. Therefore, she remade the rituals, making the white blood stronger. After one of these rituals, Amanda and some of her followers turned into monsters.

The girl began to be pursued by former members of the order, who had become hunters. To avoid being found, Amanda hid in the caves of Erikuria. There she devoured thunder bats in the hope that this would help her regain her human form.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/69a02bc472a613ec6266297ea3db98e9cb37c7b2.png[/img]

It's time to set out for real riches! Monsters at least 5 levels above you can drop gold ore, which can be combined into pure gold bars, and then into treasure chests to get various useful items, such as gems, wealth potions, and more.

When combining treasure chests, you have a chance to get a Gold Rush Stash, and every 25th attempt will bring you one guaranteed! From the stash, you can get one of three rings, corresponding to your character's level at the time of receiving the stash:

✨Ring of Wealth - increases the amount of gold received when killing a monster by 18%,
✨Ring of Gold - stuns the enemy for 1.5 seconds upon a critical attack. Cannot be triggered more often than once every 40 seconds.

✨Ring of the Seeker - increases the chance to get an item when killing monsters by 14%.

Also, combining chests with riches will give you the "Treasure Hunt" buff, which increases the amount of health, gold pickup, and item drop chance by 5%. (Repeated combinations will increase the bonus up to 10%). The buff will be active throughout the event and for a week after it.
In addition, combining can give you the "Rich Man" title, which increases the gold pickup by 3.5%.

While the premium account is active, the chance of gold ore dropping is doubled. Additional gold bars can be purchased in the store.

Killing a representative of the opposite faction allows you to take half of the gold ore that he had on him, and once a day your faction will receive a buff for the number of combined items of this event.

Good luck in your adventures!
