notes.title: "Scary Tales" Season
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/b255cf6c471c5ff6b92618bd02ac2ddbdbe55548.png[/img]

More than a hundred gifts for every player of the Sphere! The bravest, wisest and noblest warriors of the Sphere are invited to participate in the new season!

🔹What is this season?🔹

In essence, this is a set of tasks for participation in which progress points are given. As you accumulate progress points, you will receive sets of useful, and sometimes even unique rewards!

🔹Tell us more about the prizes!🔹

⚫️Title "Fearless" - Ability enhancement increased by 1.8%, attack and ability speed increased by 2.5%.
⚫️Windfury Infusion - increases attack, spell and movement speed by 5% for 24 hours
⚫️Loot Collector Rem - moves 60% faster than usual, lasts 30 days.
⚫️Groom's Token - used to upgrade a riding pet for grooms.
⚫️Marquise Kruger's pet. Its properties are below.
◻️ Magic
◻️ Skill
◻️ Level 10 - Exceptional Stamina (Increases the owner's stamina by 1.6%) OR Exceptional Spirit (Increases the owner's spirit by 1.6%)
◻️ Level 20 - Warrior's Flame (Increases the owner's movement and attack speed by 5%) OR Wizard's Flame (Increases the owner's movement and ability speed by 5%)
◻️ Level 30 - Exceptional Agility (Increases the owner's agility by 1.6%) OR Exceptional Wisdom (Increases the owner's wisdom by 1.6%)
◻️ Level 40 - Growing Wrath (When attacking, with a 6% chance, increases the owner's attack and ability speed by 6% for 13s. Stacks up to 5 times.) OR Life Absorption (Restores health in the amount of 2.5% of the damage dealt by the owner.)
◻️ Level 50 - Exceptional Agility (Increases the owner's Agility by 1.6%) OR Exceptional Wisdom (Increases the owner's Wisdom by 1.6%)
◻️ Level 60 - Power Gathering (After the death of a creature within 16m, the owner's Agility and Wisdom will be increased by 2.6% for 16 seconds. The effect stacks 6 times.) OR Vanishing (If the owner receives a crowd control effect, he will be invisible for 3.5 seconds, also increasing his movement speed by 25%. This effect works no more than once every 60 seconds.)

In addition to all this, you will be able to get feed, preservation crystals, the Refiner's Hammer, essences, ghost coins, spices and much, much more. The full set of rewards is available for those who purchase an expanded pass.

You can purchase the Godinev Skull headgear and the Curse of Grix back attachment from Battle Pass vendors using Ghost Coins.

🔹I'm in! How do I join?🔹

When you first log in after the Battle Season starts, each of your characters will see an invitation window.

Click the "Start Season" button to join. After that, you can open the season window by clicking on the icon next to the minimap.

🔹What do you need to do?🔹

Open the season window. In it, you will see a list of tasks. Tasks are divided into those that you can complete once per season and daily ones. One-time tasks are chains (complete the current task to start the next one). However, each group of tasks is available at the same time - as you complete simple tasks, new, more difficult ones will open up for you.

🔹I want more rewards and tasks!🔹

Easy! To have access to more missions and get more rewards for progress points, you can purchase an extended pass. In addition to these benefits, the pass will also allow you to gain combat experience (progress points) faster. An extended pass is purchased once for the entire season and is valid for your entire account. You can become the owner of an extended pass and collect the rewards due to you at any time during the season.

🔹Can I get the rewards right now?🔹

If the romance of completing tasks every day gets boring for you, then of course! To speed up the passage of the season and instantly gain access to rewards, you can purchase levels (a fixed number of progress points).

🔹How long is the season?🔹

The season lasts 28 days and contains 100 levels of progress.
Get maximum gifts!

We wish you good luck in the new season!

notes.title: Rem — a friendly ghost
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/8c876e289aa41c52182de18e45f3dfdb2e4dfe55.png[/img]

It is generally accepted that demons are evil and dangerous creatures who have never seen compassion. However, this cannot be said about all of them.

Rem was an ordinary demon. But compared to other horned ones, he was distinguished by his sincere kindness to others. He could help anyone, even a dwarf. Other demons considered this stupidity and made fun of him, but Rem did not take offense.

And yet, one day, helping others played a cruel joke. Rem was patrolling Tir Twaidh and came across a wounded man named Ronus. Another demon could have finished off the enemy, but not Rem. He believed that everyone deserves the right to live, so he helped the man: he patched up his wounds, protected him from monsters and brought him to the camp. There they saw that Ronus had not returned alone, and attacked Rem. The demon tried to hide, but he could not: an arrow hit him right in the heart.

The demon fell, but his spirit remained. He forgave his murderers, because he understood that they did not know about helping Ronus. In addition, Rem decided that in the form of a spirit he would be able to do more good deeds. Therefore, he stayed in Tir Twaidh and began to help everyone, regardless of whether it was a demon or a person.

notes.title: Marquise Kruger
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/b820865bad6e55b5820f977d356a94592832fccd.png[/img]

There are many people in the Sphere who care about their neighbors. But their kindness should not be mistaken for weakness.

Adelaide Kruger came from an ancient family, had the title of Marquise and held a high position at court. She was an incredibly beautiful woman, whose hand all the lords in the kingdom sought.
But the Marquise had other things to do. She founded orphanages for the victims of the war with demons, and collected homeless animals in her estate. Many joked that Adelaide would rather marry another cat than a man. Such conversations did not offend the lady, but on the contrary, they made her laugh.

However, not everyone was ready to put up with the Marquise's eccentricity. Lord Vermank wanted to marry Lady Kruger at all costs. For several months he presented Adelaide with gold, but the Marquise was adamant. After another refusal, the lord could not stand it: he gathered his people and set fire to her estate. The Marchioness rushed into the burning building to save all the animals she had sheltered. She managed to save everyone, but she died in the process.

When the fire was over, the animals returned to the ruins of the estate to honor the memory of their mistress. The Marchioness's spirit could not abandon them and returned in the form of an unusual cat with horns. In her new guise, Lady Kruger took revenge on her killer, and then became an animal protector. Since then, anyone who kicked an unfortunate kitten on the street does not live long.

notes.title: Godinev Skull
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/2734ec794501ea8ac40689a09aa329167e31b24d.png[/img]

Hospitality is considered one of the main virtues. But do not be fooled, because sometimes it can lead to death.

Far to the south, in the forests, there is the Godinev tribe. This is a friendly community of savages, which was discovered by one of the human expeditions. The discoverers were greeted like kings: they were treated to the most delicious fruits, given the best wines to drink and indulged in every possible way. Exactly six days.

On the seventh day, the savages, according to their ritual, sacrificed the explorers to their god Godinevesp. They tied up the people, put horned skulls on their heads, and cut out their hearts, which they then ate.

King Rickard III put an end to their murders. He went to those lands to find out where the expedition had disappeared. The king also came across the Godinev tribe and was pleasantly surprised by the hospitality of the savages.

However, on the third day, the king and some men were walking through the forest and came across a pit filled with human bodies. Some of them were dressed in the uniform of the lost expedition.

The king returned to the camp and told his men everything. At night, when the tribe fell asleep, the soldiers destroyed the tribe. They took the skulls of the Godines as trophies.

notes.title: The Curse of Grix
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/bfa0b7a85bee983386814ac7fc25718cabf6afd9.png[/img]

You can't read ancient magic books, especially out loud. These rules are followed by all researchers of the Sphere. Almost all.

Grix could be called a happy man: family, home, children, the position of chief researcher at the royal court. It would seem, live and rejoice. But curiosity let the researcher down.

During one expedition, Grix was studying the ruins of an old deserted castle and discovered a secret room littered with bones. In its center was a pedestal with Mortvilia - a book of the dead, made from human skin. Its pages were covered with warnings, but Grix decided not to stop. He found a spell that grants a person supernatural power.

Grix wanted to use the power for the benefit of humanity, so he began to read the spell. As soon as he read the first lines, the skin on his back burst and huge ugly wings grew from the wounds. The other members of the expedition, seeing this, decided that Grix had become a demon, so they attacked him. The frightened researcher dropped the book and fled, and his colleagues burned the cursed tome so that no one else would turn into a monster.

For many centuries, Grix wandered the Sphere, collecting artifacts and ancient scrolls to return to his human form. So far, he has not succeeded, and he still walks the world with cursed wings on his back.

notes.title: Beware of Genoda!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/529acdb8e2bb4cedc6a733ee5cd6080fa5f221f4.png[/img]

The scary tales that old men tell around the fire are always popular, especially on dark autumn evenings. Who knows, maybe there is some truth in these legends, or maybe it is just fiction. We will find out soon...

***

Some places are best avoided.

It is known from ancient scrolls that it is best to avoid the mountains in the northernmost part of Tir Twaidh. There is no grass growing there, there are no animals, and even birds fly around those places. The scrolls do not say what kind of creature lives there, but the elders briefly mention the huge spider Genoda.

Even in human legends, you can find mentions of her. Several centuries ago, people tried to pass through the northern pass to Tir Twaidh, to the territory of demons, but the troops did not return. The kingdom thought that the demons had killed everyone, but one survivor said that a huge spider lives in the mountains. After that, people began to avoid the pass, and then completely removed it from all maps so that no one would fall into the clutches of the monster.

No one knows how Genoda appeared in the mountains. People believe that she came from the Abyss along with the demons. The Horned Ones are sure that the spider has always been in the mountains, since the creation of the Sphere. But both peoples are equally afraid of her, because Genoda devours all living things that invade her domain. But where is the border of her domain?

notes.title: Season "Dungeons and Dwarves"
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/3700665a8ae294d5d28aabb343d65d0bc0e18b15.png[/img]

More than a hundred gifts for every player of the Sphere! The bravest, wisest and noblest warriors of the Sphere are invited to participate in the new season!

🔹What is this season?🔹

In essence, this is a set of tasks for participation in which progress points are given. As you accumulate progress points, you will receive sets of useful, and sometimes even unique rewards!

🔹Tell us more about the prizes!🔹

🔸Title "Halfling" - increases health regeneration by 9%, health reserve by 4%.
🔸Windfury Infusion - increases attack speed, spells and movement by 5% for 24 hours
🔸Loot Collector Worl - moves 60% faster than usual, exists for 30 days.
🔸Stable Hand Token - used to improve a riding pet at the stable hands.
🔸Pet Bules. Its properties are below.
◻️ Beast
◻️ Luck
◻️ Level 10 - Exceptional Agility and Endurance (Increases the owner's Agility and Endurance by 0.95%) OR Exceptional Wisdom and Endurance (Increases the owner's Wisdom and Endurance by 0.95%)
◻️ Level 20 - Superior Vigilance (Reduces the chance of being critically hit by 6.5%) OR Greater Wound Healing (During combat, restores the owner's health regeneration by 50% of their normal value)
◻️ Level 30 - Exceptional Agility and Endurance (Increases the owner's Agility and Endurance by 0.95%) OR Exceptional Wisdom and Endurance (Increases the owner's Wisdom and Endurance by 0.95%)
◻️ Level 40 - Secrets Darkness (Increases critical strike chance by 3.5%) OR Scent of Blood (Increases critical strike power by 7%)
◻️ Level 50 - Exceptional Strength and Agility (Increases owner's Strength and Agility by 0.95%) OR Exceptional Intellect and Wisdom (Increases owner's Intellect and Wisdom by 0.95%)
◻️ Level 60 - Gathering Power (After a creature within 16m dies, owner's Agility and Wisdom will be increased by 2.6% for 16 seconds. The effect stacks up to 6 times.) OR Aerial Feints (After receiving damage, there is a 9% chance to reduce all damage taken by 3.5% and increase movement speed by 6.5% for 12 seconds. Cannot occur more than once every 5 seconds. Stacks up to 4 times.)

📜In addition to all this, you can get feed, preservation crystals, the Refiner's hammer, essences, ghost coins, spices and much, much more. The full set of rewards is available to those who purchase the extended pass.

📜You can buy the Dendrika Stronghold headdress and the Berg Star shoulder ornament from the Battle Pass goods merchants for ghost coins.

🔹I'm in! How do I participate?🔹

When you first log in to the game after the start of the battle season, each of your characters will see an invitation window.

Click the “Start Season” button to join. After that, you can open the season window by clicking on the icon located next to the minimap.

🔹What do you need to do?🔹

Open the season window. In it, you will see a list of tasks. Tasks are divided into those that you can complete once per season and daily ones. One-time tasks are chains (complete the current task to start the next one). However, each group of tasks is available at the same time - as you complete simple tasks, new, more difficult ones will open up for you.

🔹I want more rewards and tasks!🔹

Easy! To have access to more tasks and get more rewards for progress points, you can purchase an extended pass. In addition to these benefits, the pass will also allow you to gain combat experience (progress points) faster. An extended pass is purchased once for the entire season and is valid for your entire account. You can become the owner of an extended pass and collect the rewards due to you at any time during the season.

🔹Can I get rewards right now?🔹

If the romance of completing tasks every day gets boring for you, then sure! To speed up the season and instantly gain access to rewards, you can purchase levels (a fixed number of progress points).

🔹How long is the season?🔹

The season lasts 28 days and contains 100 progress levels.
Get the most gifts!

We wish you good luck in the new season!

notes.title: Coming soon!
notes.notes:
The new season will bring new gifts to the Sphere, and it's time to learn more about them!

UNOCYCLE

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/60dc36a3668b6699c87d1518bffef8a0dffd5e99.png[/img]

Not only among demons and people are there incredible madmen who move progress forward. One of them was the dwarf Sidrok, who was always interested in mechanisms. From early childhood, he sought to create something new and breakthrough, so throughout his life he created many useless things.
For example, an automatic pickaxe, to use which you needed to have the strength of three dwarves.

But sometimes Sidrok had breakthroughs. One of them was the unocycle - an unusual mechanism in the form of a circle, which allowed you to travel huge distances. Initially, the gnomes considered the unocycle a useless mechanism: what was the point of it if there were rails in the tunnels?

Their opinion changed when a team of gnomes was digging a new adit. Several workers were buried and needed to be rescued urgently. Sidrok on the unocycle reached the blockage before anyone else and saved the gnomes.

When the gnomes got to the surface, Sidrok showed his invention to the people. But they didn’t like the fact that the central axis prevented them from looking forward, so they abandoned the unocycle. Nevertheless, some liked the unusual transport and asked Sidrok to make it bigger so that a person could fit in it.

Sidrok is no longer alive. However, the unocycle can still be found among collectors, but they sell it at a very high price.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/f555db0709b39a5537a52cb4c04e56db4d080d06.png[/img]

GOLD RESERVE

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/6b3dc904b20c43c88383f52fbbca856c6e4b6366.png[/img]

After reaching the surface, the gnomes began to cooperate with humans. One of them, Brok, saw that humans were using hops to produce delicious ale, so he began to study the technology to create his own unique drink.

It must be admitted that Brok's drink really turned out delicious. But how to make people drink his ale, because they are used to their own? Brok consulted Sidrok, who made him a special barrel called a "gold reserve" that could be carried on his shoulders. Brok traveled with it to human cities and offered everyone a mug of his drink.

The dwarven ale quickly conquered the human cities. But some people liked not only the drink, but also the unusual barrel. They began ordering them from Sidrok and, like Brok, went to human cities and let everyone try their drinks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/f555db0709b39a5537a52cb4c04e56db4d080d06.png[/img]

SIDROCK'S HELMET

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/d116f44d50983e7d8ae1a2fac51a1912ff512a8f.png[/img]

Perhaps Sidrok's most controversial invention was his unusual helmet. It was supposed to be used by the dwarves during the war with the elves. Sidrok believed that thanks to this helmet the elves would be afraid of the dwarves and retreat, but the helmet did not give any significant advantage.

However, after the dwarves came to the surface, the helmet became popular with the people. It had an unusual shape and a creepy mask. The royal family liked them so much that a special squad of elite fighters wore these helmets. The warriors won a major victory over the demons, which went down in history as the "Horned Clash." Today, the special squad no longer exists. But Sidrok's helmets are still as strong as they were hundreds of years ago, which is why they are so valuable.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/f555db0709b39a5537a52cb4c04e56db4d080d06.png[/img]

BULES

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/a4502bb93ead19455cfd239d30325bd457d76763.png[/img]

After reaching the surface, the gnomes began to explore the Sphere. They became acquainted with the animal world, plants, and human technologies. The King of the gnomes even personally led expeditions to explore the world of the Sphere.

On one of these expeditions, he saw a rare black bird - a bules. A few days later, the king died. A month later, the new king of the gnomes also traveled around the Sphere, saw a boules, and a week later he was buried in one of the old mines.

All this led to the gnomes considering the boules a harbinger of evil for the gnomes. Therefore, they began to avoid places with cursed birds. The demons learned about such prejudices and began to catch boules to use them in the fight against the gnomes for intimidation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/f555db0709b39a5537a52cb4c04e56db4d080d06.png[/img]

VORL

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/d510e42dc78fcf066354948f4d430373a601d027.png[/img]

Vorls are cute furry animals that live underground. Thanks to their sense of smell, they can avoid dangerous places underground. Sidrok noticed this and began to use vorls to find places where an underground passage could collapse.

Vorls had an unimaginable effect on people: the animals were tamed and began to be actively bred. But when the first wave of excitement passed, people realized that there was no practical use for underground vorls on the surface. Scientists and wizards tried to use vorls in building castles to detect weak spots in walls, but to no avail. However, these animals are very smart, so people managed to teach them to carry items in special bags.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/f555db0709b39a5537a52cb4c04e56db4d080d06.png[/img]

The new battle season starts on August 28. Don't forget to claim the gifts of the "Legends of the Sphere" season before this date and free up your bags for the next rewards!

notes.title: Season "Legends of the Sphere"
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/aea95928f36cf97fba598a37dead9d52b3cd54f3.png[/img]

More than a hundred gifts for every player of the Sphere! The bravest, wisest and noblest warriors of the Sphere are invited to participate in the new season!

🔹What is this season?🔹

In essence, this is a set of tasks for participation in which progress points are given. As you accumulate progress points, you will receive sets of useful, and sometimes even unique rewards!

🔹Tell us more about the prizes!🔹

🔸The title "Legend of the Sphere" - increases the chance of a critical attack by 0.6% and the amount of gold received from killing monsters by 8%.
🔸Windfury Infusion - increases attack speed, spells and movement by 5% for 24 hours
🔸Loot Collector Aulelei - moves 60% faster than usual, exists for 30 days.
🔸Groom's Token - used to upgrade a riding pet for grooms.
🔸Chedrigil's pet. Its properties are below.
◻️ Strong
◻️ Economy
◻️ Level 10 - Exceptional Stamina (Increases the owner's stamina by 1.6%) OR Exceptional Spirit (Increases the owner's spirit by 1.6%)
◻️ Level 20 - Superior Defense Stance (Reduces the owner's physical damage taken by 7.5%) OR Powerful Runic Defense (Reduces the owner's magical damage taken by 7.5%)
◻️ Level 30 - Exceptional Strength and Stamina (Increases the owner's strength and stamina by 0.95%) OR Exceptional Intelligence and Stamina (Increases the owner's intelligence and stamina by 0.95%)
◻️ Level 40 - Impenetrable Defense (Increases the owner's physical and magical defense by 35% for 8 seconds upon receiving the effect stun, fear, silence, immobilize, sleep, or disarm.) OR Magic Scale (Reduces the chance to be critically hit by 4.8%, damage taken by 2.5%.)
◻️ Level 50 - Exceptional Strength and Endurance (Increases the owner's strength and endurance by 0.95%) OR Exceptional Intelligence and Endurance (Increases the owner's intelligence and endurance by 0.95%)
◻️ Level 60 - Underwater Treasures (Increases gold, the number of items picked up, and the number of resources collected by 12%.) OR Courage (When the owner's health drops to 45% of maximum or lower, the damage taken is reduced by 23%, the chance to be critically hit is reduced by 8% for 15 seconds. Triggers no more than once every 25 seconds.)

📜In addition to all this, you can get feed, preservation crystals, the Refiner's hammer, essences, ghost coins, spices and much, much more. The full set of rewards is available to those who purchase the extended pass.

📜You can buy the "Dendric's Stronghold" headdress and the "Berg's Star" shoulder ornament from the Battle Pass goods merchants for ghost coins.

🔹I'm in! How to participate?🔹

When you first log in to the game after the start of the battle season, each of your characters will see an invitation window.

Click the "Start Season" button to join. After that, you can open the season window by clicking on the icon next to the minimap.

🔹What do you need to do?🔹

Open the season window. In it, you will see a list of tasks. Tasks are divided into those that you can complete once per season and daily ones. One-time tasks are chains (complete the current task to start the next one). However, each group of tasks is available at the same time - as you complete simple tasks, new, more difficult ones will open up.

🔹I want more rewards and tasks!🔹

Easy! To have access to more tasks and get more rewards for progress points, you can purchase an extended pass. In addition to these benefits, the pass will also allow you to gain combat experience (progress points) faster. An extended pass is purchased once for the entire season and is valid for your entire account. You can become the owner of an extended pass and collect the rewards due to you at any time during the season.

🔹Can I get the rewards right now?🔹

If the romance of completing tasks every day gets boring for you, then sure! To speed up the passage of the season and instantly gain access to rewards, you can purchase levels (a fixed number of progress points).

🔹How long is the season?🔹

The season lasts 28 days and contains 100 levels of progress.
Get maximum gifts!

We wish you good luck in the new season!

notes.title: In Search of the Chedrigil
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/2f878e9b4b67dd02f58d49e31a6e38ee2cc67192.png[/img]

None of the demons know where the Chedrigil came from in the Sphere. Some say that it was just a tree seed that fell on a turtle shell and sprouted. But others are sure that the Chedrigil is a magical animal that came to us from the spirit world. According to legend, the leaves of its tree can cure any disease. Some will say that this is just a myth, but a couple of demons were convinced that it was true.

Endre was the most beautiful demoness that the Sphere had ever seen. She rejected everyone's advances. She did not need the strongest demon, but the one who was ready to do anything for her. One day, the demoness was seriously ill: she became very weak and could not get out of bed. The shamans kept her alive, but they knew that it was all in vain.

Kerp, who had been in love with Endre all his life, knew that he could help the demoness. He had heard the legend of the chedrigil and was determined to find it. So he left the army of Vagrot and began to travel around the Sphere in search of the animal.

For many months he could not find it. In despair, he turned to the spirits to help him find the beast. Chedrigil heard the request of the enamored demon and came to him himself. The beast allowed Kerp to pick several leaves from the tree, which he took to Endre's house. There the demon made a decoction from them, thanks to which Endre quickly got back on her feet.

After such a miraculous healing, Endre became Kerp's wife. Chedrigil has not been seen since. However, some shamans are sure that if the demon is worthy, the spirit will come to his aid.

notes.title: Who is Aulelei?
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/297e971f05393a53638adaad0641627f1d7087d3.png[/img]

The Red Stone Plateau is an extremely harsh place, full of lizards, shushpans, and other monsters. But even if you are a strong warrior and are not afraid of monsters, you should beware of sandstorms, which can easily lead you astray. However, if you are lucky, the spirit of this place will show you the way.

According to legend, a long time ago, a merchant named Hank Reinkord lived in Erikuria. He wanted to find the perfect route through the Red Stone Plateau, which would allow him to bypass places with monsters. But as soon as the merchant moved away from the nearest settlement, a strong sandstorm arose.

The merchant and his cargo remained in place, afraid that he would fall into the clutches of the shushpans. He hoped to wait out the storm, but it did not subside. And when Hank was almost in despair, the aulelei came to him. The spirit took the merchant's load and led him through the desert, showing him the ideal route.

Since then, no one has seen the aulelei. But some travelers say that they saw traces of his paws in the sand and, following them, got out of the Red Rock Plateau safe and sound.

One of the most famous helmets of people was Dendrick's Stronghold. Legend has it that Dendrick was a great warrior who defeated the mighty demon Berg. In honor of his victory over the enemy, the warrior forged himself a helmet that looked like a tower. But the ancient scrolls remember the real story of Dendrick, and there is nothing heroic about it.

Dendrick was an ordinary mercenary who took on any job. But he could not complete it, because he was constantly unlucky: either the customer would choke and die, or Dendrick himself would not cope with the task. Because of this, he received the nickname "loser".

However, one day, luck smiled on him. At that time, a major battle with demons was to take place and all warriors were needed, even those like Dendrick. He agreed and even stood in the vanguard. But during the attack, Dendrick got hit in the head and fell to the ground stunned.

Having come to his senses, Dendrick saw that Berg was standing in front of him. The demon masterfully wielded his sword and killed people left and right. But Dendrick was lying behind him. So he did not lose his head, stood up and killed Berg with a blow to the back.

After the victory, Dendrick received a worthy reward. So that no one could stun him again, he ordered a helmet in the form of a tower - the only one in Erikuria. However, he never tried it on, because he fell from his horse and broke his neck.

People tried to forget about such an absurd death and the killing of a demon in the back, so they made up a legend about Dendrick, who was a great warrior. His helmet, which he never put on, was placed on the warrior's grave as a symbol of his valor and honor.

notes.title: Berg's Star
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/46f832fd0e3d3f73c8e6796d527de781fad7f265.png[/img]

A legend about a mighty, thin warrior named Berg still lives among demons. He was one of the most skilled warriors of his era, and his blade was called Berg's Star. It was a heavy sword that no other demon could lift. Berg fought with it as if the sword were light as a tree branch.

Thanks to this sword, Berg was a real terror for monsters and people. No one could defeat the warrior. But you can't be invincible forever.

During a battle with an army of people, Berg got carried away by the battle and didn't notice how a man named Dendrick appeared behind him. He pierced the heart of the legendary warrior, after which the battle was over. There were too few people to continue the battle, and the demons were demoralized by the death of the legendary warrior.

The next day, a farewell was held for Berg in Brionnfall. He was buried near the steps leading to the capital. The weapon was laid with its owner, for no one else could hold the great sword. It is said that when a worthy warrior appears, the sword will emerge from the grave to serve its new owner.

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/1188475c694ac9135132e8c3d866e48a5a1177e3.png[/img]

Few of those alive today remember how the demons founded Brionnfall. Back then, the city had a different name, and it was located in a different place.

Initially, the demons built their capital in the Forest of Blue Mists. But monsters constantly attacked and did not allow the builders to work normally, so the city was never completed. Then the leader of the demons saw an unusual dream: in it, the fiery brionne led the demons to the volcano.

The leader of the demons turned to the shamans to correctly interpret his dream. They said that the fiery brionne is a spirit that shows the demons the future. The leader of the demons decided to listen to him and led his people to the volcano Sulfur Heart.

The construction of the capital was progressing successfully. The demons erected the first buildings and high walls until they were attacked by the dwarven troops. The city held out in the heavy siege, and the demons managed to push the shorties away from the city. The leader of the demons realized that the victory was due to the brionne that came to him in a dream, so he named the capital after him.

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/97e84d175f656f2045b460355ce9531a482c3ea8.png[/img]

A new event has started in the world of the Sphere - “Dungeons and Shushpans”.

While the event lasts, any monsters of your level or 1-2 levels higher or lower may drop an adventurer badge, which can be combined with the same badges to receive a reward. Collect and equip the final item, the Adventurer's Crown, which will increase your character's Strength, Dexterity, Intelligence, and Wisdom by 0.3% (the effect can stack up to 3%). The boost is valid for the duration of the event and for a week after it.

🔥When combining badges into the Adventurer's Crown, you have a chance to receive one of three unique rings:

💍Ring of Courage - when receiving a control effect, removes 1 negative effect from the owner. Cooldown 55s.
💍Ring of Cunning - with a 6% chance when dealing damage, increases the chance of a critical attack by 4% for 12 seconds. Stacks up to 5 times.
💍Ring of Thought - when the wearer’s health drops to 70%, creates a shield equal to 20% of health. The shield lasts 20 seconds. It works no more than once every 60s.

All rings are epic and contain 6 colorless gem sockets.

If after 19 attempts your character has not received the ring, on the 20th attempt he is guaranteed to receive it!

Each time you combine icons, your faction receives 1 victory point. Once a day, points are reset and both factions receive a daily boost, the power of which depends on their place in the competition.

Remember: members of the enemy faction can defeat you and take half of your Adventurer Badges!

You can receive additional badges every day for completing the daily quests of the three young adventurers in Cinderkreg or Hellsong Tavern. While the premium account is active, the chance of getting an adventurer badge is doubled.

Additionally, you can speed up the process by purchasing the missing icons from the play store.

Forward to adventure!

notes.title: New dungeon - Cursed Halls!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/b9bd3d3c7001c60d3e990cf94d78a040c0ec2771.png[/img]

Rumor has it that the familiar dungeon “Halls of the Forgotten” has a new dimension. A few careless heroes entered there, thinking that everything would be easy, and were never seen again. They also talk about ancient treasures that will go to only the bravest and most skilled warriors. Maybe these are just legends, maybe not. Find out for yourself in the new dungeon - The Cursed Halls are open!

To get to the new dungeon, you will have to go to the Halls of the Forgotten in the western Valley of Cold. Entrance to the Cursed Halls is only available to level 59-60 players. Inside, as in the regular version of this dungeon, 9 bosses and treasure chests will await you.

And of course, the key question is what treasures you can get from the Cursed Halls. These include new runes, new quality recipes, and recipes for creating transferable chests with quality essence. Some rune recipes are ordinary, others allow you to create cursed runes. These runes increase the cooldown of the ability, but make it more powerful. Also in the new dungeon you can get recipes for cursed potions that reduce stamina, but give huge increases to other characteristics. For example, a cursed strength potion gives 620 strength for 30 minutes, but reduces stamina by 55.

Dungeon bosses and chests can give one of three buffs that last 14 days and stack. Only one boost can be active at a time.

Killing bosses and opening chests also gives you a new type of coin - Dungeon Hero Coins. You can spend them at the merchant of special goods near the entrance to the Halls of the Forgotten.

It should be added that this is not all the content that will be available in this dungeon. Over time, other new features will appear. We look forward to your impressions of the Cursed Halls on our social networks!

Have a good game!

notes.title: Season "Secrets of the Ocean"
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/4b1dc0b7820a1ba389006ee4d4c027f9798cdd13.png[/img]

More than a hundred gifts for every Sphere player! The bravest, wisest and noblest warriors of the Sphere are invited to participate in the new season!

🔹What season is this?🔹

Essentially, this is a set of tasks, for which participation is given progress points. As you accumulate progress points, you will receive sets of useful and sometimes even unique rewards!

🔹Tell us more about the prizes!🔹

🔸Title "Submariner" - reduces the chance of receiving a critical hit by 1.5%, increases endurance by 3%.
🔸Infusion of Windfury - increases attack, spell and movement speed by 5% for 24 hours
🔸Loot collector Galeb - moves 60% faster than usual, lasts 30 days.
🔸Groom Token - used to improve the groom’s mount.
🔸Phoka's pet. Its properties are below.
◻️ fast
◻️ luck
◻️ Level 10 - Exceptional Stamina (Increases the wearer's stamina by 1.6%) OR Exceptional Spirit (Increases the wearer's spirit by 1.6%)
◻️ Level 20 - Healing Power (Increases received healing and shields by 7.5%) OR Light Step (Increases the wearer's movement speed by 12%)
◻️ Level 30 - Exceptional Strength (Increases the owner's strength by 1.6%) OR Exceptional Intelligence (Increases the owner's intelligence by 1.6%)
◻️ Level 40 - Deep Waters (Increases movement speed by 7.5%, reduces damage taken by 2.5%.) OR Healing Currents (Increases movement speed by 7.5%, increases health regeneration by 40%.)
◻️ Level 50 - Exceptional Agility and Stamina (Increases the owner's agility and endurance by 0.95%) OR Exceptional Wisdom and Endurance (Increases the owner's wisdom and endurance by 0.95%)
◻️ Level 60 - Underwater Treasures (Increases gold, the number of items picked up and resources collected by 12%.) OR By Waves (Once every 3 seconds, increases movement speed by 9%. Stacks up to 4 times, applies once every 3 seconds. When receiving a small damage, the accumulated effect is reset.)

🌊In addition to all this, you can get food, conservation crystals, a refining master’s hammer, essences, ghost coins, spices and much, much more. The full set of rewards is available to those who purchase the Advanced Pass.

🌊You can buy the “Underwater Explorer’s Helmet” headdress and the “Nerod’s Air” shoulder accessory for ghost coins from battle pass merchants.

🔹I'm in! How to participate?🔹

When you first log into the game after the start of the battle season, each of your characters will see an invitation window.

Click the “Start Season” button to join. After this, you can open the season window by clicking on the icon located next to the mini-map.

🔹What needs to be done?🔹

Open the season window. In it you will see a list of tasks. Tasks are divided into those that you can complete once per season, and daily. One-time tasks are chained (complete the current task to start the next one). However, each group of tasks is available at the same time - as you complete simple tasks, new, more complex ones will open up.

🔹I want more rewards and tasks!🔹

Easily! To have access to more tasks and receive more rewards for progress points, you can purchase an extended pass. In addition to these benefits, the pass will also allow you to gain combat experience (progress points) faster. The Extended Pass is purchased once for the entire season and is valid for your entire account. You can become the owner of an extended pass and claim your rewards at any time during the season.

🔹Can I get rewards right now?🔹

If the romance of completing tasks every day bores you, then of course! To speed up the season and gain immediate access to rewards, you can purchase levels (a fixed number of progression points).

The season lasts 28 days and contains 100 levels of progress!
Receive maximum gifts!

We wish you good luck in the new season!

notes.title: The most faithful friend
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/5f7b8f30ad9bfaee26e88f6cb2894db2900e72c2.png[/img]

Loyalty is more common among animals than among demons or humans. But even among animals there are the most loyal ones - the ocean phoca.

When Nerod the Seer traveled north, he found a lone Phoca whose family had been eaten by the Tiburons. The demon felt sorry for the animal, so he took it to himself.

Phoca became attached to Nerodus and waited for him on every journey. After Nerod died in a fight with Tiburon, the animal remained at his grave. The demons tried to take him away, but Phoca always returned to his owner until his death. They even erected a monument to the animal for this.

The Phoca's devotion conquered the demons, and many began to travel north to find a true friend. But today you don’t have to go far; you just need to buy a phoca from a seller.

notes.title: Galeb will show the way!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/895e447e4591df3f07fa4c0d1f79849398867b11.png[/img]

Nerod was an excellent scientist, but a terrible sailor. He often took the wrong route and got lost in the ocean. It was good that he had a faithful galeb.

During its first journey across the ocean, Nerod's ship lost its course. The team was ready to give up, when suddenly Nerod saw a bird in the sky - a galeb. The sailors lured her with the remains of food, and then followed her, because she had to return to the nest. Thanks to this cunning, the sailors reached land.

Galeb turned out to be a very smart and useful bird. In addition to navigating the ocean, they could also deliver small packages. Sailors began to tame them and then sell them to everyone.

notes.title: Underwater Explorer Helmet
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/931d6a7ae9164b488127b1285ecc5bad7e7c8275.png[/img]

It is very dark at the bottom of the ocean. In addition, water does not allow you to keep your eyes open for long. Nerod could not find a solution to this problem, so he turned to the spirits for wisdom.

They suggested that with the help of magic you can create a helmet that can shine. But they also warned the demon that the invention would cause the death of the researcher himself.

Nerod did not believe in the prophecy of his own death. He created a helmet for an underwater explorer, with which he studied the ocean floor. But, as the spirits predicted, he died because the light of the helmet attracted the Tiburon predator.

No one continued Nerod's work because of the danger of being eaten by Tiburon. Therefore, today the helmet has become an artifact that reminds everyone of the ambitious demon explorer.

notes.title: Air of Nerod
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/7bbea13bfb6fcb291b6d438647ec8aa600196e88.png[/img]

Demons cannot breathe underwater. But how can we explore the seabed in this case? Non-Rod the Seer struggled for a long time to solve this problem. He studied different methods, and runes came to the researcher’s aid.

He applied them to special cylinders, thanks to which they began to hold huge amounts of air. With the help of a system of tubes and valves, the carrier of the “Nerod air” could breathe on the seabed.

But such a system was very expensive, so only one was made. After Nerod’s death, no one wanted to continue his work and study the ocean floor, so “Nerod’s air” became a source of pride for collectors.

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/eacee789a815db6d01cfade39dcc6fc9f1080a8f.png[/img]

The ocean has always attracted researchers with its secrets. Especially the demon Nero Seer. He plowed the ocean on his ship and even sank to the seabed with the help of magical objects.

But during one of his dives, Nerod encountered a tiburon, a powerful ocean predator. The demon defended himself as best he could, but died in an unequal battle. The wizard who was on the ship did not manage to save Nerod in time, but still took revenge for his death.

The team recovered the bodies of the demon and the ocean predator from the bottom. The researcher was buried with honors, and the Tiburon was taken to the observatory. The shamans studied Nerod’s killer for a long time, rebuilt it to live on land, and breathed new life with the help of runes. Now Tiburon roams the land with its new owner.

notes.title: Season of Dragons' Lair
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/7b15e8c247e046f224a6832067bba6d484ecba91.png[/img]

More than a hundred gifts for every Sphere player! The bravest, wisest and noblest warriors of the Sphere are invited to participate in the season of jungle mystery!

🔹What season is this?🔹

Essentially, this is a set of tasks, for which participation is given progress points. As you accumulate progress points, you will receive sets of useful and sometimes even unique rewards!

🔹Tell us more about the prizes!🔹

🔸Title "Dragon Rider" - increases the chance of a critical attack by 0.6%, the amount of critical damage by 1.3%.
🔸Infusion of Windfury - increases attack, spell and movement speed by 5% for 24 hours
🔸Loot Collector Gastres - moves 60% faster than usual, lasts 30 days.
🔸Groom Token - used to improve the groom’s mount.
🔸 Pet Shkeers. Its properties are below.
◻️ crusher
◻️skill
◻️ Level 10 - Exceptional Strength (Increases the owner's strength by 1.6%) OR Exceptional Intelligence (Increases the owner's intelligence by 1.6%)
◻️ Level 20 - Greater Wound Healing (During combat, restores the owner to 50% of their normal health regeneration value) OR Accelerated Recovery (Increases the owner's energy regeneration, magical or necrotic energy by 20%)
◻️ Level 30 - Exceptional Strength (Increases the owner's strength by 1.6%) OR Exceptional Intelligence (Increases the owner's intelligence by 1.6%)
◻️ Level 40 - Dragon's Might (Increases the chance of a critical strike by 2%, the critical damage multiplier by 4%.) OR Magic Scales (Reduces the chance of receiving a critical strike by 4.8%, damage received by 2.5%.)
◻️ Level 50 - Exceptional Stamina (Increases the wearer's stamina by 1.6%) OR Exceptional Spirit (Increases the wearer's spirit by 1.6%)
◻️ level 60 - Devouring Flame (If the owner deals critical damage, his enemy is engulfed in flames that take away 0.5% of the target's maximum health once per second for 15s and reduce defense by 20%. It triggers no more than once every 45s. Against monsters, the flame reduces defense by 40%.) OR Aerial Feints (After receiving damage, there is a 9% chance to reduce all damage taken by 3.5% and increase movement speed by 6.5% for 12 seconds. Triggers no more than once every 5 seconds. Stacks up to 4 times. )

🔥In addition to all this, you can get food, conservation crystals, a refining master’s hammer, essences, ghost coins, spices and much, much more. The full set of rewards is available to those who purchase the Advanced Pass.

🔥You can buy the “Wakamaru” headdress and the “Wandehuru” shoulder accessory from the Battle Pass merchandise merchants for ghost coins.

🔹I'm in! How to participate?🔹

When you first enter the game after the start of the battle season, each of your characters will see an invitation window.

Click the “Start Season” button to join. After this, you can open the season window by clicking on the icon located next to the mini-map.

🔹What needs to be done?🔹

Open the season window. In it you will see a list of tasks. Tasks are divided into those that you can complete once per season, and daily. One-time tasks are chained (complete the current task to start the next one). However, each group of tasks is available at the same time - as you complete simple tasks, new, more complex ones will open up.

🔹I want more rewards and tasks!🔹

Easily! To have access to more tasks and receive more rewards for progress points, you can purchase an extended pass. In addition to these benefits, the pass will also allow you to gain combat experience (progress points) faster. The Extended Pass is purchased once for the entire season and is valid for your entire account. You can become the owner of an extended pass and claim your rewards at any time during the season.

🔹Can I get rewards right now?🔹

If the romance of completing tasks every day bores you, then of course! To speed up the season and gain immediate access to rewards, you can purchase levels (a fixed number of progression points).

The season lasts 28 days and contains 100 levels of progress!
Receive maximum gifts!

We wish you good luck in the new season!

notes.title: Tame Shkeers!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/d953ab96b467cc8356dc9ee319e04d79f1d17360.png[/img]

The last legendary Targoroth dragon was Shkeers. It belonged to the young Prince Aemon, the last Targoroth.
People were dissatisfied with the rule of the ancient family and rebelled. The ship carrying the last surviving members of the Targoroth and several small dragons was supposed to leave for another continent. However, then an angry crowd invaded the harbor and began to kill the guards protecting the ship.

Aemon was about to disembark the ship to fight and allow his family to escape. But Shkeers pulled ahead of him. The dragon bit the ropes that held the ship near the harbor, and he jumped onto the stone pier and, at the cost of his own life, protected the owner and the last representatives of the Targoroth family.

Much water has passed under the bridge since then. The Targoroths never returned. Did they even exist? Legends say yes. But they have already been rewritten so many times that it is unclear what is truth and what is fiction. However, Shkeers is real. And everyone can become his friend.

notes.title: Gastres is looking for an owner!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/3b2c2d651c945be88a44e67fc11128eebb76aec2.png[/img]

Not all Targoroth dragons were large. Some of them stopped developing and remained dragons forever.

Thus, the Gastres dragon was the smallest of the brood. Members of the royal dynasty did not want to take it, so the lizard went to Gartosh Targoroth, a bastard. Because of his background, he could not hold official positions, so he became a master of spies.
In such a craft, the small dragon Gastres came into place. Together with his master, the lizard penetrated enemy castles and started arson, stole artifacts and obtained valuable information about enemies.

Is this story true? No one knows. But the dragon Gastres remains in the past of the Sphere and right now everyone can become its happy owner.

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/b5a19ae5a77c960a86626d3ff860bcfa1dc94a79.png[/img]

Of course, one of the most famous dragonriders was Oneiriss Targoroth. She was the daughter of King Waymon and flew on her dragon along with her brothers and other men of her kind.
But in one of the battles, her dragon died: the demon wizard threw a magic spear and pierced the lizard’s heart. Oneiriss miraculously survived falling into the ocean.
The girl was very attached to her pet, so she ordered a helmet to be created in the form of her dragon, so that she could always carry the memory of him.
Nobody knows how true this legend is. However, helmets resembling dragons are very popular among demons and humans today.

notes.title: Who will win the Ragah's trophy?
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/2c837db86a0308f04ecef607f55068305a0757a5.png[/img]

The Targoroth managed to conquer most of the continent with the help of the largest dragon, Ragah. It is said that it was so huge that its shadow could cover an entire city.

In the decisive battle, Ragah lost his rider, Viseron II Targoroth. After this, the dragon went mad and began to destroy not only his enemies, but also his allies. Targoroth, demons, elves and other warriors had to unite to destroy the lizard.

This was achieved by the legendary demon Lakun, who with his ax managed to break through the strong scales on the dragon’s neck. After Ragah was killed, the battle ended and the armies dispersed to lick their wounds. But Lakun nevertheless beheaded the beast and carried its head over his shoulders as a trophy.
Whether this is true or fiction, no one knows now. However, the honor of wearing Ragah's head on one's back today can fall to anyone.

There is a legend among people and demons about the powerful Targoroth family. For thousands of years they ruled the continent and united all the people of the Sphere. And all thanks to the dragons. Mighty lizards obeyed representatives of this clan, which is why many said that fire flows in the blood of the Targoroths.

Each of the Targoroths had their own dragon. So, Prince Vesmer had the dragon Wincord. The heir to the throne could not walk due to a rare disease, and it was dangerous for him to fly, so his lizard never took to the air. However, this did not stop Vesmer from participating in battles and making a significant contribution to the capture of the continent.

Today no one remembers those battles. And did they exist at all? But everyone remembers dragons. And today everyone can touch that time and become a Vincord rider.

There are rumors that monsters from the Abyss are trying to break into the Enchanted World! Fight them on their own territory and receive unimaginable rewards.

🌀What to do?🌀

From all the monsters in the world of the Sphere you can get the mysterious “echoes of the Abyss”. However, you can only get the bulk of the items by completing quests in a special zone, where you will have to fight various monsters from all corners of the Abyss.

You will be offered 4 quests, which will have to be completed in the dangerous territory of a special zone. There you will be able to compete with representatives of enemy factions, but if you die at the hands of a representative of the opposing faction, you will lose 50% of the echoes.

If you are brave enough, you will meet the most terrible Boss of the Abyss - the Darkness dragon, from whom you can win conservation and strengthening crystals, but keep in mind that he, like all dragons, has the ability to grow and increase his combat power. The more warriors who enter the battle with the boss, the more rewards you will receive in the end, but remember, they will go to only the most worthy of the warriors.

🌀Reward guaranteed!🌀

When you combine fragments of a mysterious egg, you have a chance to get a mysterious egg, which is guaranteed to drop one random pet: a forest lizard, a winged gurinid, an Abyss dragon, a snake catcher, as well as a poisonous, ice or golden dragon.

Also, when combining fragments of a mysterious egg, the character receives the power of dark energies, which increases damage dealt and experience gained and lasts until the end of the event and a week later.

Each time you combine fragments, the character can also receive one of three epic relics with six colorless gem sockets:

💎relic of power - increases the probability of a critical attack by 1.5%, the magnitude of the critical effect by 6%.
💎Relic of Vitality - increases the owner’s stamina by 5% and the amount of healing received by 10%.
💎relic of speed - increases the speed of movement, attack and casting spells by 5%.
Relics, after being placed in an equipment slot, can be placed on the ability panel and have an additional property:
When used, removes the effects of stun, immobilization, sleep, and disarming from the character. Reload time: 150 seconds.

If a character does not receive a relic after 24 attempts to combine fragments, he is guaranteed to receive it on the 25th attempt.

🌀What else?🌀

In the process of combining the echoes of the abyss, you will also receive rewards: teleportation stones, resurrection scrolls, scrolls to improve armor and weapons, and much more.

Every day, the winning faction that united the most echoes will receive a 10% bonus to experience, gold and item drops for the day, and the losing team will receive a 5% bonus to experience and gold.

We remind you that characters with an active premium account have a double chance to knock out abyss shards from monsters! You can purchase additional Abyss materia in the game store.

Good luck!

notes.title: Season "On Distant Shores"
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/3abf8600953a4e6604cbdffa5b131517c6ebe12f.png[/img]

More than a hundred gifts for every Sphere player! The bravest, wisest and noblest warriors of the Sphere are invited to participate in the season of jungle mystery!
 
🔹What season is this?🔹

Essentially this is a set of tasks, for which participation is given progress points. As you accumulate progress points, you will receive sets of useful and sometimes even unique rewards!

🔹Tell us more about the prizes!🔹

🔸Title "Island Conqueror" - increases movement speed by 2.5%, health regeneration by 9%.
🔸Infusion of Windfury - increases attack, spell and movement speed by 5% for 24 hours
🔸Loot collector "Muskan" - moves 60% faster than usual, lasts 30 days.
🔸Groom Token - used to improve the groom's mount.
🔸Pet "Ngira". Its properties are below.
◻️ secretive
◻️ savings
◻️ Level 10 - Exceptional Strength (Increases the owner's strength by 1.6%) OR Exceptional Intelligence (Increases the owner's intelligence by 1.6%)
Level 20 - Greater Fortification (Reduces physical and magical damage received by the wearer by 3.5%) OR Healing Power (Increases received healing and shields by 7.5%)
Level 30 - Exceptional Strength (Increases the owner's strength by 1.6%) OR Exceptional Intelligence (Increases the owner's intelligence by 1.6%)
Level 40 - Nature's Wrath (Increases the owner's ability power by 12% for 10c when receiving a stun, fear, silence, root, sleep or disarm effect. Procs no more than once every 40s.) OR Superior Vigilance (Reduces the chance of being critically hit by 6 ,5%)
Level 50 - Exceptional Agility (Increases the owner's agility by 1.6%) OR Exceptional Wisdom (Increases the owner's wisdom by 1.6%)
Level 60 – Spikes (Reflects 15% of damage received to the enemy.) OR Enhanced Regeneration (Increases the owner’s health regeneration by 140%)

❄️In addition to all this, you can get food, conservation crystals, a refining master’s hammer, essences, ghost coins, spices and much, much more. The full set of rewards is available to those who purchase the Advanced Pass.
 
❄️You can buy the “Wakamaru” headdress and “Wandehuru” shoulder accessory from the Battle Pass merchandise vendors for ghost coins.
 
🔹I'm in! How to participate?🔹

When you first log into the game after the start of the battle season, each of your characters will see an invitation window.
 
Click the “Start Season” button to join. After this, you can open the season window by clicking on the icon located next to the mini-map.
 
🔹What needs to be done?🔹

Open the season window. In it you will see a list of tasks. Tasks are divided into those that you can complete once per season, and daily. One-time tasks are chained (complete the current task to start the next one). However, each group of tasks is available at the same time - as you complete simple tasks, new, more complex ones will open up.

🔹I want more rewards and tasks!🔹

Easily! To have access to more tasks and receive more rewards for progress points, you can purchase an extended pass. In addition to these benefits, the pass will also allow you to gain combat experience (progress points) faster. The Extended Pass is purchased once for the entire season and is valid for your entire account. You can become the owner of an extended pass and claim your rewards at any time during the season.
 
🔹Can I get rewards right now?🔹

If the romance of completing tasks every day bores you, then of course! To speed up the season and gain immediate access to rewards, you can purchase levels (a fixed number of progression points).

The season lasts 28 days and contains 100 levels of progress!
Receive maximum gifts!
 
We wish you good luck in the new season!

notes.title: Crystal fever
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/1019c8d71db614b616373c2c1486236dd42dc694.png[/img]

Jump into the Crystal Rush and be guaranteed to receive one of four epic bracelets with special properties:
🔹Avoidance bracelet - reduces the chance of receiving a critical hit by 6%. Only one avoidance bracelet has an effect at a time.
🔹Resistance bracelet - increases magical defense by 12%. Only one resistance bracelet has the effect at a time.
🔹Strengthening bracelet - increases physical defense by 12%. Only one strengthening bracelet has the effect at a time.
🔹Enhancement bracelet - increases the power of abilities by 4%. Only one boost bracelet can provide the effect at a time.

Crystal fever is coming to the world of the Sphere! Travelers from all over the continent repeat the same thing: the Sphere is filled with mysterious magical crystals that contain various secrets and powers. The loyal soldiers of Vagrot and King Sigurd are already preparing to get as many valuable crystals as possible, but this time not only war, but also real competition awaits everyone.
 
⚡️Awards⚡️

During Crystalmania, factions of humans and demons will begin to chase the power of the crystals. By killing monsters of your level, you have a chance to receive a Tarnished Shard, from a group of which you can create stronger crystals. Each time you combine crystals, you will receive pleasant bonuses.
 
By creating new crystals, you can get:
- items for improvement,
- teleportation stones,
- pet food,
- useful potions,
- cubes of illusions,
- resurrection scrolls.

⚡️Guaranteed prize⚡️

In addition, when you combine Unfinished Crystals, you have a small chance to receive a Crystal Stash containing one of the four Epic Bracelets, and every 25th attempt to combine Unfinished Crystals, you are guaranteed to receive a Crystal Stash!
 
⚡️Useful buffs⚡️

At the end of each day, the faction that has collected more crystals will receive a pleasant bonus to experience, gold and item drops, which will last until the next count.
 
And one more thing. For combining unfinished crystals you will receive a buff that increases the power of abilities by 0.4% and maximum health by 0.7%. The effect stacks up to 40 times, meaning you can increase the power of your abilities by 16% and your maximum health by 28%. The buff is not lost after the death of the character and will remain with you until the end of the event and 1 week after it.
 
⚡️Important details⚡️

To obtain crystals from monsters, your level should not differ from the monster’s level by more than 5 levels.
 
It must be remembered that any representative of the opposing faction can defeat you and take some of the tarnished shards before you turn them into something more useful.
 
While your premium account is active, the chance of Tarnished Shards dropping is doubled.
 
You will need cunning, attentiveness and remarkable perseverance to get as many prizes as possible and defeat your opponents. Well, enough chatter, Crystal Fever is beginning!

notes.title: Make friends with mabuni!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/a35ecd222d49542311ba083730437487941b1164.png[/img]

The Mabuni, or fighting ostriches, live far to the south, on the Dakiru Islands. These mighty birds do not fly, but they can run fast. Thanks to their speed, they are in many ways superior to even the horses we are used to.

Nowadays, for some reasons, it is not easy to purchase mabuni, but some cunning traders bring them deep into the continent. If you're lucky, one of the mabuni will be yours!

Find the mabuni chest in the game store.

Good luck!

And please don't let them bite you. Just in case.

notes.title: Prickly but useful
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/09760db0e80d3c8a4b866f173f03dd20c2b5a3f1.png[/img]

Not only people, but also demons went to the Dakiru Islands. And if the first met cute Muskans, then the second met Dekhins.
 
These are predators whose bodies are strewn with needles. They were not afraid of the huge horned demons and attacked them as soon as they entered their territory. Swords and spears did not pierce the strong needles of the dekhins and the advance of the demons deeper was stopped.
 
However, the demons managed to find out about the weak point of the dekhins - their head. Therefore, they quickly exterminated the animals and occupied one of the islands of Dakiru. The demons took the cubs of the dekhins and began to train them. The Horned Ones wanted to raise them into ideal pets and they succeeded.
 
Dekhins turned out to be very loyal animals to their owner. To hide their only weak point, the demons began making small helmets for them. Thus, they turned the Dekhins into ideal and practically invulnerable defenders.

notes.title: Meet Muskan
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/f3e6af2b225fde15ecdd5c612afa9d82e394efed.png[/img]

The main discovery of the Dakiru Islands for researchers from Erycuria were the cute muscan animals. They are very friendly and curious. In addition, these animals always smile, which is why even the most ferocious predators do not attack them.

Muskans turned out to be easily trained animals, so the discoverers of the islands began to bring them to the continent in large quantities. The animals quickly found work: they became letter carriers and collectors of various items.

Because of their intelligence and devotion to their master, the Muskans helped preserve the royal dynasty in Erycuria. During the palace coup staged by Charles the Forsaken, smiling animals carried letters between the king in exile and his loyal people who remained in the palace. This allowed the rightful ruler to plan a successful attack and regain the throne.
The Muskans, who helped the king regain power, were given special helmets as insignia. At the same time, all Muskans in Erycuria became inviolable creatures and their murder is punishable by death.

notes.title: What you need to know about vandehuru
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/a1072dd63bea3fe5f2487182a1261fb4d49d834b.png[/img]

The inhabitants of the Dakiru Islands surprised the discoverers with their culture. To show their status in society, they wear a vandekhura, a headdress made of hair and feathers. The longer and larger the feathers, the higher the position the person occupies.

On the continent, this headdress became a way to show one's wealth. The first vandekhuru imported cost a lot of money, and only nobles could afford them. Within a few years, human and demon craftsmen began making their own vanderhoorus, causing their value to plummet.

However, this vandehuru is original, produced by the Dakiru Islanders. Such headdresses are still valuable, especially among lovers of the islanders' culture.

notes.title: The story of wakamaru
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/312dff07ffc5fdd3971cf9e781c7965aa1f4a08b.png[/img]

The tribes of the Dakiru Islands are famous for their ingenuity. Instead of carrying their weapons separately, they created unusual shields called wakamaru.

They differ in that they have recesses into which a small club and a spear can be installed. This allows warriors from the Dakiru Islands to easily adapt to the situation on the battlefield.

For people and demons from the continent, the wakamaru turned out to be useless. They tried to make a similar shield out of steel, but it turned out to be too heavy. Therefore, the wakamaru has become a decoration that can be hung on the wall of your estate or worn on your back.

notes.title: Beware of mabuni!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/e56afde6a2668d6adf6d70aa0bf0d1ba41b4a2c3.png[/img]

Far to the south, on the Dakiru Islands, you can find unusual birds. Locals call them mabuni. These majestic birds are not able to fly, but they can run fast. When they began to be brought to the continent, the mabuni quickly began to displace the horses that were familiar to many due to their speed.
The fleet-footed birds could have completely supplanted the ungulates if one of the mabuni had not accidentally bitten the young heir to the throne of Erycuria. The prince was seriously ill after this and only two years later was he able to fully recover. The king carefully weighed all the risks, and as a result banned the import of mabuni to the continent.
Today, the bird can only be purchased from smugglers on the black market. You just need to remember that if a mabuni bites you, you can get seriously ill. And the treatment will be very long.

notes.title: Jungle Mystery Season
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/16f685b7872b424ea16837766811bfb208ad0e9a.png[/img]

More than a hundred gifts for every Sphere player! The bravest, wisest and noblest warriors of the Sphere are invited to participate in the season of jungle mystery!
 
🔹What season is this?🔹

Essentially, this is a set of tasks, for which participation is given progress points. As you accumulate progress points, you will receive sets of useful and sometimes even unique rewards!

🔹Tell us more about the prizes!🔹

🔸Title "Birdcatcher" - increases the chance of a critical attack by 0.6%, the speed of attack and ability use by 1%.
🔸Infusion of Windfury - increases attack, spell and movement speed by 5% for 24 hours
🔸Loot collector "Maki-maki" - moves 60% faster than usual, lasts 30 days.
🔸Groom Token - used to improve the groom’s mount.
🔸Pet "Moki-maki". Its properties are below.
◻️ beast
◻️ luck
◻️ Level 10 - Exceptional Agility (Increases the owner's agility by 1.6%) OR Exceptional Wisdom (Increases the owner's wisdom by 1.6%)
◻️ Level 20 - Tireless (Increases movement, attack and casting speed by 6%.) OR Light Step (Increases the wearer's movement speed by 10%)
◻️ Level 30 - Exceptional Agility (Increases the owner's agility by 1.6%) OR Exceptional Wisdom (Increases the owner's wisdom by 1.6%)
◻️ Level 40 - Superior Vigilance (Reduces chance of being critically hit by 6.5%) OR Precision (Increases chance of being critically hit by 2.5%)
◻️ Level 50 - Exceptional Agility (Increases the owner's agility by 1.6%) OR Exceptional Wisdom (Increases the owner's wisdom by 1.6%)
◻️ Level 60 - Treasure Sense (Increases the chance of items dropping when killing monsters by 10%, the amount of gold dropped by 15%) OR Elusiveness (Reduces the chance of receiving a critical hit by 13%.)

❄️In addition to all this, you can get food, conservation crystals, a refining master’s hammer, essences, ghost coins, spices and much, much more. The full set of rewards is available to those who purchase the Advanced Pass.
 
❄️You can buy a skirmisher’s helmet and a forge of the great hunt from battle pass goods merchants for ghost coins.
 
🔹I'm in! How to participate?🔹

When you first enter the game after the start of the battle season, each of your characters will see an invitation window.
 
Click the “Start Season” button to join. After this, you can open the season window by clicking on the icon located next to the mini-map.
 
🔹What needs to be done?🔹

Open the season window. In it you will see a list of tasks. Tasks are divided into those that you can complete once per season, and daily. One-time tasks are chained (complete the current task to start the next one). However, each group of tasks is available at the same time - as you complete simple tasks, new, more complex ones will open up.

🔹I want more rewards and tasks!🔹

Easily! To have access to more tasks and receive more rewards for progress points, you can purchase an extended pass. In addition to these benefits, the pass will also allow you to gain combat experience (progress points) faster. The Extended Pass is purchased once for the entire season and is valid for your entire account. You can become the owner of an extended pass and claim your rewards at any time during the season.
 
🔹Can I get rewards right now?🔹

If the romance of completing tasks every day bores you, then of course! To speed up the season and gain instant access to rewards, you can purchase levels (a fixed number of progression points).

The season lasts 28 days and contains 100 levels of progress!
Receive maximum gifts!
 
We wish you good luck in the new season!

notes.title: The story of moki-maki
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/364f2e649fa1850f6efac36e0e8e13cd5f25bd10.png[/img]

In the jungle, everyone survives in their own way. If the maki-maki became fast and nimble, then their relatives, the moki-maki, took a different path: they began to flock together and support each other. Over time, these large monkeys began to help other animals to achieve their goals. Local tribes noticed this and began using moki maki to track prey or explore the area.

When scientists found out about this, they began to actively export moki-maki from the jungle. Now the nobility uses animals in their palaces as servants. Adventurers also know about the skills of moki-maki and even take them with them on hikes, where the monkeys help in battles.

notes.title: Who are maki-maki?
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/d1087c5b9ffb4b22df19e8d2fc3437ad9e5e34d6.png[/img]

In the jungle you can also meet cute and harmless representatives of the local fauna. For example, little maki-maki monkeys. These nimble animals quickly jump over trees and easily hide from predators. But they are very trusting, so you can easily catch them using sweets.

Despite their small size, maki maki are very intelligent monkeys and are easy to train. Some masters taught maki-maki simple commands. Thanks to this, monkeys can collect objects and bring them to their owner. But the price for such trained maki-maki is appropriate.

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/1a85c188aaae64c6c4d9c4c0958969f35ed5adf2.png[/img]

In the jungle you can find not only dangerous predators or monsters. There are also birds there. Their trills fascinated and attracted researchers, who described the birds in detail in their books.
 
As soon as books with unusual jungle animals were published, bird hunters appeared. They collected birds in these kind of houses: they are convenient to carry with them and enjoy the birdsong.

notes.title: The story of pagari
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/927542c3773d09571e8d8aa22a07a9d8968b2b5f.png[/img]

The main headdress of all jungle explorers was pagari - pieces of dense fabric covering the head. Nowadays it is just a beautiful accessory, but previously it had a practical purpose.

The first expedition that went into the jungle encountered many dangers: snakes, animated trees, Ngeru Nui and others. Scientists found salvation from a local tribe who wore pagaris on their heads. Runes were inscribed on the inside of the fabric, which protected the savages.
Months later, the explorers returned home with a pagari on their heads. Not only the king, but also the courtiers liked the headdress, so they began to order the same ones for themselves. Naturally, there are no runes on them. But wearing such a headdress makes you a real jungle explorer.

notes.title: The story of Ngeru Nui
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/441270066ddf9102a62f946a316060becc09a01b.png[/img]

The jungle is a very dangerous and mysterious place. In addition to poisonous plants and toads, big cats, or, as the locals call them, ngeru nui, hide in the treetops. These dangerous predators move almost silently and are able to sneak up close to their prey and then strike.

Many explorers died before we were able to obtain records of these graceful hunters. However, as the late jungle explorer Jerome Savoyo discovered, the temper of the Ngeru Nui can be curbed. To do this, you need to raise a big cat from childhood. The main thing is to make friends with the cat. In this case, Ngeru Nui will even allow you to climb on his back.

Today, many people go into the jungle to get Ngeru Nui kittens. Not everyone succeeds, so this mount is very rare and exotic. But everyone who has ever ridden on the back of a big cat knows that Ngeru Nui is worth the money.

notes.title: Season of the Wasteland Hunter
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/ebed7e6082cb275e8713c6681ad7412b32ac44c1.png[/img]

More than a hundred gifts for every Sphere player! The bravest, wisest and noblest warriors of the Sphere are invited to participate in the Season of the Wasteland Hunter!
 
🔹What season is this?🔹

Essentially, this is a set of tasks, for which participation is given progress points. As you accumulate progress points, you will receive sets of useful and sometimes even unique rewards!

🔹Tell us more about the prizes!🔹

🔸The title “Hunter of the Wasteland” - increases the chance of items falling out of monsters and increases physical defense by 3%.
🔸Infusion of Windfury - increases attack, spell and movement speed by 5% for 24 hours
🔸Loot collector "Messenger Mastiff" - moves 60% faster than usual, lasts 30 days.
🔸Groom Token - used to improve the groom’s mount.
🔸Pet "Mastiff" Its properties are below.
◻️ strong
◻️ savings
◻️ Level 10 - Exceptional Stamina (Increases the wearer's stamina by 1.6%) OR Exceptional Spirit (Increases the wearer's spirit by 1.6%)
◻️ Level 20 - Superior Vigilance (Reduces chance of being critically hit by 6.5%) OR Healing Power (Increases healing and shields received by 7.5%)
◻️ Level 30 - Exceptional Stamina (Increases the wearer's stamina by 1.6%) OR Exceptional Spirit (Increases the wearer's spirit by 1.6%)
◻️ level 40 - Increasing anger (When attacked with a 6% chance, increases the speed of attack and trying on the owner’s abilities by 6% for 13s. Stacks up to 5 times.) OR Increasing strength (When receiving damage with a 6% chance, increases the owner’s defense by 6% for 14 seconds. Stacks up to 5 times.)
◻️ Level 50 - Exceptional Stamina (Increases the wearer's stamina by 1.6%) OR Exceptional Spirit (Increases the wearer's spirit by 1.6%)
◻️ level 60 - Return (After receiving fatal damage, the owner recovers 30% of the maximum amount of health. Triggers no more than 1 time in 3 minutes.) OR Greater Wound Healing (During battle, restores the owner 85% of his normal health regeneration value)

❄️In addition to all this, you can get food, conservation crystals, a refining master’s hammer, essences, ghost coins, spices and much, much more. The full set of rewards is available to those who purchase the Advanced Pass.
 
❄️You can buy a skirmisher’s helmet and a forge of the great hunt from battle pass goods merchants for ghost coins.
 
🔹I'm in! How to participate?🔹

When you first enter the game after the start of the battle season, each of your characters will see an invitation window.
 
Click the “Start Season” button to join. After this, you can open the season window by clicking on the icon located next to the mini-map.
 
🔹What needs to be done?🔹

Open the season window. In it you will see a list of tasks. Tasks are divided into those that you can complete once per season, and daily. One-time tasks are chained (complete the current task to start the next one). However, each group of tasks is available at the same time - as you complete simple tasks, new, more complex ones will open up.

🔹I want more rewards and tasks!🔹

Easily! To have access to more tasks and receive more rewards for progress points, you can purchase an extended pass. In addition to these benefits, the pass will also allow you to gain combat experience (progress points) faster. The Extended Pass is purchased once for the entire season and is valid for your entire account. You can become the owner of an extended pass and claim your rewards at any time during the season.
 
🔹Can I get rewards right now?🔹

If the romance of completing tasks every day bores you, then of course! To speed up the season and gain instant access to rewards, you can purchase levels (a fixed number of progression points).

The season lasts 28 days and contains 100 levels of progress!
Receive maximum gifts!
 
We wish you good luck in the new season!
