notes.title: History of the Mastiff
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/4cdb8e57a8eedd9a0cb8d97a29c948a1b4e2806c.png[/img]

Any hunter needs a faithful and reliable companion who will help in trouble, will not let him freeze on a cold night, and in case of trouble will be able to call for help. But hunters most often travel alone, because where two pairs of eyes are looking for prey, both will be left with nothing. At least there is such a sign. Fate cannot be tested to the limit - this is the law in the wastelands.

But a good hunter will always find a way out. And therefore, special companion animals, mastiffs, were bred in the wastelands. These distant relatives of snow wolves are not at all similar to their ancestors - their dark fur always makes them stand out against the snow, but makes them practically invisible on the rocky plains. Heavy muzzle, powerful paws, impressive build, shaggy coat and quarrelsome character. This is how a wanderer who saw him from the outside would describe the mastiff. This dog truly inspires respect, and sometimes fear, in those who encounter him for the first time. However, outsiders rarely see mastiffs.

Skirmishers who go hunting always take their faithful dog with them. Contrary to their appearance, mastiffs are quite harmless and extremely loyal to their owner and his family. They never stray far from their owner, guard his sleep at night, and willingly ride small children on their powerful backs. However, for strangers and for hunted prey, the mastiff has long fangs and jaws that can gnaw through the backbone of a mouflon.

In some settlements, mastiffs are bred, and their puppies can sometimes be found in bazaars and in the Valley of Cold, and even much further south - all the way to the mysterious Ketam Ai. If you happen to become the owner of a mastiff, know that this is not an ordinary dog, its respect must be earned. But if you manage to do this, then you will never find a truer companion. Wherever you go, no matter how difficult it is for you, he will always and everywhere follow you and protect you from any troubles.

notes.title: Skirmisher Helm
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/547d19c1ca9ac563ade2ed9c2db76b18f11891c2.png[/img]

Many tribes and peoples inhabit the northern plains and ridges. The bone hunters who settled along the shores of the frozen sea dug deep into the frozen wasteland. A little further south live the hunters of the wasteland, inhabitants of the endless plains stretching from the icy mountains to the northern borders of Erikuria and Tir Tuaid.

The inhabitants of the wastelands, like their neighbors, live in small communities and engage in trades, the first and most important of which, of course, is hunting. Hunters are respected here, and their traditions are respected and strictly followed. Skirmishers are especially respected - experienced trackers and skilled trappers. They travel alone for long periods of time through the wastelands, setting snares, and invariably return with rich prey.

During the great hunt, skirmishers arm themselves with a bunch of darts, mount a trusty mouflon and ride in the vanguard, driving down the most important game. It is from among the skirmishers that the hunter is selected who at the right moment will blow the bugle, calling on the others to begin the race.
Skirmishers on a great hunt can always be distinguished from other horsemen, because they always wear their bronze pointed helmets. Other hunters prefer leather to bronze, but skirmishers remain true to themselves.

Nobody knows how to forge such helmets in the wastelands, and where hunters got them from is a big question. Perhaps they were brought by traders from the distant south and exchanged for furs, or perhaps they remained with the inhabitants of the wastelands from those distant times when people began their campaign against Erycuria hundreds of years ago. Then the skirmishers walked in the vanguard of the human army and were the first to step into uncharted territories, just as now they are the first to rush forward to the sound of a bronze horn.

notes.title: Horn of the Great Hunt
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/cf3695fbf977bb312ee38b6bbf9065fcc7744c97.png[/img]

Spring is beginning. The snow is gradually melting, reluctantly giving way to the first green sprouts reaching towards the sun. Animals come out of their winter quarters and leave the dark forest thickets. The whole earth comes to life. And the piercing sound of a bugle echoes above it, heralding the beginning of the great hunt.

This has been the custom since ancient times - with the first rays of the spring sun, wasteland hunters saddle their horses and chase their first prey. Those who honor traditions say that this first hunt of the new year is the most important, because its outcome determines how successful the hunt will be before the next cold weather. If hunters bring rich prey, then the year will go well, and the winter will be satisfying, but if not... They usually don’t talk about it out loud.

Many consider all this to be superstition and a relic of the distant past, but the hunters themselves will never allow themselves to go against this tradition. However, hunters are extremely superstitious.

The great hunt always begins with the most experienced skirmisher blowing a bronze horn, giving the command to the others. The Horn of the Great Hunt is a relic treasured by every wasteland settlement. It is passed down from generation to generation - from one hunter to another. Its sound is so strong that it carries for many miles and hangs in the air for a long time after the hunt has already begun.

If you once hear the sound of the bugle of the great hunt, know that somewhere nearby, through the spring fog, a cavalcade of horsemen is rushing, driving the beast. They gallop quickly, and the bows and spears in their hands hit without missing a beat. And it’s better not to stand in their way on this day.

notes.title: Pioneer Story
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/1309d0070b2bbdfcf4b6c15ee1214962233f1051.png[/img]

Few animals can compare with the mouflon in endurance and tenacity. This huge ram with curled horns rightfully bears the glory of the pioneer of the wasteland. Not the lightest on his feet, inferior in speed to southern horses, he is capable of tirelessly moving forward day and night - through rocky plains, windbreaks and impassable mountain ranges.
 
Wasteland dwellers tame mouflons and use them as mounts. Many hunters also choose them as companions and value them very much for their tenacity. However, taming a mouflon is oh so difficult. First you need to track down the young Aries in the ridges. Then he needs to be caught, and woe to the hunter who throws a rope over the horns of the beast, forgetting to untie its other end from his hand! Everyone knows that a rope must be tied to a stone or a strong tree, otherwise you won’t be able to collect the bones. And when a mouflon is caught, you need to wait until it is exhausted. And the wait may drag on for several days.
 
The exhausted mouflon needs to be saddled and waited until he gets to his feet and tries to throw the annoying rider off his back. If the hunter manages to stay on the back of an angry animal during a frantic race, the mouflon will humble himself and begin to obey his rider. It is on such tamed rams that skirmishers ride during the great hunt.
 
Rare traders who venture north sometimes buy mighty rams from the inhabitants of the wastelands, although this does not happen often. However, sometimes in the southern markets you can meet grooms offering the heroes to buy real pioneers of the wasteland - for hard cash, of course.
 
And even if it was not you who tracked down and tamed the tireless mouflon, he remembers how he was once caught and restrained, and will obey you wherever you send him. Tirelessly, he will carry you forward, through all obstacles. And you just grab his horns tighter, so that if necessary, you won’t have to catch up with the stubborn beast on foot.

notes.title: Season of the Bonehunter
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/bf0b02654f4e02b7351047ea3dc0559722b6ad17.png[/img]

More than a hundred gifts for every Sphere player! The bravest, wisest and noblest warriors of the Sphere are invited to participate in the season of the bonehunter!
 
🔹What season is this?🔹

Essentially, this is a set of tasks, for which participation is given progress points. As you accumulate progress points, you will receive sets of useful and sometimes even unique rewards!

🔹Tell us more about the prizes!🔹

❄️The title "Bonehunter" - increases the chance of items dropping from monsters and the amount of crafting materials picked up by 3%.
❄️Infusion of Windfury - increases attack, spell and movement speed by 5% for 24 hours
❄️Loot collector “Tamed Peregrine Falcon” - moves 60% faster than usual, lasts 30 days.
❄️Groom Token - used to improve the groom’s mount.
❄️Pet "Hunting Peregrine Falcon" Its properties are below.
◻️ crusher
◻️ skill
◻️ Level 10 - Exceptional Agility (Increases the owner's agility by 1.6%) OR Exceptional Wisdom (Increases the owner's wisdom by 1.6%)
◻️level 20 - Light Step (Increases the wearer's movement speed by 10%) OR Tireless (Increases the speed of movement, attack and casting spells by 6%.)
◻️ Level 30 - Exceptional Agility (Increases the owner's agility by 1.6%) OR Exceptional Wisdom (Increases the owner's wisdom by 1.6%)
◻️ Level 40 - Great Flame of the Warrior (Increases the owner's movement and attack speed by 7.5%) OR Great Flame of the Wizard (Increases the speed of movement and use of abilities of the owner by 7.5%)
◻️ Level 50 - Exceptional Agility (Increases the owner's agility by 1.6%) OR Exceptional Wisdom (Increases the owner's wisdom by 1.6%)
◻️ level 60 - Sky Shroud (Reduces damage received by the owner and allies within a radius of 12 meters by 4.5%) OR Aerial Feints (After receiving damage with a 9% chance, reduces all damage taken by 3.5% and increases movement speed by 6.5% for 12 seconds. Triggers no more than once every 5 seconds. Stacks up to 4 times.)

❄️In addition to all this, you can get food, conservation crystals, a refining master’s hammer, essences, ghost coins, spices and much, much more. The full set of rewards is available to those who purchase the Advanced Pass.
 
❄️You can buy a Bonehunter Helmet and a Hunting Bow from Battle Pass goods merchants for Ghost Coins.
 
🔹I'm in! How to participate?🔹

When you first enter the game after the start of the battle season, each of your characters will see an invitation window.
 
Click the “Start Season” button to join. After this, you can open the season window by clicking on the icon located next to the mini-map.
 
🔹What needs to be done?🔹

Open the season window. In it you will see a list of tasks. Tasks are divided into those that you can complete once per season, and daily. One-time tasks are chained (complete the current task to start the next one). However, each group of tasks is available at the same time - as you complete simple tasks, new, more complex ones will open up.

Easily! To have access to more tasks and receive more rewards for progress points, you can purchase an extended pass. In addition to these benefits, the pass will also allow you to gain combat experience (progress points) faster. The Extended Pass is purchased once for the entire season and is valid for your entire account. You can become the owner of an extended pass and claim your rewards at any time during the season.
 
🔹Can I get rewards right now?🔹

If the romance of completing tasks every day bores you, then of course! To speed up the season and gain instant access to rewards, you can purchase levels (a fixed number of progression points).

The season lasts 28 days and contains 100 levels of progress!
Receive maximum gifts!
 
We wish you good luck in the new season!

notes.title: Legend of the hunting bow
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/0525b95ee4ae0f91fe0938b60043367ff5390335.png[/img]

Every hunter needs a bow. Northerners think so. A real hunter is like a frosty snake - he lurks for a long time, and then strikes for sure. And if the game is large and fast, he chases it until it is exhausted, and then stings with one sure attack. After all, there is no one more dangerous than a hunted animal; it does not forgive mistakes.

Bone miners believe that a hunter needs only a bow and a knife for his craft. They despise traps, snares and wolf pits. The last ones especially. Hunting is always a one-on-one duel. Otherwise there will be no honor in the hunt. And northern hunters put their honor above all else.

For a hunter, a bow is not only a tool of his craft, it is his faithful friend and adviser who will never betray and will always lend a shoulder. Northerners make bows from brown snow birch - brittle and capricious wood. They don’t make houses out of it - after all, the roof will tend to collapse on the head of the unlucky builder. And in general, brown birch is only suitable for firewood. If you don't know how to talk to her.

First you need to find a special tree - not straight and slender, but twisted into three deaths, buried by an avalanche and resurrected in the spring. The future bow should be guessed in the tree trunk itself, in its knots, cracks and bends. When you have found a suitable birch tree, you should ask its will to become a friend to the hunter, and after the answer, if it, of course, agrees, cut it at the root, and fill the roots with pitch - each onion should have roots immersed in the frozen soil of the northern wastelands.

Then a bow is turned from a single trunk so that its body consists of a twisted and knotted core. The workpiece is then wrapped in cloth soaked in fat and honey from killer bees, as well as sprinkled with fresh thawed earth and the ashes of a sacrificial fire, and then buried five spans into the ground and left for a whole year. After this, the onions are dug up, peeled, polished and smoked over low heat. And then they wrap it again in greased cloth and bury it in the ground again until spring, and only then take it out and put a bowstring on it. Such a bow will never break in the hands of a hunter, will not fail and will never send an arrow past the target.

The string for a hunting bow is woven from wolf hair, women's hair and birch bark. This unites the three worlds that the northerners believe in - the world of the living, the world of animals and the earth, which many consider the world of the dead. Such a bowstring will never break and will never hit the hunter’s hand. Unless he points his bow at the defenseless.

The northerners believe in this, and invariably follow the traditions of making their bows. Scientific minds have long proven that it is impossible to make weapons from brown birch, however, all the samples that they were able to obtain from a tribe of bone hunters showed that they are in no way inferior in strength and strength to modern compound bows, and in accuracy and speed of arrow flight are far superior to them. However, when tested in battle, these bows instantly broke, and their fragments crumbled to dust before the arrow flew off the string.

A northern hunter would say that a bow is needed for hunting, not for battle, that they kill with it only out of necessity, and not for the sake of anything else, that honest hunting is the only way. But who will seriously listen to northern hunters who believe in fairy tales and make bows from brown birch?
Decide for yourself who to believe. But this hunting bow, made of brown birch, in an embroidered quiver with a dozen arrows feathered with peregrine falcon feathers is yours. Who knows, maybe he will bring you luck in your hunt. I believe in it.

notes.title: The Legend of the Hunting Peregrine Falcon
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/dd53477b8adf4df8db45a3a30446c817b181e9d1.png[/img]

They say that a true hunter must have the eye of a falcon. And how else can a hunter see his prey and shoot a sure arrow right into its heart! Many people say so, but northerners sincerely believe it.
 
After the hunter has proven his skill and tenacity in pursuit of the pioneer of the wasteland, he sets off for the snowy mountains on the coast of the marginal sea. Yes, yes, the north only seems flat - in fact, there are many mountain ranges there, one higher than the other! And somewhere there, high in the mountains, live true hunters, whose skill others can only strive for, but will never achieve it. And the young bone hunter must overcome deep gorges, terrible glaciers and frozen cliffs to reach the sharp peaks on which peregrine falcons build their nests.
 
Peregrine falcons are small birds, inconspicuous and inconspicuous. And this is their strength: they are impossible to see against the background of gray rocks and gray ice as they circle in the sky above an unsuspecting victim. Peregrine falcons wait until the prey is at one point known to them, and then fold their wings and fly down. They rush towards the victim like lightning, and the air behind them collapses - as if thunder thunders from a clear sky. And no one can escape their blow.
 
It is for the peregrine falcon eggs that bone hunters go to the mountains. They carefully hide a single egg in their bosom, leave a piece of raw meat in the nest, and then go down to their village. They must carry this egg through all the dangers, without damaging or breaking it, and then keep it warm until the chick hatches. They then feed and raise the peregrine falcon, who recognizes them as his parents.
 
A hunter who manages to catch a peregrine falcon is considered a master of his craft. His eyes no longer know fatigue, his hand never misses. A bird circling in the sky above him allows him to see the world with his own eyes. And his arrow will always hit the target, like the claws of a northern falcon, falling down like lightning. Northerners believe this.
 
Who knows, maybe the eyes of true bone hunters are really like those of a bird? We can only guess, looking at their helmets with bone masks that reliably hide their faces from the evil wind. And from curious glances.

notes.title: Bonehunter Helm
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/c13655bc817c0aefb367d9c6aa4c24d78c9caf83.png[/img]

The north is harsh and merciless, and proof of this is the harsh snowstorms driving ice chips along the coast of the marginal sea. These winds tear clothes, cut flesh like a whip and blind the unwary who did not have time to cover his eyes with his hand.
 
There is also the sun - scorching, scorching, but at the same time cold. It doesn't heat, but it burns. Reflected in the eternal ice, it blinds anyone who dares to peer into the distance for too long and too intently.
 
But a hunter needs a keen eye!
 
In order to protect the face and eyes from the terrible northern winds and the scorching cold fire of the sun, the helmets of bone hunters appeared. Tanned leather reliably protects against razor-sharp floes of ice rushing over the ground, and bone masks with narrow slits shade the eyes and save them from blindness.
 
Another distinctive feature of these helmets are the trophy tusks that hunters attach to their temples. The luckier the hunter, the bolder and more agile he is, the more tusks on his helmet. They have, however, another purpose. An experienced hunter can hear his prey from many miles away by placing his ear to the ground, and the tusks enhance the hunter's hearing many times over.
 
Many helmets have a broken right tusk, and there is an explanation for this. First, after the hunter receives his first helmet, he must traditionally go to the mountains, find the ice mouflon, this pioneer of the wastelands, and fight him in fair combat. Often the tusks on the helmet break, and if this happens, the hunter is recognized by his tribe. Especially if he brings mouflon horns to the village. And secondly, the right tusk is often deliberately ground down so that it does not interfere with archery. So it turns out that experienced bone miners have a broken tusk attached to their helmet, and when talking, they invariably stand half-turned towards the interlocutor - and always with their left ear towards him.
 
However, despite the difficulty in making and even some sacred meaning of their helmets, the northerners do not consider them something special. It's just a necessary tool in their craft. In addition, artisans always make helmets with a supply, and there are always enough daredevils ready to fight a mouflon in the icy wastelands. So the extra helmets, no, no, and end up on the markets of the southern lands. In the south there is no need to hide your eyes behind a bone mask and break through the snow with your tusk in order to reach the ground and hear your prey, but fashion is fashion. And there is always a demand for exotic things.
Try on this bonehunter helmet, my dear customer! I'm telling you for sure, it suits you! Don't hesitate to take it. At the very least, you will tell your grandchildren tales about how you collided with the pioneer of the wasteland and walked away victorious! I'm sure they will be delighted!

notes.title: The story of the Snow Wolf
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/b8e609a7b19d3d7d69efcbc45b8617bcb8daef90.png[/img]

Anyone who has ever heard a wolf howl under a full moon will tell you that their blood ran cold from this drawn-out, melancholy music that reverberated off the cold rocks and penetrated right under the skin.
 
Many people, and some demons, are afraid of wolves, considering them ruthless predators who will not fail to surround a lone wanderer and tear him to shreds. But there are few who have actually encountered wolves. They will most likely tell you that if you are afraid of wolves, do not go into the forest, and that gray predators will most likely run away at the sight of a terrible two-legged monster. Especially if this monster suddenly has a longer stick in his hands. However, wolves are different from wolves.
 
Among the northerners there are dark legends about huge and fierce snow wolves. They appear only at night, come along with a blizzard, and the next morning they disappear without a trace. Except for the traces of the bones of their victims. Legends say that snow wolves are huge, fearless and ferocious, and their eyes glow with an otherworldly yellow fire in the darkness of the night. Seeing a snowy samum in the distance, the northerners close the shutters and turn off the lights in order to ward off trouble and not attract snow wolves. However, legends are only meant to be exaggerated. One way or another, there are no real eyewitnesses of an attack by snow wolves. For natural reasons, one must think...
 
However, sometimes you can meet rare bone hunters on your way. This small tribe lives farthest in the north, on the coast of the eternally frozen sea. They don't like to talk about themselves, but others talk a lot about them. They say that hunters travel across the ice that compresses the outlying waters, and track down unprecedented creatures that have no name. Some people think that these are nimble snow leopards, others that they are gigantic hairy elephants with tusks capable of breaking centuries-old ice floes, although it is clear to the ignorant that there are no hairy or fanged elephants in the world, and some even say about ice dragons. But who the rare bone miners actually hunt remains a mystery, while the bone itself is regularly supplied to the markets of the southern lands.
 
One thing is certain about these hunters - they invariably travel on the backs of huge wolves with yellow eyes. Such a wolf can run non-stop for days on end, chasing down prey. And the more wolves in the pack, the more coordinated and quickly they overtake the target. These wolves do not know fatigue, they are unfamiliar with pity, and they do not recognize anyone except their rider. Some believe that these are the legendary snow predators, tamed by hunters, while others do not believe this. But everyone unanimously agrees with the name that the hunters themselves call their animals - tireless pursuers.
 
Sometimes, in a good year for adventurers, bone hunters bring with them the puppies of their tireless pursuers to auction and sell them to the heroes. If you are lucky enough to get such an animal, and have the patience to feed and raise it, then know that it will become your devoted friend and will rush you through any obstacles towards your goal.
 
The main thing is not to put your hands in his mouth, and make sure that he looks less into the forest. Just in case. It certainly won't be superfluous.

notes.title: Season of the Northern Shaman
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/56a2e26d7b9c846b2b0026c2a448ce98a5d3686e.png[/img]

More than a hundred gifts for every Sphere player! The bravest, wisest and noblest warriors of the Sphere are invited to participate in the season of the northern shaman!

🔹What season is this?🔹

Essentially, this is a set of tasks, for which participation is given progress points. As you accumulate progress points, you will receive sets of useful and sometimes even unique rewards!

🔹Tell us more about the prizes!🔹

❄️Title "Northern Shaman" - increases movement speed by 2.5%, endurance by 3%.
❄️Infusion of Windfury - increases attack, spell and movement speed by 5% for 24 hours
❄️Groom Token - used to improve the groom’s mount.
❄️Loot collector "Rusak" - moves 60% faster than usual, lasts 30 days.

❄️Pet "Moon Hare". Its properties are below.
◻️ fast
◻️ speed
◻️ Level 10 - Exceptional Agility (Increases the owner's agility by 1.6%) OR Exceptional Wisdom (Increases the owner's wisdom by 1.6%)
◻️ Level 20 - Greater Wound Healing (During combat, restores the wearer to 50% of their normal health regeneration value) OR Accelerated Recovery (Increases the wearer's energy regeneration, magical or necrotic energy by 15%)
◻️ Level 30 - Exceptional Agility (Increases the owner's agility by 1.6%) OR Exceptional Wisdom (Increases the owner's wisdom by 1.6%)
◻️ level 40 - Shadow Prism (When dealing a critical hit, gives invisibility for 3s. Movement speed in this state increases by 25%. Triggers no more than once every 60s) OR Prismatic Shield (After receiving damage, with a 5% chance, removes 1 negative effect from the owner . Triggers no more than once every 30s.)
◻️ Level 50 - Exceptional Agility (Increases the owner's agility by 1.6%) OR Exceptional Wisdom (Increases the owner's wisdom by 1.6%)
◻️ Level 60 - Celerity (Increases the owner's movement speed by 22%.) OR Moon's Power (After a critical hit, the owner's abilities cost 25% less for 10s. Triggers no more than once every 60s.)

❄️In addition to all this, you can get food, conservation crystals, a refining master’s hammer, essences, ghost coins, spices and much, much more. The full set of rewards is available to those who purchase the Advanced Pass.
 
❄️You can buy a northern shaman's hat and a northern shaman's tambourine from battle pass goods merchants for ghost coins.
 
🔹I'm in! How to participate?🔹

When you first enter the game after the start of the battle season, each of your characters will see an invitation window.
 
Click the “Start Season” button to join. After this, you can open the season window by clicking on the icon located next to the mini-map.
 
🔹What needs to be done?🔹

Open the season window. In it you will see a list of tasks. Tasks are divided into those that you can complete once per season, and daily. One-time tasks are chained (complete the current task to start the next one). However, each group of tasks is available at the same time - as you complete simple tasks, new, more complex ones will open up.

🔹I want more rewards and tasks!🔹

Easily! To have access to more tasks and receive more rewards for progress points, you can purchase an extended pass. In addition to these benefits, the pass will also allow you to gain combat experience (progress points) faster. The Extended Pass is purchased once for the entire season and is valid for your entire account. You can become the owner of an extended pass and claim your rewards at any time during the season.

If the romance of completing tasks every day bores you, then of course! To speed up your progress through the Battle Season and instantly gain access to rewards, you can purchase levels (a fixed number of progress points).
 
🔹How long does the season last?🔹

The battle season lasts 28 days and contains 100 levels of progress!
Receive maximum gifts!
 
We wish you good luck in the new season!

notes.title: Nothern Shaman's Tambourine
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/35f096f38ff78001628088b942beb797471c461a.png[/img]

Every shaman must have his own tambourine, this is the law. The tambourine is the voice of the shaman, his companion and the first guide to the world of spirits. This is not just a flat drum with a mallet, oh no, the tambourine is a living creature, or rather, a dwelling for a small spirit. This is true, at least if we are talking about a real shamanic tambourine, and not about a souvenir craft bought from a passing peddler in the Village of the Frost Tribe.
 
These tambourines - real and souvenir - have a lot in common. For example, you can knock on them in the same way. They also have beautiful fur upholstery and a wooden cross to make it comfortable to hold the instrument. Well, the drawing, yes.
 
The pattern on the membrane of the tambourine is literally a story being told. On the most ancient tambourines they depicted scenes of hunting and everyday life, painted various animals, trees, mountains, rivers, stars... But then the plots began to change. The shamans were no longer drawing small sketches, they were trying to draw the very structure of the world! Some succeeded, some did not, but you and I hardly have the right to judge how competently some shaman transferred onto his tightly stretched skin what was revealed to him during his travels to other worlds. One thing is certain - the more powerful the shaman, the more accurately he remembered and reproduced what he saw.
 
And what we have in front of us now is not a souvenir craft, this is a real tambourine of the supreme shaman! He was found in the abandoned hut of a spirit seer near the peak of Frostfangs. Where the old man went will remain a mystery forever. Maybe he went north, or maybe the spirits finally called him to themselves, and there, in other worlds, he no longer needed a guide.
 
One way or another, the shaman set off on his last endless journey, and his faithful assistant was left alone. It is not suitable for such a powerful object to be buried under the snows of the Valley of Cold, so now the high shaman’s tambourine will be transferred to safe hands. Maybe it’s yours.
 
It is unlikely that you will be able to use the tambourine for its intended purpose, and it is unlikely that it will open the way for a stranger to other worlds, but the spirit living in it will definitely be grateful for salvation from snow captivity and careful care of its home. I guarantee that this little thing will bring a bit of luck to its new owner. And who knows, maybe he will reveal to him the secrets of our world.

notes.title: Shaman's hat
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/a2dc27a8ac09ae572496ecc7a9d7bdca01d4161d.png[/img]

What do you know about shamans? Not about demonic shamans in carved masks, conjuring the Abyss and sending curses, but about others, ancient, real? You can live your entire life in Erycuria and not meet a single spirit seer. They live secretly, on the very outskirts of the civilized world, where progress and the war that follows on its heels have not yet reached.

There, on the very edge of civilization, in remote villages in the north, you can still meet one of the real shamans. They are laconic, their faces are always hidden under outlandish headdresses made of leather and fur, and, looking at their bent and emaciated bodies, you might think that they bear the entire weight of this world. In part, this is true.

You cannot become a shaman, their art cannot be learned, their gift cannot even be comprehended. Shamans who speak with spirits are born. Nature itself teaches them to see, hear and cry. He reveals his secrets to them and sends guides to other worlds. But the shaman himself cannot do anything of his own free will. He is only a servant of his people and other, incomprehensible forces. That’s why the load on their shoulders is so heavy, and that’s why they hardly talk to others. It is difficult to be the only sighted person among the blind.

That is why shamans wear their wonderful hats that hide their faces, with eyes sewn on top of the skin and fur, looking forward. Others should not know what truths the shaman sees when performing rituals over the bed of a sick person, over a dead bear, in a clearing under the full moon. These truths are visible only to himself. However, the shaman does not need his own eyes; he sees with his heart. But others would be afraid to ask a blind old man for help.

The shaman’s hat with sewn eyes is a symbol of his limitless power and endless weakness, a symbol of his knowledge and faithful service to others. When trying on this hat, remember what it means. You won’t become shamans, even if you spend a whole year in it, but you will still lightly touch their path, fate and bitter sadness.

However, you can consider it just an interesting souvenir.

notes.title: The Story of The Bear
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/ef369a69d672e89aa1d19c83d7ce220dd5f558e3.png[/img]

There are animals about which they sing songs, there are animals about which they tell tales and joke loudly, there are animals about which they speak in low tones. And there is a beast that is talked about only in whispers, but more often they are simply silent. Even his name is forbidden to be spoken out loud, and if you need to address him somehow, they simply say “master” or “bear.”
 
The king of the summer forest, whom both animals and small spirits reckon with, fierce in anger, but also a faithful helper in need - if only you know how to show him your respect. Everyone who lives in the forest knows the bear, fears it and has unlimited respect for it.
 
And everyone also knows that in winter the bear sleeps, and under no circumstances should you wake it up. The king of the forest, who awakens at the wrong time, loses his mind and brings only death and ruin to everything that comes his way. If this happens, residents of the surrounding villages get together and organize a hunt, because otherwise it is simply impossible to stop the raging hungry bear. Each such case is a great tragedy, and bears awaken more and more every year. Pundits believe that the ash that constantly erupts from the Sulfur Heart is to blame. Maybe that's how it is.
 
But sometimes some wandering shaman may meet the connecting rod, and then the fate of the beast will turn out differently. No one knows how shamans pacify the spirit of the forest king and make his madness recede. Just as no one knows why such bears leave their possessions and stay with the shamans forever.
 
Sometimes you can meet a spirit seer with a tambourine, traveling on the back of a bear through frozen forests and icy plains. And I tell you, you will never forget this sight!

And sometimes a sorcerer, a warrior, and even a monk can be on the back of a bear! After all, if some shaman manages to save more than one animal, he will have to give it up - always in good hands and for hard cash. Of course, the shamans themselves do not use money, but they are always ready to help their home village.
 
And even though the riding bear has lost its memory, most of its strength and is no longer the master of the forest, it remains a formidable beast and protector for the one it carries on its back.
 
The main thing is to remember to feed him enough and always be respectful to him.

notes.title: The Story of the Moon Hare
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/95b45c090a457f1b26a12366ee6cdde15b7c1d3a.png[/img]

It is difficult to imagine an animal more harmless than a simple hare. He is considered cowardly, weak and stupid. True, only those who have never seen a hare with their own eyes think so. They also probably confuse him with a rabbit.
 
From time immemorial, the inhabitants of the Sphere peered into the night sky and saw there the silhouettes of various animals: a boar, a bear, a wolf, a bird of prey, a dragon. Among them there was a place for the hare. True, they found it not among a scattering of cold stars, but on the yellowish surface of the moon. The play of light and shadow, piles of rocks and deep gorges seemed to form a face with long ears and a cunning eye. Stargazer scientists refused to include the long-eared animal in the list of celestial animals, but the memory of the Moon Hare remained in the memory of peoples, as did the belief in its miraculous powers.
 
The Moon Hare is especially known in the North, in the cradle of the human race, where people still live by hunting and gathering, where faith in the forces of nature and the spirits of ancestors is still strong. Shamans often tame hares, considering them to be guides to another world, and wild hares sometimes gather in clearings where shamans perform rituals under the full moon.
 
Northern shamans believe that in times of great need, if you ask well, the Moon Hare can come to the call and fulfill any desire. Is it so? Perhaps no one knows for sure. But yellow-eyed hares, bearing the stamp of the sun and moon, do exist. They do not fulfill desires, and they do not appear to everyone. They can follow powerful sorcerers and other heroes, bringing them good fortune, dispelling hostile magic, or hiding it from the evil eye.
 
No one knows where they come from and what is the secret of their amazing power. Maybe this is the Moon Hare coming to the Sphere to get a better look at this world, which he usually looks at from the cold darkness. Or maybe this is just a fairy tale told on a long northern night in the winter hut of the first people.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/fbfff017e8cfa133b34c53b8d346df81fe072b22.png[/img]

On the eve of the New Year, we are pleased to announce the opening of a new game server "Atlas". Its peculiarity is that it is located in Latin America, which means that players from this and nearby regions will be able to play without fear of ping and delays.

The Atlas server is available to all of our players, and it will be a pleasant surprise for those who do not have time to grab top places in the rankings on Hyperion and Prometheus. New year, new world, new opportunities!

Beginner players and seasoned veterans alike can begin their adventure in the world of the Sphere, battling opponents, forming clans, and vying for high positions in the rankings! Improve your hero and become the owner of the highest quality equipment on the server, create strong alliances and compete for leadership on the battlefields. Capture untouched castles, which are now under the control of the most powerful monsters.

To start playing on a new server, select "Atlas" in the list of servers when entering the game.

We wish everyone who decided to start their adventures in the new game world success and heroic victories!

notes.title: Killer's hour
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/dc9ac15bf9aefb885e4a8538eaff1f5e618a8bb0.png[/img]

A black shadow silently appeared on the road leading into the city. Silently she slipped through the slightly open gate and disappeared among the houses. This is a Death Legion assassin who has come to take someone's life.
For centuries, the Legion's deadly Assassins have been harvesting, bringing death and collecting their bloody tribute.

This Saturday from 21:00 to 22:00 (UTC+3), the world of the Sphere will be filled with blood and the ominous laughter of Death itself, because the Hour of the Assassin will take place on the server!

Kill the most players during this time and become an honorary member of the Legion. The reward will not be long in coming:
🔹3 days of premium account
🔹2 rare duelist potions
🔹Scroll of Great Purification
🔹5 resurrection scrolls
🔹5 rank 2 strengthening crystals
🔹Powerful magic pen
🔹unique game title "Death Legionnaire"

All this will be yours!

Only unique kills of players level 15 and above will be counted. Killings on battlefields, sieges, arenas, etc. are also considered. Killing the same character multiple times does not count towards statistics. Results will be published within three working days after the event ends.

Join the mysterious brotherhood of assassins, or one day they will come for your soul!

notes.title: Class rebalance
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/b13a6932488d0fb3ce25c5abdf45ad2cf001188c.png[/img]

As you know, we constantly monitor the situation in the game, paying special attention to both game statistics and your wishes. In this regard, from time to time we revise the abilities of some classes to make them more relevant in modern game conditions, taking into account new equipment, pets, runes and other opportunities for strengthening.
 
Meet the seasonal game balance update!
 
All skill buffs for all classes have been reset so you can re-allocate skills to match the new skill features.
 
🔷Barbarian🔷

⚪️Rage
🔸Furious Strike - Cleave 1 now reduces damage dealt by 5%, instead of 10%. Cleave 3 increases the number of targets by 2, instead of 1.
🔸Whirlwind – now requires rage level 2, instead of 3. Cooldown increased from 20s to 25s. Each level of rage increases the damage of the whirlwind by 5%. Level 4 additionally increases critical strike chance by 2%, level 5 reduces cooldown by 6s.
🔸Furious Jump – cooldown increased from 10s to 12s.
🔸Axe Throw - Chance 1 now provides a 2s cooldown, instead of 1s. Speedup 2 has been replaced with a duration that increases the duration of the slow by 1s.
🔸Skullbreaker – cost increased from 0 to 10 rage.

⚪️Combat skill
🔸Shock Wave – base damage of the ability is increased by 18%, weapon damage is increased by 8%. The ability requires 3rd level of rage in place of 2 and does not receive a boost for 3rd level of rage as before.
🔸Bloodlust – base probability of triggering reduced from 15% to 10%, with a critical hit from 100% to 20%. Base damage multiplier reduced by 30%, weapon damage multiplier reduced by 15%. Luck traits now also increase the chance to trigger on a critical hit.

⚪️Containment
🔸Overcoming Pain – no longer has a cost and requires rage level 4, instead of 3. Base duration increased from 10s to 11s, bonus effect for rage level 4 removed. Buffs 1 and 2 reduce damage taken by 5%, down from 10%.
🔸Titan Walk - now requires rage level 2, instead of 3. Rage levels 3, 4 and 5 increase the damage of the ability by 7% each.
🔸Combat trance – cooldown increased from 6 minutes to 10 minutes. Increases 1 and 2 speed up reload by 40s, instead of 35s, increase 3 speeds up reload by 50s.
Rise of the Barbarian
🔸Bloody madness – reduces the barbarian’s defense by 40%, instead of 25%.


🔷Paladin🔷

⚪️Retribution
🔸Righteous Strike - buffs 1 and 2 now give 20% damage, instead of 15%. Boost 3 has been replaced with Restoration, which increases Zealotry generation from Righteous Strike by 3.
🔸Onslaught – base damage increased by 20%, weapon damage by 10%. The buff increases damage by 25%, up from 15%.

⚪️Self-sacrifice
🔸Shield Bash - durations 1 and 2 removed. Added Cleave 2 and 3, which increase the number of targets by 1 and the stun duration by 0.5s each.
🔸Phoenix – ability cooldown reduced from 40 minutes to 35 minutes.

⚪️Valor
🔸Divine Shield – the base strength of the shield is increased by 15%, the share of strength from weapons is increased by 10%. Simplification has been replaced with a duration that increases the duration of the shield by 4s.
🔸Sanctuary – the cost of the ability has been increased from 70 to 90. Simplification 1 and 2 reduce the cost of the ability by 15, instead of 10. Simplification 3 has been replaced by power, which gives an additional charge of the ability, but increases the cooldown by 90s.
🔸Consecration – cooldown increased from 30s to 45s. Blinding effect reduced from 20% to 10%. Increases 1 and 2 speed up the cooldown of the ability by 5s, instead of 4s.

⚪️Rise of the Paladin

🔸Will of the Righteous – cooldown traits speed up ability recovery by 4s. each, instead of 3s.
🔸Might of the Heavens - Duration traits now increase duration by 1s each, instead of 0.75s.

🔷Warrior🔷

⚪️Combat skill
🔸Bleeding – base damage multiplier reduced by 10%, weapon damage by 5%. Physical attack reduction effect reduced from 7% to 5%.
🔸Dash – cooldown increased from 17s to 18s.

⚪️Exhausting
🔸Crush – Duration 1 and 2 increase the duration of the effect by 4s, instead of 5s.
🔸Slowing Strike – the cost of the ability has been increased from 20 to 25. The slowdown duration has been reduced from 10s to 6s.
🔸Piercing – the range of the ability has been increased from 15m to 20m. The buff now increases damage by 30%, up from 40%. The effect now also affects the bleeding caused by the ability.
🔸Rage – power-up 3 now increases damage by 10%, instead of 5%.

⚪️Tactics
🔸Mockery – the amount of generated hatred has been increased. Boost 3 has been replaced with power, which increases the radius of the taunt to 5m, the number of targets to 5, but increases the cooldown of the ability by 5s.
🔸Lion's Roar – cooldown increased from 15s to 20s. Ability damage removed. The ability additionally reduces the target's healing and regeneration received by 5%. Boosts 1 and 2 also affect healing reduction and regeneration. Lion's Roar buff runes now increase healing and regeneration reduction.
🔸Wrath – Frequent Wrath 2 has been replaced with Power, which increases damage and armor reduction by 5%.
🔸Morale – ability cooldown increased from 120s to 180s.

⚪️Rise of the Warrior
🔸Arena of Torment – cooldown increased from 50s to 60s.


🔷Pathfinder🔷

⚪️Accuracy
🔸Precise Shot – base damage of the ability is increased by 20%, weapon damage by 14%. The cooldown of the ability has been increased to 10s. Boost 3 increases damage per charge by 15%, up from 10%

⚪️Survival
🔸Ice Arrow – cooldown increased from 20s to 22s. The base damage of the ability is increased by 30%, weapon damage by 15%. Duration 1 now also increases the duration of the root by 1s.
🔸Heavy Arrow – base damage and weapon damage increased by 20%.
🔸Explosive Arrow – cost increased from 40 to 50. Base damage increased by 10%, weapon damage by 6%.
🔸Mine – boost 1 increases damage by 20%, instead of 15%. Increase 2 also reduces the cooldown of the trap by 5s.

⚪️Trick
🔸Summon a companion – ability cooldown increased to 10s. Strengthening 1 and 2 increase the companion's endurance by 22%, instead of 15%. Fortify 3 has been replaced with haste, reducing summon time by 3s.
🔸Trap – power-up 1 now increases damage by 20%, instead of 15%. Increase 2 also reduces mine cooldown by 5s.
🔸Hedgehogs – slowdown reduced from 50% to 30%. Base damage increased by 10%, weapon damage by 5%.
🔸Easy step – cooldown increased from 60s to 70s. Increase 3 speeds up reload time by 10s, instead of 5s.

⚪️Rise of the Pathfinder
🔸Evil beast – health increased by 15%. The enhancement adds 18% damage to the beast, instead of 15%.
🔸Series of deaths – duration increased from 5s to 6s.
🔸Star Arrow – enhancement traits increase damage by 9%, instead of 8%.


🔷Monk🔷

⚪️Combat skill
🔸Furious Throw – base damage increased by 7%, weapon damage by 3%.
🔸Comet – base damage increased by 16%, weapon damage by 7%.

⚪️Meditation
🔸Power flow – ability cooldown increased from 11s to 12s.
🔸Deep Meditation - Duration 1 and 2 increase the duration of the ability by 3s, instead of 2s. Duration 3 has been replaced with haste, which increases movement speed by 25%.
🔸Spell Breaker - the ability has been renamed to “Wisdom of Streams”. The ability additionally increases the monk's health regeneration by 15%. Boost 3 increases magic damage resistance by 6%, up from 5%. Added Recovery Traits 1, 2 and 3, which increase regeneration by an additional 4%

⚪️Fortitude
🔸Orb of Energy – Boost 3 increases damage and healing ability by 25%, instead of 20%.
🔸Sky Wave – base damage increased by 20%, weapon damage by 8%.
🔸Fanatical Rage – base damage reduced by 15%, weapon damage by 7%. Added Volume 3, increasing the radius by another 3 meters.


🔷Killer🔷

⚪️Toxicology
🔸Cobra Venom – base damage increased by 45%, weapon damage increased by 22%. Boost 3 increases the ability's damage by 30%, up from 25%. Duration 3 increases the duration of the ability by 3s, up from 2s.
🔸Rapid Recovery - the ability has been renamed to “Hidden Reserves”. The ability additionally increases the character's walking and running speed by 6%. Added acceleration traits 1-3, which increase movement speed by 1/1/2%.

⚪️Dagger Mastery
🔸Dagger Throwing – slowdown power reduced from 25% to 20%.
🔸Dragon's Mouth – the cost of the ability has been increased to 20 energy.
🔸Fan of Blades – the cost of the ability has been increased from 40 to 50.
🔸Dancing Blade – casting distance increased from 15m to 18m. Ranges 1 and 2 increase the casting distance by 3m, instead of 2.5m.

⚪️Stealth
🔸Invisibility – cooldown increased from 10s to 15s.
🔸Insidious Strike – the base damage of the ability is increased by 15%, weapon damage by 5%.
🔸Step into the shadows – base damage increased by 15%, weapon damage by 6%.

⚪️Rise of the Assassin
🔸Shadow Dance – physical damage reduction increased from 20% to 22%, magic damage reduction from 15% to 17%. Duration increased from 5s to 6s, cooldown increased from 50s to 60s. Duration increases the duration of the ability by 1.2s instead of 1s

🔷Sorcerer🔷

⚪️Element of fire
🔸Fire Arrow – acceleration 1 speeds up the ability by 0.3, instead of 0.1, acceleration 2 has been removed. Added Buff 3 which increases ability damage by 20%
🔸Hydra – boosts 1 and 2 speed up reload time by 3s, instead of 2s, boost 3 is replaced with power, which increases the number of Hydra charges by 1, but doubles the cost of the ability.
🔸Fire Land - acceleration 1 and 2 increase the casting speed by 0.3, instead of 0.2. Acceleration 3 removed. Added Buff 2, increasing the ability's damage by 15%.
🔸Circle of Fire – ability slowdown replaced with armor reduction by 10%.
🔸Fireball – base damage increased by 19%, weapon damage increased by 7%.
🔸Pyromaniac – the chance of triggering a critical hit has been reduced from 100% to 70%, luck traits now also increase this parameter. Luck 1 and 2 increase the chance by 8%, instead of 5%. Luck 3 has been replaced with duration, increasing burn duration by 3s.

⚪️Element of lightning
🔸Lightning – boost 1 speeds up reload time by 3s, instead of 2.5s, boost 2 has been removed. Added volume, which increases the area of effect of the ability by 4m and allows you to stun up to 3 targets at the same time. Volume also slows the cooldown by 4s and increases the cost of the ability by 100%.
🔸Fan of lightning - cost increased from 8% to 9%.
🔸Discharge - cost increased from 8% to 9%. Base damage increased by 12%, weapon damage increased by 6%. Boost 1 increases the ability's damage by 15%, up from 10%.
🔸Lightning Sphere - boost 3 increases the damage of the ability by 15%, instead of 10%. Increases 1 and 2 speed up reload time by 4s, instead of 3s. Increase 3 has been replaced with Power, which increases the ability's damage by 30%, increases the cooldown by 2s, and increases the cost of the ability by 100%.

⚪️Secret knowledge
🔸Magic shield – cost increased from 10% to 12%. Base shield strength increased by 13%, weapon strength by 6%. Increase 1 now speeds up cooldown by 10s, down from 6s. Increase 2 has been replaced with duration, which doubles the duration of the shield and its cost.
🔸Meditation - duration 1 and 2 increase the duration of use by 3s, instead of 2s, duration 1 and 2 speed up the recharge by 30s, instead of 20s. Duration 3 and frequency 3 have been removed. Added Replenishment 1 and 2, which increase mana regeneration by 15% each.

⚪️Rise of the Sorcerer
🔸Focus Energy – Mana regeneration increased from 65% to 70%. Traits to increase energy regeneration now give 15%, instead of 10%. Cooldown traits speed up cooldown by 3s, up from 2s.
🔸Rain of Fire – base damage increased by 35%, weapon damage by 9%.


🔷Priest🔷

⚪️Teaching of darkness
🔸Torment – the cost of the ability has been increased from 5% to 7%. Boost 1 increases damage by 15%, up from 12.5%.
🔸Bonds of Darkness – slowdown reduced from 15% to 10%, chain radius reduced from 15m to 10m. Damage multiplier per target reduced from 7.5% to 5%.
🔸Sadism – boost 2 increases recovery by 3%, instead of 2%.

⚪️Teaching of light
🔸Healing – base healing multiplier increased by 10%, weapon multiplier increased by 5%
🔸Pillar of Light – base healing multiplier increased by 10%, weapon multiplier increased by 5%
🔸Chain Heal – buff 3 increases healing by 9%, up from 7%.

⚪️Enlightenment
🔸Orb of Light – boost 1 and 2 increase durability by 15% and 20%. Gain 3 removed. Added Duration 3, which increases the duration of the shield by 10s, but doubles the cost of the ability.
🔸Body's Prayer - acceleration 1 reduces cast time by 3s, instead of 2s. Haste 2 has been replaced with might, which removes the cost and cast time, but allows you to resurrect an ally in battle.
🔸Altruism – the ability has been renamed to “Healing Power”. The ability additionally increases the healing received and the strength of the shields received by the priest by 5%. Added Healing Traits 1,2 and 3, which increase the power of healing and shields received by 1,2 and 2%.

⚪️Rise of the Priest
🔸Ancient Mysteries – magical energy regeneration increased from 15% to 20%.


🔷Necromancer🔷

⚪️Dark magic
🔸Summon Zombies – damage increased from 60% to 65%.
🔸Dark armor – cost increased from 10% to 13%. Duration increased from 16s to 20s

⚪️Curses
🔸Decomposition – cost increased from 6% to 7%
🔸Withering – base damage increased by 10%, weapon damage by 6%. Casting time increased to 1.5s.
🔸Flesh Minion – cooldown increased from 90s to 120s. Increases 1 and 2 speed up reload time by 15s, instead of 10s.

⚪️Harvest of souls
🔸Twist of Souls – the cost of the ability has been increased from 13% to 16%, the casting time has been increased from 1s to 2s. Simplification 1 and 2 reduce the cost of the ability by 25%, instead of 20%. Simplify 3 has been replaced with a boost that increases the ability's damage by 15%.


We hope you enjoy the new balance, and of course, we look forward to hearing from you on our Discord channel!
 
Have a good game!

notes.title: Snow Whirlwind Holiday
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/36a15e3f2421f6ed7f6464cfa29c05c3db44e086.png[/img]

The most festive time of the year has arrived! Have you already started decorating the Christmas tree and buying gifts for friends and family? We invite you to go on a New Year's adventure in Sphere 3.
 
Only at this special time of year will completely unique opportunities be available to you: snow battles, holiday missions and, of course, pleasant gifts from the local Morozovik.
 
First, get to know Morozovik. You can find it in your faction's capital.
This is where the festive chain of tasks that you have to complete begins.
 
So, what adventures await you for the New Year?
❄️In the first task you have to save the New Year. Monsters stole New Year's decorations, and what would New Year be without decorations? Go ahead, take them away from the scoundrels!
❄️Morozovik lost the gifts he prepared for the holiday! They lie somewhere in the area. Bring them back soon!
❄️Light up the New Year's garlands! Please note that they are unusual, they are powered only by the energy of the stars. Therefore, only specially trained Guardians can light them. Find the Guardian in your location and ask for help.
For completing the entire chain of missions you will receive wonderful rewards, including a unique headdress, as well as a New Year's Ice Lizard and Snow Raccoon!
 
After completing tasks, they will become available as daily ones.
 
By completing daily quests and killing monsters of your level, you can get ice coins and spend them on buying treasures, a special pet, and holiday amulets with unusual properties.
❄️Amulet of Circulation - When receiving a control effect, reduces damage received by 20% for 8s. Triggers no more than once every 60s.
The amulet is of rare quality, has red, yellow, purple and three colorless sockets.
❄️Fireworks Amulet - When landing a critical hit, strikes the target and surrounding enemies within an 8m radius with a burst of flame, causing disorientation for 2s. NPCs are instead stunned for 3s. It works no more than once every 90s.
The amulet is of rare quality, has red, yellow, purple and three colorless sockets.
❄️Talisman of good luck - Amulet for good luck in the new year. Increases item drop chance by 10%. An epic quality amulet with six colorless sockets.
❄️Talisman of wealth - Amulet for wealth in the new year. Increases the amount of gold received from killing monsters by 15%. An epic quality amulet with six colorless sockets.
❄️Pet "Ice Ifrit".

In the store you can purchase potions that increase the amount of ice coins you receive when killing monsters and completing event quests.
 
❄️You can now buy a blessing of whirlwind from snowmen, which increases running speed, stamina, experience gained and the chance of loot dropping by 1.7%. The effect stacks up to 15 times (25.5%) and is valid for all 3 weeks of the event and another week after.
 
And how can the New Year pass without snowballs, icicles and fun? All this is now available to you! Find snowdrifts and pieces of ice from which you can get snowballs or icicles that give a slowing effect. You can throw them at each other or at monsters. However, remember that this fun ammo melts easily and will only last about 5 minutes in the warm hands of your characters.
 
Now let's celebrate the New Year in Sphere 3! New Year's adventures await their heroes!
 
Upcoming holidays!

notes.title: Let's tame the Cleaver!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/5382115ebb3d9896a6ef56023cb1d136fc9a0085.png[/img]

Remember the legend about the heroic wise Cleavers? Now's your chance to tame one of them! If you succeed, it will increase your movement speed by 150% and your maximum health by 15%, and those around you will remember you as the one who managed to ride the Cleaver himself.

There are rumors that monsters from the Abyss are trying to break into the Enchanted World! Fight them on their own territory and receive unimaginable rewards.

🌀What to do?🌀

From all the monsters in the world of the Sphere you can get the mysterious “echoes of the Abyss”. However, you can only get the bulk of the items by completing quests in a special zone, where you will have to fight various monsters from all corners of the Abyss.

You will be offered 4 quests, which will have to be completed in the dangerous territory of a special zone. There you will be able to compete with representatives of enemy factions, but if you die at the hands of a representative of the opposing faction, you will lose 50% of the echoes.

If you are brave enough, you will meet the most terrible Boss of the Abyss - the Darkness dragon, from whom you can win conservation and strengthening crystals, but keep in mind that he, like all dragons, has the ability to grow and increase his combat power. The more warriors who enter the battle with the boss, the more rewards you will receive in the end, but remember, they will go to only the most worthy of the warriors.

🌀Reward guaranteed!🌀

When you combine fragments of a mysterious egg, you have a chance to get a mysterious egg, which is guaranteed to drop one random pet: a forest lizard, a winged gurinid, an Abyss dragon, a snake catcher, as well as a poisonous, ice or golden dragon.

Also, when combining fragments of a mysterious egg, the character receives the power of dark energies, which increases damage dealt and experience gained and lasts until the end of the event and a week later.

Each time you combine fragments, the character can also receive one of three epic relics with six colorless gem sockets:

💎relic of power - increases the probability of a critical attack by 1.5%, the magnitude of the critical effect by 6%.
💎Relic of Vitality - increases the owner’s stamina by 5% and the amount of healing received by 10%.
💎relic of speed - increases the speed of movement, attack and casting spells by 5%.
Relics, after being placed in an equipment slot, can be placed on the ability panel and have an additional property:
When used, removes the effects of stun, immobilization, sleep, and disarming from the character. Reload time: 150 seconds.

If a character does not receive a relic after 24 attempts to combine fragments, he is guaranteed to receive it on the 25th attempt.

🌀What else?🌀

In the process of combining the echoes of the abyss, you will also receive rewards: teleportation stones, resurrection scrolls, scrolls to improve armor and weapons, and much more.

Every day, the winning faction that united the most echoes will receive a 10% bonus to experience, gold and item drops for the day, and the losing team will receive a 5% bonus to experience and gold.

notes.title: The new battle season!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/4cf6dbe09eb103340eefa6d3dbbcbfe0b6a86116.png[/img]

More than a hundred gifts for every Sphere player! The bravest, wisest and noblest warriors of the Sphere are invited to participate in the new battle season!
 
[h2]What is battle season?[/h2]

Essentially, this is a set of tasks, for which participation is given progress points. As you accumulate progress points, you will receive sets of useful and sometimes even unique rewards!

[h2]Tell me more about the prizes![/h2]

✨Title "Swift" - increases movement speed by 2.5%, reduces the chance of receiving a critical hit by 1.5%.
✨Infusion of Windfury - increases attack, spell and movement speed by 5% for 24 hours
✨Loot collector "Squirrel" - moves 60% faster than usual, lasts 30 days.
✨Groom Token - used to improve the groom’s mount.
✨Pet "Nut". Its properties are below.
◾️ secretive
◾️luck
◾️level 10 - Exceptional Agility (Increases the owner's agility by 1.6%) OR Exceptional Wisdom (Increases the owner's wisdom by 1.6%)
◾️level 20 - Greater Wound Healing (During combat, restores the owner to 50% of their normal health regeneration value) OR Accelerated Recovery (Increases the owner's energy regeneration, magical or necrotic energy by 15%)
◾️level 30 - Exceptional Agility (Increases the owner's agility by 1.6%) OR Exceptional Wisdom (Increases the owner's wisdom by 1.6%)
◾️level 40 - Increasing anger (When attacked with a 6% chance, increases the speed of attack and trying on the owner’s abilities by 6% for 13s. Stacks up to 5 times.) OR Increasing strength (When receiving damage with a 6% chance, increases the owner’s defense by 6% for 14 seconds. Stacks up to 5 times.)
◾️level 50 - Exceptional Stamina (Increases the wearer's stamina by 1.6%) OR Exceptional Spirit (Increases the wearer's spirit by 1.6%)
◾️level 60 - Celerity (Increases the owner's movement speed by 22%) OR Elusiveness (Reduces the chance of receiving a critical hit by 13%.)

In addition to all this, you can get food, conservation and strengthening crystals, a refining master’s hammer, essences, ghost coins, spices and much, much more. The full set of rewards is available to those who purchase the Advanced Pass.

[h2]I'm in! How to participate?[/h2]

When you first enter the game after the start of the battle season, each of your characters will see an invitation window.
 
Click the “Start Season” button to join. After this, you can open the season window by clicking on the icon located next to the mini-map.
 
[h2]What should I do?[/h2]

Open the season window. In it you will see a list of tasks. Tasks are divided into those that you can complete once per season, and daily. One-time tasks are chained (complete the current task to start the next one). However, each group of tasks is available at the same time - as you complete simple tasks, new, more complex ones will open up.

[h2]I want more rewards and tasks![/h2]

Easily! To have access to more tasks and receive more rewards for progress points, you can purchase an extended pass. In addition to these benefits, the pass will also allow you to gain combat experience (progress points) faster. The Extended Pass is purchased once for the entire season and is valid for your entire account. You can become the owner of an extended pass and claim your rewards at any time during the season.
 
[h2]Can I get the rewards right now?[/h2]

If the romance of completing tasks every day bores you, then of course! To speed up your progress through the Battle Season and instantly gain access to rewards, you can purchase levels (a fixed number of progress points).
 
[h2]How long does the season last?[/h2]

The battle season lasts 30 days and contains 100 levels of progress!
Receive maximum gifts!
 
We wish you good luck in the new season!

notes.title: Nut's story
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/e79866af5f635c0225c52c46fe4902cbae782376.png[/img]

People, demons, and in general everyone who has outgrown a gnome and walks on two legs, rarely turn their gaze down, but even less often raise their heads to the tops of the trees. And very few people actually think about what trees are and what kind of life boils in their branches.

For the great races of the Sphere, trees are of value only as building material for houses, castles and siege engines, and they do not even notice the animals inhabiting the ancient forests of Erikuria, the Valley of Cold and the Southern Lands. Here, for example, are proteins. Most likely, while traveling around the world, you have never seen them. But the squirrels have been keeping an eye on you for a long time.
Nothing can hide from their attentive and curious eyes! They follow travelers everywhere, they always know who is going where, and if you happen to spend the night in the forest, then don’t be surprised if you don’t have enough supplies in the morning, especially if you stocked up on nuts for the journey.

But the squirrels not only observe, they protect their forests as best they can, take care of the ancient trees and warn the bipeds that they are coming to ravage their lands. But the squirrels are not strong enough to stop civilization, which is inexorably advancing on their home, and they retreat further and further into impenetrable thickets and windfalls - where the greed of people and others cannot yet reach.

But there are other proteins. The largest and strongest of these intelligent animals occasionally leave their shelters and go out into the world. Some settle near cities and villages, while others join larger animals - those who have enough strength to defend their common home. So from time to time you can see how squirrels show the way to the cleavers making their way through the jungle to the edge of the forest.

Nut is one of the warriors of the squirrel tribe. No one will ever know where he got his armor, just the right size for himself, just as no one will know how he made friends with the war boars and became their scout, and he will not tell anyone his real name. Nut is fearless and fast as lightning, he is more agile than his fellow tribesmen and more curious than all of them combined. But what really distinguishes him from all other squirrels is that he was the first to go out into the big world openly and begin to look for a two-legged friend.

If you are lucky enough to meet him one day and become friends, then know that you will find in him a faithful ally, a devoted and incredibly useful comrade. The nut will accompany you in any adventure, it will follow you into the darkest dungeons, will not leave you at the walls of a besieged castle, will not get confused in the capital hubbub of Olannor and will not flinch under the gaze of Lord Vagrot himself! But all this - if you can win him over and win his trust. Who knows, maybe you will be lucky!

Reach out your hand and let the squirrel in battle armor sniff it. Look into Nut's eyes and hold his gaze. And then, when he climbs onto your shoulders, go on your way. Your shared journey is just beginning!

notes.title: Story of the Ax
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/2d3f46c6295e6987079c25f7ca8d771221d5a5a7.png[/img]

Little is known about the warriors of the Valley of Cold, those who move from settlement to settlement on the back of a war boar, making their way through snow, through blizzards and through the black winter night. We can say that they are stern and taciturn warriors. Or that they keep their guard at the border of inhabited lands. Or that they always end up where monsters get too close to settlements. All this is true, but it still doesn’t say anything about them.

Little is known for certain about these guardians of the cold plains. All of them were able to tame the boar cleaver. They wear special helmets with a crest made of stiff wool. And each of them is armed with a heavy ax, which he carries on his back. That's basically all.

Boar riders are recognized by these axes. By the way, here is one of them! Look at her. One of its wings shines dazzlingly in the sun, reflecting the light like the ice of a frozen lake. It is eternally cold and will instantly freeze anyone who tries to touch the metal with their bare hand. The second wing of the ax exudes the heat of a blazing fire; it is always red-hot and can burn an unwary warrior. Axes of the Ice Flame - that's what they're called.

You need to have remarkable courage, as well as strength and wisdom, just to take this weapon in your hands and not get hurt! Few people are able to cope with the killing power of this deadly, but so elegant ax.

But you can’t fool your eyes – you already want to squeeze its handle, wave it, and hang it behind your back! And this is understandable. You have all the qualities to handle this weapon. Who knows, maybe this ax was waiting for you? Perhaps you are destined to become the new warrior of the north? Perhaps it’s your turn to carry out your patrol on the border of winter? It may well be that this is the case.

So don't wait! Reach out and take it! And then saddle your boar and set off across the endless snows of the very edge of the world!

notes.title: Boar's Story
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/d29419e010f748c3850a7e64448643993b15c801.png[/img]

Winter is coming!

Cold winds have blown over the Sphere, they are driving up heavy leaden clouds and bringing frost that penetrates to the bones. Rare snow falls from the sky - it melts before reaching the ground, but soon the frost will get stronger and the snow will fall in full force. The holiday of the Snowy Twist is just around the corner, but the middle of winter is still far away, but for now...
In the meantime, the frost is getting stronger, and wild boars are emerging from their secluded rookeries. These ferocious beasts roam the Valley of Cold in search of food and attack anyone who dares to invade their domain. Don't underestimate these animals!

They are the embodiment of courage and fury, they are anger itself, ready to fall on those who dare to cross the borders of their lands! Any hunter knows that in the snowy forest there is no animal more dangerous than a wild boar! It’s not for nothing that they have long been attacked with special spears, and nothing else, because neither a leopard, nor a tiger, nor even a bear awakening in the middle of winter poses such a danger as a young hog defending its land!

This is the lot of youth - to rush into battle against anyone who dares to cross the line. But among the boars there are also wise animals. Those who have lived enough years in the world know that neither demon nor man pose a danger to their existence. The giants are busy with their wars, but the boars know the truth. They know that behind the snowstorm and the darkness of the winter night there is a real danger. Darkness, death and something much worse than death. And they, the boars, were the first to stand in the way of this darkness!

Adult boars, which have grown long tusks and stiff bristles that protect better than any armor, sometimes go out into the world and look for a warrior. It doesn't matter if it's human or demon, because it doesn't matter to them. They are ready to faithfully serve anyone who can put armor and a saddle on them and remain alive. And they will fight together with their warrior to the last drop of blood. Such boars are called Cleavers, and they always fight in the vanguard during the winter cold.

So arm yourself with courage and go to the snowy forests of the Valley of Cold to find and tame the faithful Cleaver. You will not find a truer friend or a fiercer warrior than this wild boar.
Grip your trusty ax tighter, pull your bristly helmet deeper, and go there, into the very center of winter, into the thick of the forest, into the camp of frosty monsters, to find and curb this beast. Cleaver. It will be hard. It will be hard. But you won't regret your choice, that's for sure.

notes.title: Jackpot "Welcome Winter"
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/398ec1fd21571ba53295c14eeef113c8988e0989.png[/img]

You are given a unique opportunity to take part in the “Welcome Winter” Jackpot.
 
What is Jackpot?

Jackpot is a great opportunity to get some of the most expensive and useful products at a mind-blowing discount, and also win GXP! The final size of the Jackpot is unlimited!

❄How is the prize fund formed?

When purchasing each product, a portion of the funds is transferred to the accumulative Jackpot prize fund, which will be drawn among the participants! The amount accumulated during the promotion period will be drawn at the end of the promotion on December 1 between Sphere 3 players participating in the Jackpot.

❄How does the awarding process take place?

A prize of 50% of the accumulated amount will be received by 3 winners, and the remaining 50% will be distributed among the remaining 10 winners.

❄When will you be able to find out the results and receive your reward?

Jackpot results will be announced within 3 business days after the end of the promotion. Winning GXP will be credited to winners' accounts within three business days.

You can take part in the jackpot from November 16 to November 30 (inclusive).

notes.title: Dungeons and Shushpans
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/97e84d175f656f2045b460355ce9531a482c3ea8.png[/img]

A new event has started in the world of the Sphere - “Dungeons and Shushpans”.

While the event lasts, any monsters of your level or 1-2 levels higher or lower may drop an adventurer badge, which can be combined with the same badges to receive a reward. Collect and equip the final item, the Adventurer's Crown, which will increase your character's Strength, Dexterity, Intelligence, and Wisdom by 0.3% (the effect can stack up to 3%). The boost is valid for the duration of the event and for a week after it.

🔥When combining badges into the Adventurer's Crown, you have a chance to receive one of three unique rings:

💍Ring of Courage - when receiving a control effect, removes 1 negative effect from the owner. Cooldown 55s.
💍Ring of Cunning - with a 6% chance when dealing damage, increases the chance of a critical attack by 4% for 12 seconds. Stacks up to 5 times.
💍Ring of Thought - when the wearer’s health drops to 70%, creates a shield equal to 20% of health. The shield lasts 20 seconds. It works no more than once every 60s.

All rings are epic and contain 6 colorless gem sockets.

If after 19 attempts your character has not received the ring, on the 20th attempt he is guaranteed to receive it!

Each time you combine icons, your faction receives 1 victory point. Once a day, points are reset and both factions receive a daily boost, the power of which depends on their place in the competition.

Remember: members of the enemy faction can defeat you and take half of your Adventurer Badges!

You can receive additional badges every day for completing the daily quests of the three young adventurers in Cinderkreg or Hellsong Tavern. While the premium account is active, the chance of getting an adventurer badge is doubled.

Additionally, you can speed up the process by purchasing the missing icons from the play store.

Forward to adventure!
