notes.title: The new battle season!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/8ff72383367746be7acf639ab72e31d576df01cd.png[/img]

More than a hundred gifts for each player of the Sphere 3! The bravest, wisest and noblest warriors of the Sphere are invited to participate in the new battle season!
 
[h2]What is the battle season?[/h2]

In fact, this is a set of tasks for participation in which progress points are given. As you accumulate progress points, you will receive sets of useful and sometimes even unique rewards!

[h2]Tell me more about the prizes![/h2]

✨Title "Tireless" - increases health regeneration by 12%.
✨Infusion of Windfury - increases attack, spell and movement speed by 5% for 24 hours
✨Loot collector "Shadow Fox" - moves 60% faster than usual, lasts 30 days.
✨Multi-Armed Warrior Back Attachment and Desert Warlord's Turban (from the Battle Pass Item Merchant)
✨Pet "Desert Hunter" Its properties are below.
◾️ beast
◾️savings
◾️level 10 - Exceptional Stamina (Increases the wearer's stamina by 1.6%) OR Exceptional Spirit (Increases the wearer's spirit by 1.6%)
◾️level 20 - Laceration (The owner's critical hit reduces the healing received by the target by 25%, the target's health regeneration by 60% for 10s. Triggers no more than once every 10s.) OR Lick Wounds.png Lick Wounds (If the owner's health drops to 50 % or lower, his health regeneration in combat is increased by 100% for 18s (can only trigger once every 30s)
◾️level 30 - Exceptional Stamina (Increases the wearer's stamina by 1.6%) OR Exceptional Spirit (Increases the wearer's spirit by 1.6%)
◾️level 40 - Tireless (Increases movement, attack and casting speed by 6%.) OR Regeneration (Increases the owner's health recovery by 60%.)
◾️level 50 - Exceptional Agility (Increases the owner's agility by 1.6%) OR Exceptional Wisdom (Increases the owner's wisdom by 1.6%)
◾️level 60 - Devour (Restores health in the amount of 5% of the damage dealt by the owner.) OR Harvest (If a creature dies within a radius of 20m, the owner's critical strike chance increases by 1.3%, and health regeneration in battle by 6%. The effect is cumulative up to 9 times (the effect lasts for 21s)

In addition to all this, you can get food, preservation and strengthening crystals, a refiner's hammer, essences, ghost coins, spices and much, much more. The full set of rewards is available to those who purchase the Advanced Pass.

[h2]I'm in! How to participate?[/h2]

When you first log into the game after the start of the battle season, each of your characters will see an invitation window.
 
Click the "Start Season" button to join. After that, you can open the season window by clicking on the icon, which is located next to the mini-map.
 
[h2]What should I do?[/h2]

Open the season window. There you will see a list of tasks. Tasks are divided into those that you can complete once per season, and daily ones. One-time tasks are chains (complete the current task to start the next one). However, each group of tasks is available at the same time - as you complete simple tasks, you will open new, more complex ones.

[h2]I want more rewards and tasks![/h2]

Easily! To have access to more tasks and get more rewards for progress points, you can purchase an advanced pass. In addition to these benefits, the pass will also allow you to gain combat experience (progress points) faster. The Advanced Pass is purchased once for the entire season and is valid for your entire account. You can become the owner of an advanced pass and collect your rewards at any time during the season.
 
[h2]Can I get rewards right now?[/h2]

If the romance of completing tasks every day bores you, then sure! To speed up the passage of the Battle Season and get instant access to rewards, you can purchase levels (a fixed number of progress points).
 
[h2]How long is the season?[/h2]

The battle season lasts 30 days and contains 100 levels of progress!
Get the most gifts!
 
We wish you good luck in the new season!

notes.title: Halloween in Sphere 3!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/f2941872d0065989a4bd45744fb35db598d60453.png[/img]

👻Trick or treat, Spherians?

Halloween is approaching, which means all sorts of evil spirits are already crawling out of crypts and graves. The world of Sphere 3 was attacked by ghosts. You have to find out who they are and where they came from! Meet the Halloween event in Sphere 3!

Complete tasks and fight monsters, get candies for this and exchange them for valuable prizes:
🎃Gloves of Horror - when delivering a critical hit, they frighten the target, preventing it from moving for 2.5s. The effect triggers no more than once every 120s. Contains 6 colorless gem sockets.
🎃Trembling Gloves - When receiving damage, there is a 6% chance to reduce the enemy's ability power by 4% for 12s. Can stack up to 5 times.
🎃Two unique pets - Poltergeist and Jack-O-Lantern.
🎃Shadow fox for 30 days, which not only collects loot 60% faster, but also increases health regeneration by 20% and health regeneration in battle by 10%.
🎃Scary helmets.

In the game store you can purchase potions and elixirs to get more candies, and extra candies!

Each faction already has a Strange Girl in the capital. With its help, you will complete a very exciting chain of quests, during which you will be able to receive wonderful in-game prizes, including:
🔸unique headdress - Pumpkin,
🔸Horse of the Damned in different colors,
🔸enchantment and improvement scrolls,
🔸inlay stones,
🔸various useful consumables.

You are waiting for battles with ghosts, unraveling the mysteries of the universe, collecting various ingredients for a spell, the game "Candy or Treat!" and much more.

People can find the Strange Girl in the eastern part of Olannor, and demons can find it in the western part of Brionnfall. The Barker can also show the way to it - he can be found in most large settlements.

But that is not all! During an interesting daily quest you can also get valuable prizes, for example:
🔸candies,
🔸essences,
🔸cubes of illusions.

The daily quest can be taken from the Jack Pumpkin character in Olannor and Brionnfall.

🔸By the way, in event pumpkins you can find another type of candy, which gives a boost for the entire duration of the event and a week later and adds up to 30 times.

Want more details? Then hurry up to the game!

We wish you a happy Halloween!

notes.title: The new battle season!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/7210b558604e379bf323e05a2b80e9cd3dbee9b3.png[/img]

More than a hundred gifts for each player of the Sphere 3! The bravest, wisest and noblest warriors of the Sphere are invited to participate in the new battle season!
 
[h2]What is the battle season?[/h2]

In fact, this is a set of tasks for participation in which progress points are given. As you accumulate progress points, you will receive sets of useful and sometimes even unique rewards!

[h2]Tell me more about the prizes![/h2]

✨Title "Reaper" - increases critical damage by 1.2%, attack and spell speed by 3%.
✨Infusion of Windfury - increases attack, spell and movement speed by 5% for 24 hours
✨Green Agama mount - gives 150% speed and increases health by 15%.
✨Loot collector Borovik - moves 60% faster than usual, lasts 30 days.
✨Pet "Dead Man's Cup". Its properties: Crusher, Luck. Pet bonuses are below:

◾️ Level 10 - Exceptional Agility (Increases the owner's agility by 1.6% OR Exceptional Wisdom (Increases the owner's wisdom by 1.6%)
◾️ level 20 - Light Step (Increases the wearer's movement speed by 10%.) OR Smell of Blood (Increases the power of a critical strike by 7%.)
◾️ Level 30 - Exceptional Agility (Increases the owner's agility by 1.6% OR Exceptional Wisdom (Increases the owner's wisdom by 1.6%)
◾️ Level 40 - Tireless (Increases movement, attack and ability speed by 6%. OR Life Absorption (Restores health equal to 2.5% of the damage dealt by the owner.)
◾️ level 50 - Exceptional Agility (Increases the owner's agility by 1.6% OR Exceptional Wisdom (Increases the owner's wisdom by 1.6%)
◾️ level 60 - Curse of Fragility (When attacked with a chance of 8% (16% on a critical hit), reduces the enemy's defense by 6% and increases the chance of inflicting a critical hit on him by 4%. Stacks up to 7 times. The effect lasts for 13s.) OR Harvest (If a creature dies within a 20m radius, the owner's critical strike chance increases by 1.3% and health regeneration in battle by 6%. The effect stacks up to 9 times. The effect lasts for 21s)

In addition to all this, you can get food, preservation and strengthening crystals, a refiner's hammer, essences, ghost coins, spices and much, much more. The full set of rewards is available to those who purchase the Advanced Pass.

[h2]I'm in! How to participate?[/h2]

When you first log into the game after the start of the battle season, each of your characters will see an invitation window.
 
Click the "Start Season" button to join. After that, you can open the season window by clicking on the icon, which is located next to the mini-map.
 
[h2]What should I do?[/h2]

Open the season window. There you will see a list of tasks. Tasks are divided into those that you can complete once per season, and daily ones. One-time tasks are chains (complete the current task to start the next one). However, each group of tasks is available at the same time - as you complete simple tasks, you will open new, more complex ones.

[h2]I want more rewards and tasks![/h2]

Easily! To have access to more tasks and get more rewards for progress points, you can purchase an advanced pass. In addition to these benefits, the pass will also allow you to gain combat experience (progress points) faster. The Advanced Pass is purchased once for the entire season and is valid for your entire account. You can become the owner of an advanced pass and collect your rewards at any time during the season.
 
[h2]Can I get rewards right now?[/h2]

If the romance of completing tasks every day bores you, then sure! To speed up the passage of the Battle Season and get instant access to rewards, you can purchase levels (a fixed number of progress points).
 
[h2]How long is the season?[/h2]

The battle season lasts 30 days and contains 100 levels of progress!
Get the most gifts!
 
We wish you good luck in the new season!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/82d0ffae421d514cfe4ec62cedc00c44f18c48b9.png[/img]

🍁 An ancient autumn holiday comes to the world of the Sphere. While the holiday lasts, any monsters of your level, as well as 3 levels higher or lower, may drop a fragment of a golden leaf. Following the ancient tradition, you have to collect yourself a crown of golden leaves and receive the blessing of autumn itself (bonus to experience up to 5% and increase in damage up to 10%), which is valid during the holiday and a week after it.

By combining leaves, you can also be guaranteed to receive one of two epic belts for your level, as well as useful items, including healing potions, teleportation stones, enhancement scrolls, banker summon scrolls, resurrection scrolls, inlay stones, strengthening crystals and runic strengthening crystals. as well as experience and breadwinner potions.

More information about epic belts: with a certain chance you can get one every time you combine three leaf symbols. If after 19 attempts your character has not received a belt, on the 20th attempt he is guaranteed to receive it!

All belts have 6 colorless slots for stones:
🔥Belt of flying leaves - when receiving a control effect, removes 2 negative effects from the owner. Recharge 90s.
🔥Belt of autumn warmth - upon a critical hit, restores 8% of the owner’s health. Cooldown 35s.
 
Be careful: representatives of the opposite faction can kill you and take half of your golden leaf fragments.

Don't forget about the daily competition. Every day, the winning team will receive a 10% bonus to experience, gold and item drops for the entire next day, and the losing team will receive a 5% bonus to experience and gold.

You can find a daily quest in Cinderkreg and Hellsong Tavern that will give you additional fragments.

A premium account doubles your chances of receiving a gold leaf fragment, and you can buy additional gold leaves in the in-game store.

Good luck!

notes.title: Call of Aradoth
notes.notes:
🔥 Return the mighty dragon Aradoth to the world of the Sphere, win and get unique rewards!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/b635b25685d721866370ea7f09186563acd3691d.png[/img]

The dragon cry has not been heard in the fertile expanses of Erikuria for a long time, the juicy grass has not flared up with flames for a long time and the girls in the surrounding villages have not disappeared. Has good really won and the mighty Aradot finally defeated?

There are those who believe this, but there are others. People call them Knowers. And they say, as one, that Aradot hid and accumulates strength for the next crushing attack, before which the whole world of the Sphere will tremble. All fields will be burned to the ground, cattle destroyed, and anyone who dares to stand in the way of the dragon will inevitably die.

It is said, however, that at a certain hour, when the young moon rises over the Sphere, there is a chance to summon Aradoth against his will and strike, thereby weakening and pushing back the end of all life. To do this, the heroes have to track down and kill the Witness Aradot. Rumor has it that at this hour his path lies along the Emerald Valley, from the eastern exit from Ketam Ai to the Obelisk of Power to perform the magical ritual of strengthening Aradoth.

Hurry up to intercept him - having reached the final point, he will disappear. The Witness is not a fighter and he is rather weak, but special protective charms have been imposed on him - not a single mortal weapon can hit him until the planets in the sky line up in a certain order. Then, and only then, will the spell break for a while, and the heroes will have a chance. Dying, the Witness of Aradoth will call upon his master, and he will answer the call. This will be a chance for the heroes to slay the dragon and once again save the world of the Sphere.

The winners of Aradoth will get the greatest treasures:
✨ epic equipment,
✨rare stones,
✨recipes and valuable ingredients,
✨ spell scrolls,
✨unique title "Monster Slayer"
and much more.
 
⭐But that's not all! The player who kills Aradoth's Witness will also receive a reward - the Witness's life energy will be converted into a Premium account for 7 days and will go to him!

The Witness will start his journey this Friday at 18:30 UTC+3 from the city of Ketam Ai and will disappear in 20 minutes, performing his ritual, if no one stops him.

Good luck!

notes.title: The new battle season!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/f4e70d312190207f5f4a972292c3920144e78d42.png[/img]

More than a hundred gifts for each player of the Sphere 3! The bravest, wisest and noblest warriors of the Sphere are invited to participate in the new battle season!
 
[h2]What is the battle season?[/h2]

In fact, this is a set of tasks for participation in which progress points are given. As you accumulate progress points, you will receive sets of useful and sometimes even unique rewards!

[h2]Tell me more about the prizes![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/accbf494f8f322fb553a02ba24828d4dfbc773af.jpg[/img]

✨[b]Title "Defender of the Forest"[/b]- Reduces the chance to receive a critical hit.
✨[b]Infusion of Windfury[/b] - Increases attack, spell and movement speed by 5% for 24 hours
✨[b]Mount "Forest King"[/b] - gives 150% speed and increases health by 15%.
✨[b]Loot Gatherer Raccoon[/b] - moves 60% faster than normal, lasts 30 days.
✨[b]Pet "Wood"[/b]. Its properties are: Beast, Skill. Pet bonuses below:

◾️ Level 10 - [b]Exceptional Strength[/b] (Increases master's Strength by 1.6%) OR [b]Exceptional Intelligence[/b] (Increases master's Intellect by 1.6%)
◾️ Level 20 -[b] Great Fortification[/b] (Reduces physical and magical damage taken by the master by 3.5%) OR [b]Healing Power[/b] (Increases healing and shields received by 7.5%)
◾️ Level 30 - [b]Exceptional Stamina[/b] (Increases master's stamina by 1.6%) OR [b]Exceptional Spirit[/b] (Increases master's Spirit by 1.6%)
◾️ Level 40 - [b]Wrath of Nature[/b] (Increases the master's Ability Power by 12% for 10s when afflicted with a Stun, Fear, Silence, Root, Sleep, or Disarm effect. Cannot trigger more than once every 40s.) OR [b] ]Fast Recovery[/b] (Increases the master's energy, magical, or necrotic energy regeneration by 15%.)
◾️ Level 50 - [b]Exceptional Stamina[/b] (Increases master's stamina by 1.6%) OR [b]Exceptional Spirit[/b] (Increases master's Spirit by 1.6%)
◾️ Level 60 - [b]Thorns[/b] (Reflects 15% of damage taken back at the enemy.) OR [b]Greater Wound Repair[/b] (Recovers 85% of the master's normal health regen value during combat.)

In addition to all this, you can get food, preservation and strengthening crystals, a refiner's hammer, essences, ghost coins, spices and much, much more. The full set of rewards is available to those who purchase the Advanced Pass.

[h2]I'm in! How to participate?[/h2]

When you first log into the game after the start of the battle season, each of your characters will see an invitation window.
 
Click the "Start Season" button to join. After that, you can open the season window by clicking on the icon, which is located next to the mini-map.
 
[h2]What should I do?[/h2]

Open the season window. There you will see a list of tasks. Tasks are divided into those that you can complete once per season, and daily ones. One-time tasks are chains (complete the current task to start the next one). However, each group of tasks is available at the same time - as you complete simple tasks, you will open new, more complex ones.

[h2]I want more rewards and tasks![/h2]

Easily! To have access to more tasks and get more rewards for progress points, you can purchase an advanced pass. In addition to these benefits, the pass will also allow you to gain combat experience (progress points) faster. The Advanced Pass is purchased once for the entire season and is valid for your entire account. You can become the owner of an advanced pass and collect your rewards at any time during the season.
 
[h2]Can I get rewards right now?[/h2]

If the romance of completing tasks every day bores you, then sure! To speed up the passage of the Battle Season and get instant access to rewards, you can purchase levels (a fixed number of progress points).
 
[h2]How long is the season?[/h2]

The battle season lasts 30 days and contains 100 levels of progress!
Get the most gifts!
 
We wish you good luck in the new season!

notes.title: The new battle season has started!
notes.notes:
The new battle season has started!

Come one, come all! The bravest, wisest and noblest champions of the Sphere are invited to participate in a new battle season!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/756dbff7944ac91e44d47ed5c7a4cda0855d82e7.png[/img]
 
[h2]What is a battle season?[/h2]
 
The battle season is a number of challenges that can be completed to earn progress points. Accumulating progress points will give you sets of useful or even unique rewards. For example, completing the battle season will grant you a unique mount - and participating in it will earn you new magnificent titles, useful consumables, special elixirs, illusions and more.
 
[h2]I'm in! How to participate?[/h2]
 
Each of your characters will see an invitation window when you enter the game for the first time after the season starts. Click the “Begin season” button to join. Afterwards you will be able to access the season window by clicking the icon next to the mini-map.
 
[h2]What should I do?[/h2]
 
Open the season window to see the list of tasks. Some of these challenges can be completed daily and some are available only once per season. The one-time challenges are arranged as quest chains (complete the current task to unlock the next one), but all challenge groups are available to you from the very beginning.
 
[h2]I want more rewards and tasks![/h2]
 
Easily! To have access to more tasks and get more rewards for progress points, you can purchase an extended pass. In addition to these benefits, the pass will also allow you to gain combat experience (progress points) faster. An extended pass is purchased once for the entire season and is valid for your entire account. You can become the owner of an extended pass and collect your rewards at any time during the season.
 
[h2]Can I get the rewards right now?[/h2]
 
Yes! If you are bored with challenges, you can speed up your progress and immediately access rewards by purchasing levels (a set number of progress points) directly.
  
[h2]Tell me more about the prizes![/h2]

[list]
[*][b]The title "Great Alchemist" [/b]- increases the amount of gold and craft resources received by 8%.
[*][b] Flask of Windfury [/b] - increases attack, spell and movement speed by 5% for 24 hours
[*][b]Golden Armorback Mount[/b] — gives 150% speed and increases defense by 20%. 
[*][b]Loot Gatherer Mechanical Spider[/b] - moves 60% faster than usual, lasts 30 days.
[*][b]Pet "Alchemist's Relic"[/b] Its properties are below:[list]
[*] Level 10: Exceptional Strength (Increases wearer's Strength by 1.6%) OR Exceptional Intelligence (Increases wearer's Intellect by 1.6%)
[*] Level 20: Greater Fortification (Reduces physical and magical damage taken by the wearer by 3.5%.) OR Reflection (Has a 10% chance to reflect 20% of the damage taken by the wearer. Reflection chance increases by 10% every 5s, up to 100% until reflection fires.)
[*] Level 30: Exceptional Strength (Increases wearer's Strength by 1.6%) OR Exceptional Intelligence (Increases wearer's Intellect by 1.6%)
[*] Level 40: Otherworldly Power (Increases the power of physical abilities by 9%.) OR Arcane Ordinances (Increases the power of magical abilities by 9%.)
[*] Level 50: Exceptional Strength (Increases wearer's Strength by 1.6%) OR Exceptional Intelligence (Increases wearer's Intellect by 1.6%)
[*] Level 60: Veil of the Sky (Reduces damage taken by the owner and allies within 12m by 4.5%.) OR Shroud of the Deep (Increases damage dealt by the owner and allies within 12m by 4.5%. ).
[/list][/list]
In addition to all this, you can get food, preservation and strengthening crystals, a refiner's hammer, essences, ghost coins, spices and much, much more. The full set of rewards is available to those who purchase the Advanced Pass.
 
[h2]How long is the season? [/h2]
 
The combat season lasts 30 days and contains 100 levels of progress!
 
Get all the gifts!
 
Good luck!

notes.title: Full update of the castle mechanics!
notes.notes:
Friends!
 
Castle sieges have existed unchanged for a long time, and the time has come for pleasant changes! There has been a real revolution in the rules you know. Read more about the new sieges and castle rewards below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/d6c2647374f86af26265b6238964d67b11acdb60.png[/img]

[h2]Changes in siege mechanics[/h2]

All castles in sieges now correspond to level 60. What does it mean? If previously the level of a player in a siege was reduced to the level of a castle, now the levels of all participants in the siege are equal to the 60th.
 
However, this does not make all castles the same - their value and power will, as before, vary from the weakest Almaerta and Bansolas to the richest and most powerful Shiai Tok. In the clans window, you can see the gradation of castles from level 60 to 100.

         [td]45[/td]

     [/tr]
     [tr]
         [td]In'Kaliat[/td]
         [td]50[/td]
         [td]90[/td]
     [/tr]
     [tr]
         [td]Shiai Toc[/td]
         [td]60[/td]
         [td]100[/td]
     [/tr]
[/table]

Let's look at some aspects of this change.

[list]
[*] The effect of the castle territory, which lowers the character's level to the level of the castle upon entering the castle territory, has been removed.
[*] Upon entering the castle territory, high-level effects and skills charging are no longer removed.
[*] At the end of the siege, PvP mode is removed from everyone and all negative buffs are removed (previously all were removed).
[*] All external merchants selling castle consumables now sell a common trade set consisting of level 60 weapons and consumables.
[*] The price of some castle goods has also been raised, for example, castle brewing elixirs.
[*] Only level 60 castle guns remained for sale.
[*] The damage of castle boilers with a burning mixture and catapults has been increased.
[*] Gates of all castles, castle monsters, castle defenders (summoned bosses for castle tokens) are now level 60.
[*] The castle carpenter remained unchanged - it restores 30% of the gate's HP at a time.
[*] Helper guards summoned with the help of a clan skill have been strengthened.
[/list]

[h2]Updated castle treasures[/h2]

The potions in the chest were replaced with potion boxes, new potions in the boxes were added (for energy, fanaticism and rage). All of them correspond to level 60, but differ depending on the level of the castle.
Previously, castle equipment had a level according to the level of the castle, but now all of it corresponds to level 60. The level of items remaining in the hands of the players will remain the same, however, when the castle is recaptured or items are recalled, their level will change to 60.
Castle buffs have been changed - they have become weaker on low-level castles and stronger on high-level ones.

We do not plan to stop at these changes - there are even more interesting updates ahead. And of course, we want to know what you think of the updated castles. We look forward to seeing your impressions and suggestions on what improvements you would like to see in the castle siege game in the comments.

Enjoy the game and exciting sieges!

notes.title: New Event - Rural Horrors
notes.notes:
🚨Meet a brand new event with unique prizes - "Country Horrors"!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/9ad5e7457b0f33fca476e2faf185e5f26ea11a8d.png[/img]

In remote places, far from the battlefields, darkness gathers. Bloodthirsty vampires kidnap the inhabitants and their livestock. Who will save the villages and stop evil spirits?

By helping the villagers, you will receive coppers that can be exchanged for many priceless rewards:
🩸Vampire Hunter Title - Increases critical strike chance by 0.6% and movement speed by 2%.
🩸Garlic Bomb - On hit, reduces critical attack chance by 5% and healing received by 25% for all enemies within 7m for 14s.
🩸Vampirism Helmet - Recovers 2% of the damage dealt as health and has 6 colorless sockets to inlay.
🩸pet "Winged Vampire" (properties - fast, speed):
🔹10 level - Strength and stamina (Increases the wearer's strength and stamina by 0.8%) / Intelligence and stamina (Increases the wearer's intelligence and stamina by 0.8%)
🔹20 level - Heal wounds (During combat, restores the wearer 25% of their normal health regeneration value) / Recovery (Increases the wearer's energy, magical or necrotic energy regeneration by 10%)
🔹30 level - Agility and Stamina (Increases the wearer's Agility and Stamina by 0.8%) / Wisdom and Stamina (Increases the wearer's Wisdom and Stamina by 0.8%)
🔹40 level - Monstrous speed (Increases attack and ability speed of the wearer by 7.5%) / Lifesteal (Recovers health equal to 1% of the damage dealt by the wearer.)
🔹50 level - Agility and Stamina (Increases the wearer's Agility and Stamina by 0.8%) / Wisdom and Stamina (Increases the wearer's Wisdom and Stamina by 0.8%)
🔹Level 60 - Mortal Strikes (If the wearer deals critical damage, their critical attack chance is increased by 7% for 13s. Can only occur once every 60s) / From the Other World (Having received fatal damage, the wearer recovers 20% of the maximum amount of health. Doesn't fire more than once every 3 minutes

While the event is running, you can find William in Cinderkrag to pick up the quest for level 10-39, and in the Knight's Path if you're over level 40 if you're fighting for the human kingdom.

Vagroth warriors level 10-39 can meet William at the Hellsong Tavern, and demons level 40 or more can meet William at the Ice Tribe Village.

Additional coppers can be obtained by killing monsters if the difference between the levels of your character and the monster does not exceed 5.

In the store you can buy a potion that increases the amount of coppers received for killing monsters and completing tasks.

Good luck heroes!

notes.title: The new battle season has started!
notes.notes:
The new battle season has started!

Come one, come all! The bravest, wisest and noblest champions of the Sphere are invited to participate in a new battle season!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/8efb5952d56b6a46f45cfb0c1c2d2c2c0460cb23.png[/img]
 
[h2]What is a battle season?[/h2]
 
The battle season is a number of challenges that can be completed to earn progress points. Accumulating progress points will give you sets of useful or even unique rewards. For example, completing the battle season will grant you a unique mount - and participating in it will earn you new magnificent titles, useful consumables, special elixirs, illusions and more.
 
[h2]I'm in! How to participate?[/h2]
 
Each of your characters will see an invitation window when you enter the game for the first time after the season starts. Click the “Begin season” button to join. Afterwards you will be able to access the season window by clicking the icon next to the mini-map.
 
[h2]What should I do?[/h2]
 
Open the season window to see the list of tasks. Some of these challenges can be completed daily and some are available only once per season. The one-time challenges are arranged as quest chains (complete the current task to unlock the next one), but all challenge groups are available to you from the very beginning.
 
[h2]I want more rewards and tasks![/h2]
 
Easily! To have access to more tasks and get more rewards for progress points, you can purchase an extended pass. In addition to these benefits, the pass will also allow you to gain combat experience (progress points) faster. An extended pass is purchased once for the entire season and is valid for your entire account. You can become the owner of an extended pass and collect your rewards at any time during the season.
 
[h2]Can I get the rewards right now?[/h2]
 
Yes! If you are bored with challenges, you can speed up your progress and immediately access rewards by purchasing levels (a set number of progress points) directly.
  
[h2]Tell me more about the prizes![/h2]

[list]
[*] Title "Fiery Knight" - increases health by 6%.
[*] Flask of Windfury - increases attack, spell and movement speed by 5% for 24 hours
[*] Mount "Burning Raptor" — gives 150% speed and increases health by 20%. Life time: 60d
[*] Loot Gatherer Whelp - moves 60% faster than usual, lasts 60 days.
[*] Pet "Fire Demon". Its properties are below:[list]
[*] Level 10: Exceptional Strength (Increases wearer's Strength by 1.6%) OR Exceptional Intelligence (Increases wearer's Intellect by 1.6%)
[*] Level 20: Tireless (Increases movement, attack, and casting speed by 6%.) OR Infinite Rage (Increases damage dealt by the wearer by 6%.)
[*] Level 30: Exceptional Agility (Increases wearer's Agility by 1.6%) OR Exceptional Wisdom (Increases wearer's Wisdom by 1.6%)
[*] Level 40: Secrets of Darkness (Increases Critical Strike by 3.5%) OR Scent of Blood (Increases Critical Strike by 7%)
[*] Level 50: Exceptional Agility (Increases wearer's Agility by 1.6%) OR Exceptional Wisdom (Increases wearer's Wisdom by 1.6%)
[*] Level 60: Aura of Withering (Reduces regeneration of enemies by 30%, regeneration in battle by 25% in a radius of 10 m.) OR Devouring Flame (If the owner has dealt a critical hit, his enemy is engulfed in flames, taking away 0.5% of the maximum amount of health targets once per second for 15s and reduces defense by 20%, procs no more than once every 45s Against monsters, flames reduce defense by 40%.)[/list][/list]

In addition to all this, you can get food, preservation and strengthening crystals, barony coins, a refiner's hammer, essences, gladiator's coins, spices, magic feathers and much, much more. The full set of rewards is available to those who purchase the Advanced Pass.
 
[h2]How long is the season? What if I pass it earlier?[/h2]
 
The combat season lasts two months and contains 60 levels of progress, but for the fastest shooters in the Wild West, we have 40 more levels in store! After completing the main line, you will be able to receive a supply box every 5 levels, and if you have an advanced pass, you will also receive a knight's chest every 4 levels. From them you can get various useful consumables - exaltation tokens, crystals, feathers, coins of baronies, food, a pass to the bottomless dungeon and much more.
 
Get all the gifts!
 
Good luck!

Good luck on your adventure!

notes.title: In memory of past battles
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/acf2b75e3c91e9657c0c6d76d51c859052571946.png[/img]

It is time for all denizens of the world of the Sphere to honor the warriors that lost their lives in the great battle between the four races!

Feeling the great tide of evil and hatred that marked that fateful day, monsters rise to defy the courageous challengers! Some of them still hold on to the sacred relics of the fallen. It would be a great feat indeed to recover these items despite the danger and use them to honor your ancestors that died to protect their brethren!
 
There are new characters in both factions’ capitals that have quests for you! If you are playing as a human, you’ll need to approach general Ladarus Redblade in Olannor to receive your first task.
If you are treading the path of demons, Commander-in-chief Iom Scarlet, toe of Vargoth is waiting for you in Brionfall.
 
Completing the first mission will unlock additional quests from other characters that can be taken every day even if you have already completed them!
 
Successfully completing these challenges will yield special mounts and helmets as well as potions, gold, experience and exotic magic boxes specially made for the occasion!
 
We wish you good luck in your adventures!

notes.title: Antiquity history
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/3339f9c89be997b9ff8e17ad5febc021d794a1a9.png[/img]

While the event lasts, you can find the characters of the event in Cinderkreg if you are fighting on the side of the human kingdom, or in the Hellsong Tavern if you represent the army of demons. By completing daily tasks, you can get ancient coins and purchase special items with them.
 
Potions that temporarily enhance the character:
[list]
[*] Elixir of Dragonfire - when used, it removes 2% health from all enemies within a 8m radius per second for 12s. Only works against players
[*] Elixir of Phoenix Wing - when used, blinds everyone within a 12m radius for 8s.
[*] Elixir of Cursed Blood - when used, restores 80% of health and takes 5% of health per second for 10s
[*] Elixir of Black Anger - when used, it increases the speed of using abilities and running speed by 35% for 10s, but takes 3% of health per second.
[*] Elixir of Stone Fortress - when used, it increases physical and magical defense by 50%, but reduces movement speed by 25% for 10s.
[/list]

Unique ancient rings with unusual properties.
 
[list]

notes.title: Obelisks of Power - a new PvP activity in the game!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/7fa4aa532ffda4b5bd35990d072e556da5d722c2.png[/img]

Meet the new PvP activity in the game — Obelisks of Power. The obelisks are located all over the world - you can easily find them by the marks on the map. The level of the obelisk roughly corresponds to the level of the location in which it is located. Three times a day, according to the schedule, each obelisk is captured.

How is the capture going? The goal of each participant is to damage the obelisk faster than rivals. Your damage dealt to the obelisk is indicated by green on the bar, and the damage of opponents is indicated by red. In the same place, under the health bar of the obelisk, you can see the name of the current leader. To increase your damage, first knock down someone else's. The longer it takes to inflict damage, the stronger this damage becomes.

The zone around the obelisks is a special PvP zone where all characters are hostile to each other, even if they are clanmates or are in the same group. Accordingly, you can eliminate an opponent who is inflicting damage on your obelisk in the good old way - by defeating him in PvP.

The winner, who scored the damage faster than others, receives a special box - the treasure of the obelisk. By opening it, you can get recipes and rune components, stones and equipment.

If the level difference between the player and the obelisk is 10 or more levels, then this player will not be able to attack the obelisk (for example, a level 30 player will not be able to attack a level 20 obelisk, but a level 29 player will already be able to).

Let the fight begin!

notes.title: The new battle season has started!
notes.notes:
The new battle season has started!

Come one, come all! The bravest, wisest and noblest champions of the Sphere are invited to participate in a new battle season!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/f82d5547b86bed52724f515c8a0ae5e48a3d559a.png[/img]
 
[h2]What is a battle season?[/h2]
 
The battle season is a number of challenges that can be completed to earn progress points. Accumulating progress points will give you sets of useful or even unique rewards. For example, completing the battle season will grant you a unique mount - and participating in it will earn you new magnificent titles, useful consumables, special elixirs, illusions and more.
 
[h2]I'm in! How to participate?[/h2]
 
Each of your characters will see an invitation window when you enter the game for the first time after the season starts. Click the “Begin season” button to join. Afterwards you will be able to access the season window by clicking the icon next to the mini-map.
 
[h2]What should I do?[/h2]
 
Open the season window to see the list of tasks. Some of these challenges can be completed daily and some are available only once per season. The one-time challenges are arranged as quest chains (complete the current task to unlock the next one), but all challenge groups are available to you from the very beginning.
 
[h2]I want more rewards and tasks![/h2]
 
Easily! To have access to more tasks and get more rewards for progress points, you can purchase an extended pass. In addition to these benefits, the pass will also allow you to gain combat experience (progress points) faster. An extended pass is purchased once for the entire season and is valid for your entire account. You can become the owner of an extended pass and collect your rewards at any time during the season.
 
[h2]Can I get the rewards right now?[/h2]
 
Yes! If you are bored with challenges, you can speed up your progress and immediately access rewards by purchasing levels (a set number of progress points) directly.
  
[h2]Tell me more about the prizes![/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Title "Defender of Heaven"[/b] - reduces the chance to get a critical hit by 1.5%, increases defense by 2.5%.
[*] [b]Infusion of Windfury[/b] - increases attack, spell and movement speed by 5% for 24 hours
[*] [b]Mount "Sky Steed"[/b] - increases movement speed by 150%, increases health by 20%. There are 60 days.
[*] [b]Golden Whelp Loot Collector[/b] - moves 60% faster than usual, lasts 60 days.
[*] [b]Pet "Sky Guardian"[/b]. Its properties (on each level you can choose one of two):[list]
[*] Level 10[list]
[*] Exceptional Stamina (Increases the wearer's Stamina by 1.6%)
[*] Exceptional spirit (Increases the owner's spirit by 1.6%)[/list]
[*] Level 20 [list]

The combat season lasts two months and contains 60 levels of progress, but for the fastest shooters in the Wild West, we have 40 more levels in store! After completing the main line, you will be able to receive a supply box every 5 levels, and if you have an advanced pass, you will also receive a chest every 4 levels. notes.title: Crystallomania
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/822861ab7cfba465583eaef72f72121922da8f3a.png[/img]

Crystallomania comes to the world of the Sphere! Travelers from all over the continent repeat the same thing: the Sphere was filled with mysterious magical crystals that hold a variety of secrets and powers. The loyal soldiers of Vagroth and King Sigurd are already preparing to get as many valuable crystals as possible, but this time not only war awaits everyone, but also a real competition.

During Crystallomania, the human and demonic factions will start chasing the power of the crystals. By killing monsters of your level, you have a chance to get a Tarnished Shard, from a group of which it will be possible to create stronger crystals. Each time you collect crystals, you will receive pleasant bonuses, and when you collect a completed crystal, you will receive not only valuable rewards, but also a long-term increase in health and damage, which will grow with each completed crystal you collect.

To receive crystals, your level must not differ from the level of the monster by 2, and to receive crystals from another player - 5 levels.

At the end of each day, the faction that has collected more crystals will receive a nice bonus that will last until the next count.

However, it must be remembered that any representative of the opposite faction can strike you and take some of the tarnished fragments before you turn them into something more useful.

Also, while the Premium account is active, the chance of Tarnished Shards dropping is increased.

By creating new crystals, you can get:
- items to improve,
- teleportation stones,
- pet food,
- useful potions,
- illusion cubes,
- scrolls of resurrection.

And the most important thing. For collecting a completed crystal, you will also receive a buff that increases the health and damage of the character by 7% for two weeks. Each successive crystal completed increases the damage and health bonus by 2.1%, but does not refresh the duration of the buff. The buff cannot be more than 17.5%. The buff is not lost after the death of the character and will remain with you until the end of the event and 1 week after it.

You will need cunning, attentiveness and remarkable perseverance to get as many prizes as possible and defeat your opponents. Well, enough talk, Crystallomania begins!

notes.title: Adventurers
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/1e9114d7f942c81b573954e1de074b3e13b523b8.png[/img]

Spring is the time when the warriors of the Sphere remember that they are able not only to crush enemies into cabbage, but also to slay them on the spot with the power of their charm. And for noble knights, this is the best period to show gallantry and, perhaps, win a couple of hearts. Take part in the spring adventure and get the favor of beauties and other very useful items as a reward!
 
Although women of the Sphere are able to fight on an equal footing with men, not inferior to them in anything, they will never miss an opportunity to acquire jewelry. You have to help the treasure seekers by getting rare pearls from dark dungeons.
 
To join the adventure, humans need to find the beautiful Katherine in Greenwald or the Raven Legion Camp, and demons need to find the equally charming Anna.
 
Characters level 20 and above will be able to try their luck in the dungeons. The seeker wants to get a rare magical pearl for decoration and asks to look for it in the caves among the treasures of the most powerful monsters. Depending on the level of the dungeon, you can be rewarded with one of the caskets or jewelry boxes. Good news: you can find bags with 38 slots and safes with 40 slots in them!
 
And now the most important thing: you can search for treasures and get rewards every day!
 
We wish you a pleasant game!

notes.title: Holiday of the snow whirlwind
notes.notes:
Friends!

It's the most festive time of the year! Have you already started decorating the Christmas tree and shopping for gifts for friends and family? We invite you to go on a New Year's adventure in Sphere 3.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/58e58c12fe75f6eebf9709eb78c74502f33107c9.png[/img]

Only at this special time of the year, completely unique opportunities will be available to you: snow battles, holiday missions and, of course, nice gifts from the local Morozovik.
 
First, get to know Morozovik. You can find it in your faction's capital.
It is from him that the festive chain of tasks that you have to complete begins.
 
So what adventures are waiting for you this New Year?
In the first task you have to save the New Year. Monsters stole Christmas decorations, and what's a New Year without decorations? Go ahead, take them away from the villains!
Frost has lost the gifts he prepared for the holiday! They are somewhere around. Please bring them back!
Light up the Christmas lights! Keep in mind that they are unusual, they are powered only by the energy of stars. Therefore, only specially trained Keepers can light them. Find the Guardian in your location and ask for help.
For completing the entire chain of missions, you will receive wonderful rewards, including a unique headdress, as well as a New Year's Ice Lizard and Snow Raccoon!
 
After completing the tasks, they will become available as daily ones.
 
By completing daily quests and killing monsters of your level, you can get ice coins and use them to buy treasures, a special pet, and holiday amulets with unusual properties.
Whirlwind Amulet - Upon gaining a CC effect, reduces damage taken by 20% for 8s. Can only trigger once every 60s.
Rare quality amulet with red, yellow, purple and three colorless sockets.
Amulet of Fireworks - When you deal a critical hit, strike the target and nearby enemies within 8 yards with a burst of flame that causes disorientation for 2s. NPCs are stunned for 3s instead. Works no more than once every 90s.
Rare quality amulet with red, yellow, purple and three colorless sockets.
Talisman of good luck - Amulet for good luck in the new year. Increases item drop chance by 10%.
Epic quality amulet with six colorless sockets.
Ice ifrit pet - its properties - by reference.
 
In the store, you can purchase potions that increase the amount of ice coins received when killing monsters and completing event quests.
 
And how can the New Year be held without snowballs, icicles and fun? All this is now available to you! Find snowdrifts and ice blocks from which you can get snowballs or icicles that give a slowing effect. You can throw them at each other or at monsters. However, remember that this fun ammo melts easily, and in the warm hands of your characters will live no longer than 5 minutes.
 
And now let's celebrate the New Year in Sphere 3! New Year's adventures await their heroes!
 
Upcoming holidays!

notes.title: The new battle season has started!
notes.notes:
The new battle season has started!

Come one, come all! The bravest, wisest and noblest champions of the Sphere are invited to participate in a new battle season!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/5a368e7bf2a78a72c192210f9aee43bd658cdc55.png[/img]
 
[h2]What is a battle season?[/h2]
 
The battle season is a number of challenges that can be completed to earn progress points. Accumulating progress points will give you sets of useful or even unique rewards. For example, completing the battle season will grant you a unique mount - and participating in it will earn you new magnificent titles, useful consumables, special elixirs, illusions and more.
 
[h2]I'm in! How to participate?[/h2]
 
Each of your characters will see an invitation window when you enter the game for the first time after the season starts. Click the “Begin season” button to join. Afterwards you will be able to access the season window by clicking the icon next to the mini-map.
 
[h2]What should I do?[/h2]
 
Open the season window to see the list of tasks. Some of these challenges can be completed daily and some are available only once per season. The one-time challenges are arranged as quest chains (complete the current task to unlock the next one), but all challenge groups are available to you from the very beginning.
 
[h2]I want more rewards and tasks![/h2]
 
Easily! To have access to more tasks and get more rewards for progress points, you can purchase an extended pass. In addition to these benefits, the pass will also allow you to gain combat experience (progress points) faster. An extended pass is purchased once for the entire season and is valid for your entire account. You can become the owner of an extended pass and collect your rewards at any time during the season.
 
[h2]Can I get the rewards right now?[/h2]
 
Yes! If you are bored with challenges, you can speed up your progress and immediately access rewards by purchasing levels (a set number of progress points) directly.
  
[h2]Tell me more about the prizes![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/b7dd54333492e8a6e1a3460857af4626d455f891.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] [b]Title "Defender of Heaven"[/b] - reduces the chance to get a critical hit by 1.5%, increases defense by 2.5%.
[*] [b]Infusion of Windfury[/b] - increases attack, spell and movement speed by 5% for 24 hours
[*] [b]Mount "Sky Steed"[/b] - increases movement speed by 150%, increases health by 20%. There are 60 days.
[*] [b]Golden Whelp Loot Collector[/b] - moves 60% faster than usual, lasts 60 days.
[*] [b]Pet "Sky Guardian"[/b]. Its properties (on each level you can choose one of two):[list]
[*] Level 10[list]
[*] Exceptional Stamina (Increases the wearer's Stamina by 1.6%)
[*] Exceptional spirit (Increases the owner's spirit by 1.6%)[/list]
[*] Level 20 [list]
[*] Powerful Rune Protection (Reduces magical damage taken by the wearer by 7.5%)
[*] Superb Defensive Stance (Reduces physical damage taken by the wearer by 7.5%)[/list]
[*] Level 30 [list]
[*] Exceptional Stamina (Increases the wearer's Stamina by 1.6%)
[*] Exceptional spirit (Increases the owner's spirit by 1.6%)[/list]
[*] Level 40[list]
[*] Superior Vigilance (Reduces the chance to receive a critical hit by 6.5%)
[*] Thorns (5% chance to reflect 30% of the damage taken by the wearer. The chance to reflect increases by 5% every 10s, up to 50% until the reflection is triggered.)[/list]
[*] Level 50[list]
[*] Exceptional Agility (Increases the wearer's Agility by 1.6%)
[*] Exceptional Wisdom (Increases the wearer's Wisdom by 1.6%)[/list]
[*] Level 60[list]
[*] Heaven's Fury (If the wearer has dealt a critical hit, the ground of punishment appears under their opponent's feet, reducing the opponents' critical attack chance by 7% and their ability power by 15% for 10s. Cannot be triggered more than once every 50s.)
[*] Sky Cover (Reduces damage taken by the owner and allies within 12m radius of him by 4.5%.)[/list][/list]
[/list]In addition to all this, you can get food, crystals of preservation and strengthening, coins of baronies, hammer of the master of processing, essences, coins of the gladiator, spices, magic feathers and much, much more. The full set of rewards is available to those who purchase the extended pass.
 
[h2]How long does this season last? What if I complete it faster?[/h2]
 
The combat season lasts two months and contains 60 levels of progress, but for the fastest shooters in the Wild West, we have 40 more levels in store! After completing the main line, you will be able to receive a supply box every 5 levels, and if you have an advanced pass, you will also receive a chest every 4 levels. There you can get various useful consumables - exaltation tokens, crystals, feathers, coins of baronies, food, a pass to the bottomless dungeon and much more.
 
Get all the gifts!
 
Good luck!

notes.title: Invasion of the Abyss
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/dd92663b6f4d58075bab59ac096962cd82939ae1.png[/img]

There are rumors that monsters from the Abyss are trying to break into the Enchanted World! Fight them on their own territory and get unimaginable rewards.
 
From all the monsters of the world of the Sphere, you can get mysterious “echoes of the Abyss”. However, you can only get the bulk of the items by completing quests in a special zone where you have to fight various monsters from all over the Abyss.
 
You will be offered 4 quests, which will have to be completed in the dangerous territory of a special zone. There you will be able to compete with representatives of enemy factions, however, if you die at the hands of a representative of the opposite faction, you will lose 50% of the echoes. At the end of Glorious Battles, you can get one of three non-combat dragon pets!
 
If you are brave enough, then you will meet with the most terrible Boss of the Abyss - the dragon of Darkness, from which you can win back crystals of preservation and strengthening, but keep in mind that, like all dragons, he has the ability to grow and build up combat power. The more warriors join the battle with the boss, the more rewards you will receive in the end, but remember, they will only go to the most worthy of the warriors.
 
In the process of combining the echoes of the abyss, you will also receive rewards: teleportation stones, resurrection scrolls, armor and weapon upgrade scrolls, and much more. For collecting the final item, you will receive a personal buff that stacks up to three times and will last until the end of the event and a week after it.
 
Every day, the winning faction with the most echoes combined will receive a 10% bonus to experience, gold, and item drops for the day, while the losing team will receive a 5% bonus to experience and gold. Keep your eyes peeled: the enemy faction can strike you down and take half of your echoes!
 
We remind you - characters with an active premium account have a double chance to knock out the shards of the abyss from monsters! Additional Abyss Materia can be purchased from the in-game store.
 
Good luck!

notes.title: New Arena - Altar Defense!
notes.notes:
The new arena "Protection of the Altar" is already in the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/0b764697ba714f72efb28dc51de452eaed425a4e.png[/img]
 
Unlike all other arenas, here everything is decided by your tactics, speed and reaction. Alone or with friends, you have to protect the ancient altar from hordes of monsters with the help of special ifrit towers.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/db326ae25c4d4b6a29bdc75c10cf94827e814ee4.jpg[/img]

To defeat the monsters in the lanes, you need to use defensive towers that can be built and upgraded by spending special resource points. The following towers are available:
Fiery ifrit - deals damage to a group of enemies at the same time.
Poisonous Ifrit creates poisonous puddles under enemies.
Ice Ifrit - Attacks with slow projectiles in an area.
Resource Generator - Does not attack enemies, but generates additional resources.
Ifrit of Destruction - Fires a powerful stone projectile at a single target and reduces its defense.
Ifrit skirmisher - shoots powerful arrows at single targets at a great distance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/2c13977d8269c9d8c013eac05f62bf894d5e538d.jpg[/img]

All towers can be upgraded with resource points. The level of tower improvement is marked by color: white, green, blue, purple, red.
 
In addition, the altar will be attacked by weaker monsters that do not follow the lines. For killing them, you will be awarded a bonus rating.
 
From time to time, bonuses will appear around the altar: healing the altar, increasing the rating, and others. Collecting them will require resource points, and you need to have time to collect them before they disappear.
 
For completing the arena, you get victory points, for which a special “altar guard reward” is issued. In it you can find recipes and rune components, equipment and many useful consumables. Accrual of victory points can be accelerated with the help of a special potion.
 
In addition, for the successful completion of the arena, you earn a rating, and players of level 60 can get into the list of the best defenders at the end of the season. The rating is earned for activity in the arena: building and upgrading towers, killing monsters, successfully completing waves and rounds, saved resource points, saved altar health.
 
You can participate in battles in the arena both in single player and in group mode.
 
Arena passes can be obtained by defeating world bosses.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/c368ec2df60713fa853b4570dff6a2bd434192fc.png[/img]
 
Additional entry attempts (“Altar Arena Passes”) can be purchased from the in-game store.
 
In the future, we will continue to work on improving the arena, and your feedback is the key to making it even more interesting.
 
We wish you good luck in conquering the arena!

notes.title: Class rebalance!
notes.notes:
Friends!

As you know, we are constantly monitoring the situation in the game, paying special attention to both game statistics and your wishes. As a result, we occasionally review the abilities of certain classes to make them more relevant in today's game environment, taking into account new equipment, pets, runes, and other opportunities for strengthening.

Today's update brought important changes to all classes, which you can read about below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/0e2863b9bdb0d4f8b735af996f85a6ceb13c9799.png[/img]

All skill buffs across all classes have been reset so you can reassign skills to reflect the new skill traits.

[h1]Barbarian[/h1]
[h3]Rage[/h3]
[list]
[*]Furious Strike - base damage increased by 5%, Cleave 3 now reduces damage dealt by 5% instead of 10%
[*]Whirlwind - base damage increased by 9%, weapon damage increased by 8.5%, reload time reduced from 25s to 20s. Buffs 1 and 2 increase damage by 20% instead of 15%.
[*]Murder - base damage reduced by 7%, weapon damage reduced by 4%.
[*]Ax Throw - Fury Level 4 increases critical strike chance by 20% instead of 15%.
[*]Skullbreaker - Enhancement 3 now increases ability damage by 20% instead of 15%
[/list]
[h3]Combat Mastery[/h3]
[list]
[*]Bull Strike - base damage increased by 8%, weapon damage by 7%. Ability cooldown increased from 0s to 4s. Buffs 2 and 3 now increase damage by 15%, up from 10%. Simplify 1, 2, and 3 reduce the cost of the ability by 3 Rage, instead of 2.
[*]Frightening Shout - 3D 2 now increases radius by 2m instead of 1m
[*]Berserker - cooldown increased from 30s to 35s, boost 3 now increases efficiency by 3% instead of 2%.
[*]Shockwave - the cost of the ability has been increased from 20 rage to 25.
[*]Bloodlust - Bleeding can now stack up to two times.
[/list]
[h3]Containment[/h3]
[list]
[*]Shackle - cast range increased from 13m to 15m.
[*]Tread of the Titan - base damage increased by 10%, range increased from 7.5m to 8.5m, number of targets increased from 6 to 7, reload time increased from 35s to 42s
[*]Resolute - now affects the ability "Tread of the Titan"
[/list]
[h1]Paladin[/h1]
[h3]Retribution[/h3]
[list]
[*]Righteous Strike - Enhancement 1 increases damage by 15% instead of 10%.
[*]Onslaught - base damage increased by 6%, weapon damage by 12%. Range 2 now gives 2m instead of 1m. Range 3 has been replaced with a buff that increases the damage of the ability by 15%.
[*]Justice - buff 1 increases damage by 20% instead of 15%, buff 2 also increases healing by 20%
[*]Righteous Wrath - radius increased from 15m to 18m
[*]Power of Faith - base efficiency increased by 12%, weapon efficiency multiplier increased by 6%.
[/list]

notes.title: The Shattered Blade
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/2fc7d1cb4fc57e1cc9cc18226f0650a859771174.png[/img]

We invite you to take part in a new event - the Shattered Blade!
 
While the event lasts, monsters of at least 5 levels from yours may drop debris, combining which, you can get various useful things to improve equipment and increase the chance of finding an item, as well as a cumulative boost that will be in effect throughout the event and a week after it.
 
When you combine two restored blades, you can get a new title - "Blade Master" (increases damage, attack speed and spells by 1%.), ​​As well as strengthening "Sharp Blade" (increases ability damage, attack speed and spells by 5%. Can stack up to 6 times, up to a 10% bonus.), which will be valid for the entire event and a week after.
 
While the premium account is active, the chance of dropping debris is doubled.
 
Killing a representative of the opposite faction allows you to pick up half of the debris that he had with him, and once a day your faction will receive a boost for the number of combined items of this event.
 
Good luck with your adventure!

notes.title: Antiquity history
notes.notes:
While the event lasts, you can find the characters of the event in Cinderkreg if you are fighting on the side of the human kingdom, or in the Hellsong Tavern if you represent the army of demons. By completing daily tasks, you can get ancient coins and purchase special items with them.
 
Potions that temporarily enhance the character:
[list]
[*] Elixir of Dragonfire - when used, it removes 2% health from all enemies within a 8m radius per second for 12s. Only works against players
[*] Elixir of Phoenix Wing - when used, blinds everyone within a 12m radius for 8s.
[*] Elixir of Cursed Blood - when used, restores 80% of health and takes 5% of health per second for 10s
[*] Elixir of Black Anger - when used, it increases the speed of using abilities and running speed by 35% for 10s, but takes 3% of health per second.
[*] Elixir of Stone Fortress - when used, it increases physical and magical defense by 50%, but reduces movement speed by 25% for 10s.
[/list]

Unique ancient rings with unusual properties.
 
[list]
[*] The Eternal Ring has 3 different stone slots, plus three more colorless slots. The ring can have one of three effects to choose from:
[*] Taking damage has a 5% chance to increase your character's movement speed by 25% for 8 seconds.
[*] When you receive damage with a 5% chance, your character's physical and magical defense will increase by 15% for 10 seconds.
[*] Taking damage has a 5% chance to increase your character's stamina by 20% for 12 seconds.
[/list]

New titles:
[list]
[*] "Relic Connoisseur"
[*] “Master of Archeology”.
[/list]

You can buy all these outlandish gizmos from the event merchant located in the same cities, and additional coins can be obtained by killing monsters, or purchased from the GXP store.
 
Premium account doubles the chances of getting coins when killing monsters.
 
Good luck!

notes.title: Halloween in Sphere 3!
notes.notes:
Trick or treat, spherians?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/0be97f2bc6c331bbe9eb8872c860d6412812eaea.png[/img]
 
Halloween is coming, which means that all kinds of evil spirits are already being selected from crypts and graves. The world of Sphere 3 has been attacked by ghosts. You have to find out who they are and where they came from! Meet the Halloween event in Sphere 3!
 
Complete tasks and fight monsters, get candy for it and exchange them for valuable prizes, including two new unique pets - Poltergeist and Jack-O-Lantern, as well as a shadow fox that not only collects loot 60% faster, but also increases health regeneration by 20% and health regeneration in combat by 10%. And of course, scary helmets!
 
In the capital, each faction already has a Strange Girl. With its help, you have to complete a very exciting chain of quests, during which you can get wonderful in-game prizes, including:
[list]
[*] unique headdress - Pumpkin,
[*] Horse of the Damned of different colors,
[*] scrolls of improvement and enchantment,
[*] inlay stones,
[*] various useful consumables.
[*] You are waiting for battles with ghosts, unraveling the mysteries of the universe, collecting various ingredients for a spell, the game "Candy or life!" and much more.
[/list]
 
Humans will be able to find the Weird Girl in the eastern part of Olannor, and demons in the west of Brionnfall. Barker can also point the way to it - he can be found in most large settlements.
 
But that's not all! During an interesting daily quest, you can also get valuable prizes, for example:
[list]
[*] candies,
[*] essences,
[*] pet food,
[*] paints,
[*] illusion cubes.
[/list]
The daily quest can be taken from Jack the Pumpkin in Olannor and Brionnfall.
 
By the way, in event pumpkins you can find another type of candy that gives a buff for the entire duration of the event and a week later and stacks up to 30 times.
 
Want more details? Then get into the game!
 
We wish you a happy Halloween!

notes.title: A new battle season has started!
notes.notes:
Come one, come all! The bravest, wisest and noblest champions of the Sphere are invited to participate in a new battle season!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/250361cd4ed7e19c76cb8c8ae5d24a5f2c9e0b70.png[/img]

What is a battle season?
 
The battle season is a number of challenges that can be completed to earn progress points. Accumulating progress points will give you sets of useful or even unique rewards. For example, completing the first battle season will grant you a unique mount - and participating in it will earn you new magnificent titles, useful consumables, special elixirs, illusions and more.
 
I’m in game! Where do I sign up?
 
Each of your characters will see an invitation window when you enter the game for the first time after the season starts. Click the “Begin season” button to join. Afterwards you will be able to access the season window by clicking the icon next to the mini-map.
 
What should I be doing?
 
Open the season window to see the list of tasks. Some of these challenges can be completed daily and some are available only once per season. The one-time challenges are arranged as quest chains (complete the current task to unlock the next one), but all challenge groups are available to you from the very beginning.
 
I want more rewards and challenges!
 
We hear you! You can buy a premium pass to access more challenges and receive additional rewards for the progress points you accumulate. Aside from that, the premium pass increases the amount of battle experience (i. e. progress points) that you earn. A premium pass needs only to be purchased once per season and is valid for all characters on your account.
 
Can I receive my rewards right away?
 
Yes! If you are bored with challenges, you can speed up your progress and immediately access rewards by purchasing levels (a set number of progress points) directly.
 
How long does this season last? What if I complete it faster?
 
The battle season lasts two months and contains 50 progress levels, but the swiftest players can access 50 more! Once you complete the main challenges you will receive a box every 5 levels and a chest every 4 levels on top of that assuming you purchased a premium pass. You can obtain differerent useful things from them.
 
Get all the gifts!
 
Good luck!

notes.title: We need the best blacksmith!
notes.notes:
We need the best blacksmith!

Dear friends!
 
We are glad to inform you about the start of the "Best Blacksmith" contest!
 
In just five days, starting today, every master, regardless of level, race or class, who tries to improve their armor or weapons using save crystals will be able to claim legendary prizes.
 
1 PLACE:
Legendary Weapon Smith - Upgrade your weapon by +3
Legendary Armor Smith - Upgrade your armor by +3

2ND PLACE:

Great Weapon Smith - Upgrade your weapon by +2
Great Armor Smith - Upgrade your armor by +2

3RD PLACE:

Great Weapon Smith - Upgrade your weapon by +1

notes.title: Fallen leaves festival
notes.notes:
An ancient autumn holiday comes to the world of the Sphere. While the holiday lasts, any monsters of your level, as well as 3 levels more or less, may drop a fragment of a gold leaf. Following an ancient tradition, you have to collect yourself a crown of golden leaves and receive the blessing of autumn itself (a bonus to experience up to 5% and an increase in damage up to 10%), which is valid during the holiday and a week after it.

When you combine the leaves, you will also receive useful items, including healing potions, teleportation stones, improvement scrolls, banker summon scrolls, resurrection scrolls, inlay stones at your level, fortification crystals and runic fortification crystals, as well as experience and earner potions.

Be careful: representatives of the opposite faction can kill you and take half of your gold leaf fragments.

Don't forget about the daily competition. Each day, the winning team will receive a 10% bonus to experience, gold and item drops for the entire next day, and the losing team will receive a 5% bonus to experience and gold.

A daily quest can be found in Cinderkreg and Hellsong Tavern that will provide additional fragments.

Good luck!

Today our favorite, coolest and most amazing game is celebrating its birthday!

It seems like just yesterday we announced the launch of the CBT, and the very first clans were cautiously trying to lay siege to Almaert Castle. Cartel, Surreal, Panic - remember these legendary names? Remember that fierce PvP without limits and rules, the first sudden bugs and difficulties? A long level up to level 40, dreams of an eternal wingback, top castles in Bristle Fields, fear of leaving the peaceful zone because enemies are everywhere, and losing experience is almost deathly painful. There are no experience potions, no rates, but there are glancing and crushing blows in PvP. Those were good times...

But!
Since then, the Sphere has also been pretty pumped! We found out what the players want, followed your feedback, changed what you didn’t like, together with you we were looking for ways to improve the game, and now we can safely say that every year the Sphere will get better and better!

notes.title: A new battle season has started!
notes.notes:
Come one, come all! The bravest, wisest and noblest champions of the Sphere are invited to participate in a new battle season!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/56215f8d576702f09e75bc1b0bec869d1e02cc0b.png[/img]

What is a battle season?
 
The battle season is a number of challenges that can be completed to earn progress points. Accumulating progress points will give you sets of useful or even unique rewards. For example, completing the first battle season will grant you a unique mount - and participating in it will earn you new magnificent titles, useful consumables, special elixirs, illusions and more.
 
I’m in game! Where do I sign up?
 
Each of your characters will see an invitation window when you enter the game for the first time after the season starts. Click the “Begin season” button to join. Afterwards you will be able to access the season window by clicking the icon next to the mini-map.
 
What should I be doing?
 
Open the season window to see the list of tasks. Some of these challenges can be completed daily and some are available only once per season. The one-time challenges are arranged as quest chains (complete the current task to unlock the next one), but all challenge groups are available to you from the very beginning.
 
I want more rewards and challenges!
 
We hear you! You can buy a premium pass to access more challenges and receive additional rewards for the progress points you accumulate. Aside from that, the premium pass increases the amount of battle experience (i. e. progress points) that you earn. A premium pass needs only to be purchased once per season and is valid for all characters on your account.
 
Can I receive my rewards right away?
 
Yes! If you are bored with challenges, you can speed up your progress and immediately access rewards by purchasing levels (a set number of progress points) directly.
 
How long does this season last? What if I complete it faster?
 
The battle season lasts two months and contains 50 progress levels, but the swiftest players can access 50 more! notes.title: A new battle season has started!
notes.notes:
Come one, come all! The bravest, wisest and noblest champions of the Sphere are invited to participate in a new battle season!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/213a4b87ca161ab5682f13c94cc3e5a7e240d1f4.png[/img]

What is a battle season?
 
The battle season is a number of challenges that can be completed to earn progress points. Accumulating progress points will give you sets of useful or even unique rewards. For example, completing the first battle season will grant you a unique mount - and participating in it will earn you new magnificent titles, useful consumables, special elixirs, illusions and more.
 
I’m in game! Where do I sign up?
 
Each of your characters will see an invitation window when you enter the game for the first time after the season starts. Click the “Begin season” button to join. Afterwards you will be able to access the season window by clicking the icon next to the mini-map.
 
What should I be doing?
 
Open the season window to see the list of tasks. Some of these challenges can be completed daily and some are available only once per season. The one-time challenges are arranged as quest chains (complete the current task to unlock the next one), but all challenge groups are available to you from the very beginning.
 
I want more rewards and challenges!
 
We hear you! You can buy a premium pass to access more challenges and receive additional rewards for the progress points you accumulate. Aside from that, the premium pass increases the amount of battle experience (i. e. progress points) that you earn. A premium pass needs only to be purchased once per season and is valid for all characters on your account.
 
Can I receive my rewards right away?
 
Yes! If you are bored with challenges, you can speed up your progress and immediately access rewards by purchasing levels (a set number of progress points) directly.
 
How long does this season last? What if I complete it faster?
 
The battle season lasts two months and contains 50 progress levels, but the swiftest players can access 50 more! Once you complete the main challenges you will receive a box every 5 levels and a chest every 4 levels on top of that assuming you purchased a premium pass. You can obtain differerent useful things from them.
 
Get all the gifts!
 
Good luck!

notes.title: Victory Day! Complete missions and get rewards!
notes.notes:
It is time for all denizens of the world of the Sphere to honor the warriors that lost their lives in the great battle between the four races!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/b318623c4fc36188e7ebfb226f9f99dd76cfe3d7.jpg[/img]
 
Feeling the great tide of evil and hatred that marked that fateful day, monsters rise to defy the courageous challengers! Some of them still hold on to the sacred relics of the fallen. It would be a great feat indeed to recover these items despite the danger and use them to honor your ancestors that died to protect their brethren!
 
There are new characters in both factions’ capitals that have quests for you! If you are playing as a human, you’ll need to approach general Ladarus Redblade in Olannor to receive your first task.
If you are treading the path of demons, Commander-in-chief Iom Scarlet, toe of Vargoth is waiting for you in Brionfall.
 
Completing the first mission will unlock additional quests from other characters that can be taken every day even if you have already completed them!
 
Successfully completing these challenges will yield special mounts and helmets as well as potions, gold, experience and exotic magic boxes specially made for the occasion!
 
We wish you good luck in your adventures!

notes.title: Pet System Update
notes.notes:
Do you have a lot of pets that you don't play with? Don't do it like that, pets love attention and care! In this game update, we made it so that even those little friends whose bonuses you do not need will be useful and will be able to bring you nice and important gifts!

Introducing the Mercenary Pet System!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/fca67e1988077608bfad82f0ecf44799687f89fe.png[/img]

The essence of the system is that you can collect pumped pets in small groups and send them on special tasks. Pets go on a mission in automatic mode and after some time return with prey.

Loot is a different set of items:

pet food,
all kinds of consumables
coins of the Free Baronies,
runes,
gold,
elevation tokens,
alchemical spices
paints
and much more, depending on the level and type of task.

Let's take a closer look at the system.

Three buttons appeared at the bottom of the pets window - the actual list of pets for calling, tasks and training.

Tasks
The quest window has 6 slots, the first three are unlocked at character level 10, 30, and 50, and three more after completing 50, 100, and 250 pet quests.

When you click the "Get" button, you are prompted to select pets that will go on a mission. Depending on the selected pets, you will see the chance of successful completion of the task and the chance of receiving an additional reward. The chance to receive an additional reward appears only if you have reached 100% chance of receiving the main reward. The chance of success depends on the number of eligible pets and their desired properties.

Also, sending on a mission will require you to give a certain amount in gold. Here you can also see the time the execution will take. In the next updates, the game will introduce an accelerator - an item with which you can complete the task faster.

The tasks available to you at the moment depend on the level of your character. After completing one task, a new one immediately appears in the vacated slot. Once a day, you can reset the task in one of the task slots for free.

Pet properties
The properties of pets are exactly what is responsible for the success of their tasks. This parameter does not carry other functions yet. A pet can have one primary property and one additional property.

Basic properties:

Secretive
Fast
Magical
Beast
Strong
Crusher
Additional properties:

Speed ​​- speeds up the task by 3/6/9/12/15/18%
Luck - gives a chance for an additional reward of 1/2/3/4/5/6%
Skill - additionally increases the chance of success by 1/2/4/6/8/10%
Savings - reduces the cost of sending (if any) by 1/3/5/7/9/11%
Additional properties of pets are available for pumping in the "Training" window. Leveling them will require you to exalt tokens and gold.

Any changes to the pet's properties after they are sent to a quest will not affect the outcome of the current quest.

Now there is a job for each of your pets!
